     3	    pub(super) fn apartments_interior(&self, m: &mut Mesh, selected: Option<usize>) {
     4	        let x = self.p.x;
     5	        let z = self.p.z;
     6	        let count = (self.size.y / 4.) as usize;
     7	        let first = selected.unwrap_or(0).min(count.saturating_sub(1));
     8	        let end = if selected.is_some() {
     9	            (first + 1).min(count)
    10	        } else {
    11	            count
    12	        };
    13	        for floor in first..end {
    14	            let y = floor as f32 * 4.;
    15	            let variant = (self.id * 13 + floor * 7) % 32;
    16	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
    17	                for offset in [-1., 1.] {
    18	                    m.cuboid(
    19	                        [x + side * 3., y + 1.6, z + offset * 7.5],
    20	                        [0.18, 3.2, 11.],
    21	                        [0.72, 0.69, 0.62],
    22	                        1,
    23	                        0.,
    24	                    );
    25	                }
    26	            }
    27	            m.cuboid(
    28	                [x, y, z],
    29	                [self.size.x, 0.12, self.size.z],
    30	                [0.5, 0.48, 0.43],
    31	                1,
    32	                0.,
    33	            );
    34	            // Lift cabin and floor indicator occupy the shared entrance hall.

    69	                }
    70	                continue;
    71	            }
    72	            for side in [-1., 1.] {

    74	                let rz = z + (variant % 4) as f32 - 1.5;
    75	                m.cuboid(
    76	                    [rx, y + 0.5, rz + 5.],

    78	                    [0.25 + (variant % 3) as f32 * 0.15, 0.4, 0.55],
    79	                    1,
    80	                    0.,
    81	                );
    82	                m.cuboid(
    83	                    [rx, y + 0.6, rz - 5.],
    84	                    [3., 1.2, 5.],
    85	                    [0.8, 0.78, 0.67],
    86	                    1,
    87	                    0.,
    88	                );
    89	                m.cuboid([rx, y + 0.9, rz], [2.5, 0.2, 2.], [0.45, 0.3, 0.18], 2, 0.);
    90	                m.cuboid(

   100	                    [2.5, 0.25, 0.8],

   139	
   140	/// Search positions match generated furniture; one deterministic stash per apartment.
   141	pub fn search_target(b: &Building, p: Vec3) -> Option<(u64, bool, &'static str)> {
   142	    let floor = b.rendered_floor(p);
   143	    if floor == 0 {
   144	        return None;
   145	    }
   146	    let variant = (b.id * 13 + floor * 7) % 32;
   147	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
   148	    for (side_id, side) in [-1., 1.].into_iter().enumerate() {
   149	        let rx = b.p.x + side * 8.;
   150	        let rz = b.p.z + (variant % 4) as f32 - 1.5;
   151	        for (item, (dx, dz, label)) in [
   152	            (0., 5., "SOFA"),
   153	            (0., -5., "BED"),
   154	            (0., 0., "TABLE"),
   155	            (2.4, 6., "WARDROBE"),
   156	            (-4., -5., "SHELVES"),
   157	        ]
   158	        .into_iter()
   159	        .enumerate()
   160	        {
   161	            let q = Vec3::new(rx + dx, b.p.y + floor as f32 * 4. + 1., rz + dz);
   162	            if p.distance(q) < 2.8 {
   163	                let key =
   164	                    ((b.id as u64 * 64 + floor as u64) * 2 + side_id as u64) * 8 + item as u64;
   165	                candidates.push((
   166	                    p.distance(q),
   167	                    (key, (variant + side_id * 3) % 5 == item, label),
   168	                ));
   169	            }
   170	        }
   171	    }
   172	    candidates
   173	        .into_iter()
   174	        .min_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0))
   175	        .map(|v| v.1)
   176	}
   177	
   178	pub(super) fn furniture_colliders(b: &Building) -> Vec<Collider> {
   179	    let mut out = Vec::new();
   180	    for floor in 1..(b.size.y / 4.) as usize {
   181	        let variant = (b.id * 13 + floor * 7) % 32;
   182	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
   183	            let x = b.p.x + side * 8.;
   184	            let z = b.p.z + (variant % 4) as f32 - 1.5;
   185	            for (dx, y, dz, sx, sy, sz) in [
   186	                (0., 0.5, 5., 4., 1., 2.),
   187	                (0., 0.6, -5., 3., 1.2, 5.),
   188	                (0., 0.9, 0., 2.5, 0.2, 2.),
   189	                (2.4, 1.4, 6., 1.4, 2.8, 2.),
   190	                (-4., 1., -5., 1., 2., 3.),
   191	            ] {
   192	                out.push(Collider {
   193	                    p: Vec3::new(x + dx, floor as f32 * 4. + y, z + dz),
   194	                    size: Vec3::new(sx, sy, sz),
   195	                    movable: false,
   196	                    breakable: false,
   197	                });
   198	            }
   199	        }
   200	    }
   201	    out
   202	}

   205	mod tests {
   206	    use super::*;
   207	    fn building() -> Building {
   208	        Building {
   209	            id: 9,
   210	            name: "Office",
   211	            p: Vec3::new(0., 10., 0.),
   212	            size: Vec3::new(30., 64., 30.),
   213	            style: Style::Glass,
   214	            interior: true,
   215	        }
   216	    }
   217	    #[test]
   218	    fn only_active_floor_is_generated() {
   219	        let b = building();
   220	        let m = b.interior_mesh_at(2);
   221	        assert!(m
   222	            .vertices
   223	            .iter()
   224	            .all(|v| v.position[1] >= 17.9 && v.position[1] <= 22.1));
   225	        assert!(m.vertices.len() < 2500);
   226	        assert!(b.interior_mesh().vertices.len() > m.vertices.len() * 5);
   227	        assert!(b.interior_mesh_at(0).vertices.len() < m.vertices.len());
   228	    }
   229	    #[test]
   230	    fn each_apartment_has_one_stash_and_lobby_none() {
   231	        let b = building();
   232	        assert!(search_target(&b, Vec3::new(8., 11., 0.)).is_none());
   233	        for floor in 1..16 {
   234	            let variant = (b.id * 13 + floor * 7) % 32;
   235	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   236	                let mut found = 0;
   237	                for (dx, dz) in [(0., 5.), (0., -5.), (0., 0.), (2.4, 6.), (-4., -5.)] {
   238	                    let p = Vec3::new(
   239	                        side * 8. + dx,
   240	                        11. + floor as f32 * 4.,
   241	                        (variant % 4) as f32 - 1.5 + dz,
   242	                    );
   243	                    if search_target(&b, p).is_some_and(|(_, stash, _)| stash) {
   244	                        found += 1;
   245	                    }
   246	                }
   247	                assert_eq!(found, 1);
   248	            }
   249	        }
   250	    }
   251	}

    37	#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Debug)]
    38	pub enum Style {
    39	    Glass,
    40	    Brick,
    41	    House,
    42	    Warehouse,
    43	    Civic,

    45	}
    46	#[derive(Clone)]
    47	pub struct Building {
    48	    pub id: usize,
    49	    pub name: &'static str,
    50	    pub p: Vec3,
    51	    pub size: Vec3,
    52	    pub style: Style,
    53	    pub interior: bool,
    54	}
    55	#[derive(Clone)]
    56	pub struct Collider {
    57	    pub p: Vec3,
    58	    pub size: Vec3,
    59	    pub movable: bool,
    60	    pub breakable: bool,
    61	}
    62	impl Collider {
    63	    pub fn contains(&self, p: Vec3, r: f32) -> bool {
    64	        p.y + 1.5 > self.p.y - self.size.y / 2.
    65	            && p.y - 0.8 < self.p.y + self.size.y / 2.
    66	            && p.x > self.p.x - self.size.x / 2. - r
    67	            && p.x < self.p.x + self.size.x / 2. + r
    68	            && p.z > self.p.z - self.size.z / 2. - r
    69	            && p.z < self.p.z + self.size.z / 2. + r
    70	    }
    71	}
    72	impl Building {
    73	    pub fn entrance(&self) -> Vec3 {
    74	        Vec3::new(self.p.x, self.p.y + 1., self.p.z - self.size.z / 2. - 2.)
    75	    }
    76	    pub fn inside(&self, p: Vec3) -> bool {
    77	        (p.x - self.p.x).abs() < self.size.x / 2. && (p.z - self.p.z).abs() < self.size.z / 2.
    78	    }
    79	    pub fn support(&self, p: Vec3) -> f32 {
    80	        if matches!(self.name, "Jewelry" | "Office" | "Westhaven") {
    81	            return self.p.y
    82	                + ((p.y - self.p.y - 0.6) / 4.)
    83	                    .floor()
    84	                    .max(0.)
    85	                    .min((self.size.y / 4.).floor())
    86	                    * 4.;
    87	        }
    88	        if self.name != "Casino" {
    89	            return self.p.y;
    90	        }
    91	        if p.y > self.p.y + 8.5 {
    92	            return self.p.y + 8.;
    93	        }
    94	        let dx = p.x - self.p.x;
    95	        let dz = p.z - self.p.z;
    96	        let start = -self.size.z * 0.35;
    97	        if (5.5..=8.5).contains(&dx) && (start..=start + 20.).contains(&dz) {
    98	            return (((dz - start) / 1.).floor() + 1.).min(20.) * 0.2;
    99	        }
   100	        if p.y > self.p.y + 4.5 || (dx > 4. && dz > start + 20.) {
   101	            self.p.y + 4.
   102	        } else {
   103	            self.p.y
   104	        }
   105	    }
   106	    pub fn colliders(&self) -> Vec<Collider> {
   107	        let mut out = self.local_colliders();
   108	        for c in &mut out {
   109	            c.p.y += self.p.y;
   110	        }
   111	        out
   112	    }
   113	    fn shell_colliders(&self) -> Vec<Collider> {
   114	        let x = self.p.x;
   115	        let z = self.p.z;
   116	        let w = self.size.x;
   117	        let d = self.size.z;
   118	        let h = self.size.y;
   119	        let c = |p, size| Collider {
   120	            p,
   121	            size,
   122	            movable: false,
   123	            breakable: false,
   124	        };
   125	        if !self.interior {
   126	            return vec![c(Vec3::new(x, h / 2., z), self.size)];
   127	        }
   128	        let mut out = vec![
   129	            c(Vec3::new(x - w / 2., h / 2., z), Vec3::new(0.7, h, d)),
   130	            c(Vec3::new(x + w / 2., h / 2., z), Vec3::new(0.7, h, d)),
   131	            c(Vec3::new(x, h / 2., z + d / 2.), Vec3::new(w, h, 0.7)),
   132	        ];
   133	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
   134	            out.push(c(
   135	                Vec3::new(x + side * (w / 4. + 0.75), h / 2., z - d / 2.),
   136	                Vec3::new(w / 2. - 1.5, h, 0.7),
   137	            ));
   138	        }
   139	        out.push(c(
   140	            Vec3::new(x, (h + 3.) / 2., z - d / 2.),
   141	            Vec3::new(3., h - 3., 0.7),
   142	        ));
   143	        out
   144	    }
   145	    fn local_colliders(&self) -> Vec<Collider> {
   146	        let mut out = self.shell_colliders();
   147	        if !self.interior {
   148	            return out;
   149	        }
   150	        let x = self.p.x;
   151	        let z = self.p.z;
   152	        let h = self.size.y;
   153	        let c = |p, size| Collider {
   154	            p,
   155	            size,
   156	            movable: false,
   157	            breakable: false,
   158	        };
   159	        if matches!(self.name, "Office" | "Westhaven") {
   160	            for floor in 0..(h / 4.) as usize {
   161	                let y = floor as f32 * 4.;
   162	                for side in [-1., 1.] {
   163	                    for offset in [-1., 1.] {
   164	                        out.push(c(
   165	                            Vec3::new(x + side * 3., y + 1.6, z + offset * 7.5),
   166	                            Vec3::new(0.18, 3.2, 11.),
   167	                        ));
   168	                    }
   169	                }
   170	            }
   171	        }
   172	        if matches!(self.name, "Office" | "Westhaven") {
   173	            out.extend(apartments::furniture_colliders(self));
   174	        }
   175	        if !matches!(self.name, "Office" | "Westhaven") {
   176	            for (p, size, _, _) in self.fittings() {
   177	                out.push(c(p, size));
   178	            }
   179	        }
   180	        out
   181	    }
   182	    pub fn mesh(&self, m: &mut Mesh, lod: u8) {
   183	        let start = m.vertices.len();
   184	        self.local_mesh(m, lod);
   185	        for v in &mut m.vertices[start..] {
   186	            v.position[1] += self.p.y;
   187	        }
   188	    }
   189	    fn local_mesh(&self, m: &mut Mesh, lod: u8) {
   190	        let x = self.p.x;
   191	        let z = self.p.z;
   192	        let w = self.size.x;
   193	        let d = self.size.z;
   194	        let h = self.size.y;
   195	        let (mat, c) = match self.style {
   196	            Style::Glass => (3, [0.38, 0.63, 0.73]),
   197	            Style::Brick => (2, [0.74, 0.5, 0.37]),
   198	            Style::House => (2, [0.8, 0.75, 0.58]),
   199	            Style::Warehouse => (4, [0.57, 0.62, 0.6]),
   200	            Style::Civic => (1, [0.81, 0.8, 0.7]),
   201	            Style::Neon => (1, [0.28, 0.3, 0.46]),
   202	        };
   203	        if self.interior {
   204	            for wall in self.shell_colliders() {
   205	                m.cuboid(
   206	                    [wall.p.x, wall.p.y, wall.p.z],
   207	                    [wall.size.x, wall.size.y, wall.size.z],
   208	                    c,
   209	                    mat,
   210	                    0.,
   211	                );
   212	            }
   213	            m.cuboid([x, 0.05, z], [w, 0.1, d], [0.65, 0.65, 0.62], 1, 0.);
   214	        // Roof is a separate interior-occlusion layer, supplied by World when outside.
   215	        } else {
   216	            m.cuboid([x, h / 2., z], [w, h, d], c, mat, 0.);
   217	        }
   218	        m.cuboid(
   219	            [x, if self.interior { -0.2 } else { 0.25 }, z],
   220	            [w + 1., if self.interior { 0.4 } else { 0.5 }, d + 1.],
   221	            [0.5, 0.54, 0.54],
   222	            1,
   223	            0.,
   224	        );
   225	        if self.style == Style::House {
   226	            m.roof([x, h, z], [w + 2., 3., d + 2.], [0.48, 0.29, 0.2]);
   227	            if lod == 0 {
   228	                m.cuboid(
   229	                    [x + w * 0.25, h + 2., z],
   230	                    [1., 4., 1.],
   231	                    [0.6, 0.35, 0.26],
   232	                    2,
   233	                    0.,
   234	                );
   235	            }
   236	        } else {
   237	            for floor in [h, h * 0.45] {
   238	                if self.interior {

   240	                        m.cuboid(
   241	                            [x + side * (w / 2. + 0.25), floor, z],
   242	                            [0.7, 0.5, d + 1.1],
   243	                            [0.65, 0.69, 0.7],
   244	                            4,
   245	                            0.,
   246	                        );
   247	                        m.cuboid(
   248	                            [x, floor, z + side * (d / 2. + 0.25)],
   249	                            [w + 1.1, 0.5, 0.7],
   250	                            [0.65, 0.69, 0.7],
   251	                            4,
   252	                            0.,
   253	                        );
   254	                    }
   255	                } else {
   256	                    m.cuboid(
   257	                        [x, floor, z],
   258	                        [w + 1.1, 0.5, d + 1.1],
   259	                        [0.65, 0.69, 0.7],
   260	                        4,
   261	                        0.,
   262	                    );
   263	                }
   264	            }
   265	            if !self.interior {

   267	            }
   268	        }
   269	        if lod > 0 {
   270	            self.sign(m);
   271	            if self.name == "Donut Shop" {
   272	                m.torus([x, h + 3., z], [2.4, 0.65], [0.95, 0.45, 0.65], 8);
   273	            }

   276	        if self.name == "Donut Shop" {

   283	        }
   284	        if matches!(self.name, "Donut Shop" | "Grocery" | "Weapons") {
   285	            let color = match self.name {
   286	                "Donut Shop" => [0.85, 0.38, 0.65],
   287	                "Grocery" => [0.24, 0.65, 0.34],
   288	                _ => [0.22, 0.3, 0.4],
   289	            };
   290	            m.cuboid(

   482	    // One description drives both visible furniture/walls and collision.
   483	    fn fittings(&self) -> Vec<(Vec3, Vec3, [f32; 3], u8)> {
   484	        let mut out = Vec::new();
   485	        let x = self.p.x;
   486	        let z = self.p.z;
   487	        let w = self.size.x;
   488	        let d = self.size.z;
   489	        let mut add = |dx, y, dz, sx, sy, sz, color, mat| {
   490	            out.push((
   491	                Vec3::new(x + dx, y, z + dz),
   492	                Vec3::new(sx, sy, sz),
   493	                color,
   494	                mat,
   495	            ))
   496	        };
   497	        if self.name == "Weapons" {
   498	            for kind in 0..3 {
   499	                add(
   500	                    -6. + kind as f32 * 5.,
   501	                    0.55,
   502	                    5.,
   503	                    3.,
   504	                    1.1,
   505	                    1.2,
   506	                    [0.2, 0.24, 0.3],
   507	                    4,
   508	                );
   509	            }
   510	        } else if matches!(self.name, "Grocery" | "Gas Station") {
   511	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   512	                for i in 0..3 {
   513	                    let xx = side * w * 0.32;
   514	                    let zz = -d * 0.28 + i as f32 * d * 0.25;
   515	                    for dx in [-w * 0.09, w * 0.09] {
   516	                        for dz in [-0.92, 0.92] {
   517	                            add(xx + dx, 1.2, zz + dz, 0.08, 2.4, 0.08, [0.36, 0.4, 0.41], 4);
   518	                        }
   519	                    }
   520	                    for row in 0..3 {
   521	                        add(
   522	                            xx,
   523	                            0.8 + row as f32 * 0.6,
   524	                            zz,
   525	                            w * 0.2,
   526	                            0.1,
   527	                            2.,
   528	                            [0.7, 0.72, 0.67],
   529	                            4,
   530	                        );
   531	                    }
   532	                }
   533	            }
   534	        } else if self.name == "Cell Block" {
   535	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   536	                for i in 0..4 {
   537	                    let zz = -d / 2. + 5. + i as f32 * 10.;
   538	                    add(
   539	                        side * 9.,
   540	                        1.4,
   541	                        zz + 4.5,
   542	                        9.,
   543	                        2.8,
   544	                        0.3,
   545	                        [0.65, 0.67, 0.62],
   546	                        1,
   547	                    );
   548	                    // Split barred cell front around a two metre open doorway.
   549	                    for offset in [-3., 3.] {
   550	                        add(
   551	                            side * 4.5,
   552	                            1.4,
   553	                            zz + offset,
   554	                            0.2,
   555	                            2.8,
   556	                            4.,
   557	                            [0.28, 0.33, 0.36],
   558	                            4,
   559	                        );
   560	                    }
   561	                    add(
   562	                        side * 11.,
   563	                        0.4,
   564	                        zz - 1.,
   565	                        2.,
   566	                        0.8,
   567	                        3.5,
   568	                        [0.28, 0.42, 0.58],
   569	                        10,
   570	                    );
   571	                    add(side * 11., 0.9, zz - 3., 1., 1.8, 0.6, [0.6, 0.62, 0.57], 4);
   572	                }
   573	            }
   574	        } else if matches!(
   575	            self.name,
   576	            "Police"
   577	                | "West Police"
   578	                | "North Police"
   579	                | "Industrial Police"
   580	                | "Prison Police"
   581	                | "Visitors"
   582	                | "Infirmary"
   583	                | "Canteen"
   584	                | "Grocery"
   585	                | "Donut Shop"
   586	        ) {
   587	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   588	                for i in 0..3 {
   589	                    let zz = -d * 0.28 + i as f32 * d * 0.25;
   590	                    let color = if self.name == "Infirmary" {
   591	                        [0.82, 0.85, 0.84]
   592	                    } else {
   593	                        [0.37, 0.48, 0.58]
   594	                    };
   595	                    add(side * w * 0.32, 0.55, zz, w * 0.2, 1.1, 2., color, 10);
   596	                    if self.name.contains("Police") {
   597	                        add(
   598	                            side * (w / 2. - 1.2),
   599	                            1.25,
   600	                            zz,
   601	                            1.,
   602	                            2.5,
   603	                            1.4,
   604	                            [0.24, 0.31, 0.4],
   605	                            4,
   606	                        );
   607	                    }
   608	                }
   609	            }
   610	        } else {
   611	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   612	                if self.name == "Casino" && side > 0. {
   613	                    continue;
   614	                }
   615	                add(
   616	                    side * w * 0.32,
   617	                    1.,
   618	                    d * 0.15,
   619	                    w * 0.22,
   620	                    2.,
   621	                    1.5,
   622	                    [0.43, 0.3, 0.22],
   623	                    10,
   624	                );
   625	            }
   626	        }
   627	        out
   628	    }
   629	    pub fn interior_mesh(&self) -> Mesh {
   630	        let mut m = self.local_interior_mesh();
   631	        for v in &mut m.vertices {
   632	            v.position[1] += self.p.y;
   633	        }
   634	        m
   635	    }
   636	    pub fn rendered_floor(&self, p: Vec3) -> usize {
   637	        if matches!(self.name, "Office" | "Westhaven") {
   638	            (((self.support(p) - self.p.y) / 4.).round() as usize)
   639	                .min((self.size.y / 4.) as usize - 1)
   640	        } else {
   641	            0
   642	        }
   643	    }
   644	    pub fn interior_mesh_at(&self, floor: usize) -> Mesh {
   645	        if !matches!(self.name, "Office" | "Westhaven") {
   646	            return self.interior_mesh();
   647	        }
   648	        let mut m = Mesh::default();
   649	        self.expansion_interior(&mut m, Some(floor));
   650	        let floor = floor.min((self.size.y / 4.) as usize - 1);
   651	        m.cuboid(
   652	            [
   653	                self.p.x,
   654	                (floor as f32 * 4. + 4.).min(self.size.y),
   655	                self.p.z,
   656	            ],
   657	            [self.size.x, 0.12, self.size.z],
   658	            [0.72, 0.72, 0.68],
   659	            1,
   660	            0.,
   661	        );
   662	        for v in &mut m.vertices {
   663	            v.position[1] += self.p.y;
   664	        }
   665	        m
   666	    }
   667	    fn local_interior_mesh(&self) -> Mesh {
   668	        let mut m = Mesh::default();
   669	        let x = self.p.x;
   670	        let z = self.p.z;
   671	        let w = self.size.x;
   672	        let d = self.size.z;
   673	        for (p, size, color, material) in self.fittings() {
   674	            if self.name == "Cell Block" && size.x == 0.2 {
   675	                for i in 0..9 {
   676	                    m.cuboid(
   677	                        [p.x, p.y, p.z - size.z / 2. + i as f32 * 0.5],
   678	                        [0.12, size.y, 0.12],
   679	                        color,
   680	                        material,
   681	                        0.,
   682	                    );
   683	                }
   684	                for y in [0.15, 2.75] {
   685	                    m.cuboid([p.x, y, p.z], [0.18, 0.15, size.z], color, material, 0.);
   686	                }
   687	            } else {
   688	                m.cuboid(
   689	                    [p.x, p.y, p.z],
   690	                    [size.x, size.y, size.z],
   691	                    color,
   692	                    material,
   693	                    0.,
   694	                );
   695	            }
   696	        }
   697	        if self.name == "Cell Block" {
   698	            self.prison_details_0(&mut m);
   699	        }
   700	        for i in 0..3 {
   701	            m.cuboid(
   702	                [x, 4., z - d * 0.3 + i as f32 * d * 0.3],
   703	                [2., 0.08, 0.8],
   704	                [1., 0.9, 0.65],
   705	                9,
   706	                1.,
   707	            );
   708	        }
   709	        // Detailed fittings stay local to this building's elevation.
   710	        m.cuboid(
   711	            [x, 0.025, z],
   712	            [w - 0.8, 0.05, d - 0.8],
   713	            [0.72, 0.71, 0.65],
   714	            3,
   715	            0.,
   716	        );
   717	        if matches!(self.name, "Grocery" | "Donut Shop" | "Weapons" | "Bank") {
   718	            self.grocery_details_1(&mut m);
   719	        }
   720	        if matches!(self.name, "Grocery" | "Gas Station") {
   721	            self.grocery_details_2(&mut m);
   722	        }
   723	        if self.name == "Donut Shop" {
   724	            self.donut_shop_details_3(&mut m);
   725	        }
   726	        if self.name == "Garage" || self.name == "Desert Garage" {
   727	            self.garage_details_4(&mut m);
   728	        }
   729	        if self.name == "Criminal Base" || self.name == "Safehouse" {
   730	            self.criminal_base_details_5(&mut m);
   731	        }
   732	        if self.name == "Gym" {
   733	            self.gym_details_6(&mut m);
   734	        }
   735	        if matches!(self.name, "Apartments" | "Penthouse" | "Safehouse") {
   736	            self.housing_details_7(&mut m);
   737	        }
   738	        if self.name == "Factory" {
   739	            self.factory_details_8(&mut m);
   740	        }
   741	        if self.name == "Weapons" {
   742	            self.weapons_details_9(&mut m);
   743	        }
   744	        if self.name == "Casino" {
   745	            self.casino_details_10(&mut m);
   746	        }
   747	        if matches!(self.name, "Grocery" | "Gas Station") {
   748	            self.grocery_details_11(&mut m);
   749	        }
   750	        if self.name == "Donut Shop" {
   751	            self.donut_shop_details_12(&mut m);

   765	    pub fn roof_mesh(&self) -> Mesh {
   766	        let mut m = Mesh::default();
   767	        m.cuboid(
   768	            [self.p.x, self.p.y + self.size.y, self.p.z],
   769	            [self.size.x, 0.4, self.size.z],
   770	            [0.48, 0.51, 0.54],
   771	            4,
   772	            0.,
   773	        );
   774	        m.cuboid(
   775	            [self.p.x, self.p.y + self.size.y - 0.25, self.p.z],
   776	            [self.size.x, 0.1, self.size.z],
   777	            [0.81, 0.82, 0.77],
   778	            1,
   779	            0.2,
   780	        );
   781	        m
   782	    }

   811	    fn sign(&self, m: &mut Mesh) {

   813	            return;
   814	        }
   815	        let x = self.p.x;
   816	        let z = self.p.z - self.size.z / 2. - 0.12;
   817	        let y = 5.;
   818	        let c = [0.15, 0.85, 1.];

   822	                    [

   826	                        [x, y - 2., z],
   827	                    ],
   828	                    c,
   829	                    9,
   830	                    0.8,
   831	                );
   832	            }
   833	            "Weapons" => {
   834	                m.cuboid([x, y, z], [4., 0.7, 0.08], c, 9, 0.8);
   835	                m.cuboid([x - 1., y - 1., z], [0.7, 1.4, 0.08], c, 9, 0.8);
   836	            }
   837	            "Donut Shop" => {}
   838	            "Bank" | "Casino" => {

   843	                );
   844	            }
   845	            "Garage" | "Desert Garage" => {

   878	                }
   879	            }
   880	            "Power Plant" | "Substation" => {

   883	                    m.triangle(

   900	            }

   947	fn museum_sphere(m: &mut Mesh, p: [f32; 3], radius: f32, c: [f32; 3]) {
   948	    for i in 0..12 {
   949	        for j in 0..6 {
   950	            let point = |u: f32, v: f32| {
   951	                let a = u / 12. * std::f32::consts::TAU;
   952	                let b = v / 6. * std::f32::consts::PI;
   953	                [
   954	                    p[0] + radius * a.cos() * b.sin(),
   955	                    p[1] + radius * b.cos(),
   956	                    p[2] + radius * a.sin() * b.sin(),
   957	                ]
   958	            };
   959	            m.quad(
   960	                [
   961	                    point(i as f32, j as f32),
   962	                    point((i + 1) as f32, j as f32),
   963	                    point((i + 1) as f32, (j + 1) as f32),
   964	                    point(i as f32, (j + 1) as f32),
   965	                ],
   966	                c,
   967	                1,
   968	                0.,
   969	            );
   970	        }
   971	    }
   972	}
   973	
   974	fn museum_bone(m: &mut Mesh, a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3], radius: f32, color: [f32; 3]) {
   975	    let d = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]];
   976	    let len = (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]).sqrt().max(0.001);
   977	    let d = d.map(|x| x / len);
   978	    let raw = if d[0].abs() + d[1].abs() > 0.01 {
   979	        [d[1], -d[0], 0.]
   980	    } else {
   981	        [1., 0., 0.]
   982	    };
   983	    let len = (raw[0] * raw[0] + raw[1] * raw[1] + raw[2] * raw[2]).sqrt();
   984	    let n = raw.map(|x| x / len);
   985	    let t = [
   986	        d[1] * n[2] - d[2] * n[1],
   987	        d[2] * n[0] - d[0] * n[2],
   988	        d[0] * n[1] - d[1] * n[0],
   989	    ];
   990	    for i in 0..8 {
   991	        let point = |p: [f32; 3], j: usize| {
   992	            let f = j as f32 / 8. * std::f32::consts::TAU;
   993	            [
   994	                p[0] + radius * (n[0] * f.cos() + t[0] * f.sin()),
   995	                p[1] + radius * (n[1] * f.cos() + t[1] * f.sin()),
   996	                p[2] + radius * (n[2] * f.cos() + t[2] * f.sin()),
   997	            ]
   998	        };
   999	        m.quad(
  1000	            [point(a, i), point(b, i), point(b, i + 1), point(a, i + 1)],
  1001	            color,
  1002	            1,
  1003	            0.,
  1004	        );
  1005	    }
  1006	}
  1007	fn museum_gem(m: &mut Mesh, p: [f32; 3], r: f32) {
  1008	    for i in 0..4 {
  1009	        let a = i as f32 * std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
  1010	        let b = (i + 1) as f32 * std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
  1011	        let q = [p[0] + r * a.cos(), p[1], p[2] + r * a.sin()];
  1012	        let w = [p[0] + r * b.cos(), p[1], p[2] + r * b.sin()];
  1013	        m.triangle([[p[0], p[1] + r, p[2]], q, w], [0.05, 0.85, 1.], 3, 0.4);
  1014	        m.triangle([[p[0], p[1] - r, p[2]], w, q], [0.1, 0.6, 0.95], 3, 0.2);
  1015	    }
  1016	}

    12	        Self {
    13	            pos: Vec3::new(x, 1., z),
    14	            health: 100.,
    15	            respawn: 0.,
    16	            heading: 0.,
    17	            animation: 0.,
    18	            home: Vec3::new(x, 1., z),
    19	        }
    20	    }
    21	    pub fn active(&self) -> bool {
    22	        self.respawn <= 0.
    23	    }
    24	    pub fn arrest(&mut self) -> bool {
    25	        if !self.active() {
    26	            return false;
    27	        }
    28	        self.respawn = 60.;
    29	        self.health = 100.;
    30	        true
    31	    }
    32	    pub fn tick(&mut self, dt: f32) {
    33	        self.respawn = (self.respawn - dt).max(0.);
    34	    }
    35	}

     1	pub fn purchase(balance: &mut u32, owned: &mut Vec<usize>, kind: usize, price: u32) -> bool {
     2	    if owned.contains(&kind) {
     3	        return true;
     4	    }
     5	    if *balance < price {
     6	        return false;
     7	    }
     8	    *balance -= price;
     9	    owned.push(kind);
    10	    true
    11	}
    12	#[cfg(test)]
    13	mod tests {
    14	    use super::*;
    15	    #[test]
    16	    fn cannot_overspend() {
    17	        let mut b = 0;
    18	        let mut v = vec![0, 1];
    19	        assert!(!purchase(&mut b, &mut v, 3, 2500));
    20	        assert_eq!(b, 0);
    21	    }
    22	}

     1	use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
     2	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
     3	pub struct Vec3 {
     4	    pub x: f32,
     5	    pub y: f32,
     6	    pub z: f32,
     7	}
     8	impl Vec3 {
     9	    pub fn new(x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) -> Self {
    10	        Self { x, y, z }
    11	    }
    12	    pub fn distance(self, b: Self) -> f32 {
    13	        ((self.x - b.x).powi(2) + (self.z - b.z).powi(2)).sqrt()
    14	    }
    15	}
    16	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    17	pub enum Team {
    18	    Prisoner,
    19	    Criminal,
    20	    Police,
    21	}
    22	pub const STEP: f32 = 1.0 / 60.0;
    23	
    24	#[repr(C)]
    25	#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
    26	pub struct Vertex {
    27	    pub position: [f32; 3],
    28	    pub color: [f32; 4],
    29	    pub uv: [f32; 2],
    30	}
    31	#[derive(Default)]
    32	pub struct Mesh {
    33	    pub vertices: Vec<Vertex>,
    34	}
    35	impl Mesh {
    36	    /// Price labels built into the static shop mesh, readable in the world.
    37	    pub fn price(&mut self, p: [f32; 3], scale: f32, value: u32) {
    38	        let digits = [
    39	            [14, 17, 19, 21, 25, 17, 14],
    40	            [4, 12, 4, 4, 4, 4, 14],
    41	            [14, 17, 1, 2, 4, 8, 31],
    42	            [30, 1, 1, 14, 1, 1, 30],
    43	            [2, 6, 10, 18, 31, 2, 2],
    44	            [31, 16, 16, 30, 1, 1, 30],
    45	            [14, 16, 16, 30, 17, 17, 14],
    46	            [31, 1, 2, 4, 8, 8, 8],
    47	            [14, 17, 17, 14, 17, 17, 14],
    48	            [14, 17, 17, 15, 1, 1, 14],
    49	        ];
    50	        for (i, ch) in format!("${value}").chars().enumerate() {
    51	            let rows = if ch == '$' {
    52	                [4, 15, 20, 14, 5, 30, 4]
    53	            } else {
    54	                digits[ch.to_digit(10).unwrap() as usize]
    55	            };
    56	            for (y, row) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
    57	                for x in 0..5 {
    58	                    if row & (1 << (4 - x)) != 0 {
    59	                        self.cuboid(
    60	                            [
    61	                                p[0] + format!("${value}").len() as f32 * 6. * scale
    62	                                    - (i * 6 + x) as f32 * scale,
    63	                                p[1] - y as f32 * scale,
    64	                                p[2],
    65	                            ],
    66	                            [scale, scale, 0.006],
    67	                            [0.1, 0.12, 0.1],
    68	                            9,
    69	                            0.25,
    70	                        );
    71	                    }
    72	                }
    73	            }
    74	        }
    75	    }
    76	    pub fn triangle(&mut self, p: [[f32; 3]; 3], c: [f32; 3], material: u8, emission: f32) {
    77	        let tx = (material % 4) as f32 / 4.;
    78	        let ty = (material / 4) as f32 / 4.;
    79	        for (i, position) in p.into_iter().enumerate() {
    80	            self.vertices.push(Vertex {
    81	                position,
    82	                color: [c[0], c[1], c[2], emission],
    83	                uv: [
    84	                    tx + if i == 1 { 0.245 } else { 0.005 },
    85	                    ty + if i == 2 { 0.245 } else { 0.005 },
    86	                ],
    87	            });
    88	        }
    89	    }
    90	    pub fn quad(&mut self, p: [[f32; 3]; 4], c: [f32; 3], mat: u8, e: f32) {
    91	        let tx = (mat % 4) as f32 / 4.;
    92	        let ty = (mat / 4) as f32 / 4.;
    93	        for i in [0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3] {
    94	            let uv = match i {
    95	                0 => [0.005, 0.005],
    96	                1 => [0.245, 0.005],
    97	                2 => [0.245, 0.245],
    98	                _ => [0.005, 0.245],
    99	            };
   100	            self.vertices.push(Vertex {
   101	                position: p[i],
   102	                color: [c[0], c[1], c[2], e],
   103	                uv: [tx + uv[0], ty + uv[1]],
   104	            });
   105	        }
   106	    }
   107	    pub fn cuboid(&mut self, p: [f32; 3], s: [f32; 3], c: [f32; 3], mat: u8, e: f32) {
   108	        let [x, y, z] = p;
   109	        let [a, b, d] = s.map(|v| v / 2.);
   110	        let v = [
   111	            [x - a, y - b, z - d],
   112	            [x + a, y - b, z - d],
   113	            [x + a, y + b, z - d],
   114	            [x - a, y + b, z - d],
   115	            [x - a, y - b, z + d],
   116	            [x + a, y - b, z + d],
   117	            [x + a, y + b, z + d],
   118	            [x - a, y + b, z + d],
   119	        ];
   120	        for (f, k) in [
   121	            ([0, 1, 2, 3], 0.72),
   122	            ([5, 4, 7, 6], 0.84),
   123	            ([4, 0, 3, 7], 0.76),
   124	            ([1, 5, 6, 2], 0.9),
   125	            ([3, 2, 6, 7], 1.),
   126	            ([4, 5, 1, 0], 0.6),
   127	        ] {
   128	            self.quad(f.map(|i| v[i]), c.map(|v| v * k), mat, e);
   129	        }
   130	    }
   131	    pub fn torus(&mut self, p: [f32; 3], radii: [f32; 2], color: [f32; 3], n: usize) {
   132	        let n = n.clamp(8, 24);
   133	        for i in 0..n {
   134	            for j in 0..6 {
   135	                let v = |ii: usize, jj: usize| {
   136	                    let a = std::f32::consts::TAU * ii as f32 / n as f32;
   137	                    let b = std::f32::consts::TAU * jj as f32 / 6.;
   138	                    let radius = radii[0] + radii[1] * b.cos();
   139	                    [
   140	                        p[0] + radius * a.cos(),
   141	                        p[1] + radius * a.sin(),
   142	                        p[2] + radii[1] * b.sin(),
   143	                    ]
   144	                };
   145	                self.quad(
   146	                    [v(i, j), v(i + 1, j), v(i + 1, j + 1), v(i, j + 1)],
   147	                    color,
   148	                    1,
   149	                    0.,
   150	                );
   151	            }
   152	        }
   153	    }
   154	    pub fn cylinder(&mut self, p: [f32; 3], radius: f32, h: f32, c: [f32; 3], mat: u8, n: usize) {
   155	        for i in 0..n {
   156	            let a = i as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU / n as f32;
   157	            let b = (i + 1) as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU / n as f32;
   158	            let pa = [p[0] + a.cos() * radius, p[1], p[2] + a.sin() * radius];
   159	            let pb = [p[0] + b.cos() * radius, p[1], p[2] + b.sin() * radius];
   160	            self.quad(
   161	                [pa, pb, [pb[0], p[1] + h, pb[2]], [pa[0], p[1] + h, pa[2]]],
   162	                c.map(|v| v * (0.8 + 0.15 * a.cos())),
   163	                mat,
   164	                0.,
   165	            );
   166	            self.triangle(
   167	                [
   168	                    [p[0], p[1] + h, p[2]],
   169	                    [pa[0], p[1] + h, pa[2]],
   170	                    [pb[0], p[1] + h, pb[2]],
   171	                ],
   172	                c,
   173	                mat,
   174	                0.,
   175	            );
   176	        }
   177	    }
   178	    pub fn roof(&mut self, position: [f32; 3], size: [f32; 3], c: [f32; 3]) {
   179	        let [x, y, z] = position;
   180	        let [w, rise, d] = size;
   181	        self.quad(
   182	            [
   183	                [x - w / 2., y, z - d / 2.],
   184	                [x + w / 2., y, z - d / 2.],
   185	                [x + w / 2., y + rise, z],
   186	                [x - w / 2., y + rise, z],
   187	            ],
   188	            c,
   189	            11,
   190	            0.,
   191	        );
   192	        self.quad(
   193	            [
   194	                [x - w / 2., y + rise, z],
   195	                [x + w / 2., y + rise, z],
   196	                [x + w / 2., y, z + d / 2.],
   197	                [x - w / 2., y, z + d / 2.],
   198	            ],
   199	            c.map(|v| v * 0.8),
   200	            11,
   201	            0.,
   202	        );
   203	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
   204	            self.triangle(
   205	                [
   206	                    [x + side * w / 2., y, z - d / 2.],
   207	                    [x + side * w / 2., y, z + d / 2.],
   208	                    [x + side * w / 2., y + rise, z],
   209	                ],
   210	                c,
   211	                11,
   212	                0.,
   213	            );
   214	        }
   215	    }
   216	}

     1	use buildings::Building;
     2	use engine_core::Vec3;
     3	pub struct Door {
     4	    pub open: bool,
     5	    pub angle: f32,
     6	}
     7	impl Door {
     8	    pub fn new() -> Self {
     9	        Self {
    10	            open: false,
    11	            angle: 0.,
    12	        }
    13	    }
    14	    pub fn tick(&mut self, dt: f32) {
    15	        let target = if self.open {
    16	            std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2
    17	        } else {
    18	            0.
    19	        };
    20	        let d = (target - self.angle).clamp(-dt * 2.8, dt * 2.8);
    21	        self.angle += d;
    22	    }
    23	    pub fn blocked(&self, b: &Building, p: Vec3, r: f32) -> bool {
    24	        if !b.interior
    25	            || p.y < b.p.y - 0.5
    26	            || p.y > b.p.y + 4.5
    27	            || p.distance(b.p) > b.size.x.max(b.size.z)
    28	        {
    29	            return false;
    30	        }
    31	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
    32	            let a = self.angle * side;
    33	            let hinge = Vec3::new(b.p.x + side * 1.5, b.p.y + 1.5, b.p.z - b.size.z / 2.);
    34	            let cx = hinge.x - side * 0.75 * a.cos();
    35	            let cz = hinge.z + side * 0.75 * a.sin();
    36	            let dx = p.x - cx;
    37	            let dz = p.z - cz;
    38	            if (dx * a.cos() - dz * a.sin()).abs() < 0.75 + r
    39	                && (dx * a.sin() + dz * a.cos()).abs() < 0.15 + r
    40	            {
    41	                return true;
    42	            }
    43	        }
    44	        false
    45	    }
    46	}
    47	#[cfg(test)]
    48	mod tests {
    49	    use super::*;
    50	    use buildings::Style;
    51	    #[test]
    52	    fn door_blocks_when_closed_and_clears_center_when_open() {
    53	        let b = Building {
    54	            id: 0,
    55	            name: "test",
    56	            p: Vec3::default(),
    57	            size: Vec3::new(20., 5., 20.),
    58	            style: Style::Civic,
    59	            interior: true,
    60	        };
    61	        let p = Vec3::new(0., 1., -10.);
    62	        let mut d = Door::new();
    63	        assert!(d.blocked(&b, p, 0.45));
    64	        d.open = true;
    65	        d.tick(1.);
    66	        assert!(!d.blocked(&b, p, 0.45));
    67	    }
    68	}

     1	#[derive(Default)]
     2	pub struct Cuffs {
     3	    pub active: bool,
     4	    pub remaining: f32,
     5	    pub required: u32,
     6	    pub success: u32,
     7	    pub marker: f32,
     8	    pub target: f32,
     9	    direction: f32,
    10	    random: u64,
    11	}
    12	impl Cuffs {
    13	    pub fn start(&mut self, stars: u32, seed: &mut u64) {
    14	        *seed = seed.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1);
    15	        *self = Self {
    16	            active: true,
    17	            remaining: 5.,
    18	            required: stars.clamp(1, 5),
    19	            success: 0,
    20	            marker: 0.,
    21	            target: 0.,
    22	            direction: 1.,
    23	            random: *seed,
    24	        };
    25	        self.next();
    26	    }
    27	    pub fn width(&self) -> f32 {
    28	        0.24 - (self.success as f32) * 0.018
    29	    }
    30	    fn next(&mut self) {
    31	        self.random = self
    32	            .random
    33	            .wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005)
    34	            .wrapping_add(1);
    35	        self.target = 0.05 + (self.random >> 32) as f32 / u32::MAX as f32 * (0.9 - self.width());
    36	    }
    37	    pub fn tick(&mut self, dt: f32) -> bool {
    38	        if !self.active {
    39	            return false;
    40	        }
    41	        self.remaining = (self.remaining - dt).max(0.);
    42	        self.marker += self.direction * dt * (0.65 + self.success as f32 * 0.16);
    43	        if self.marker >= 1. {
    44	            self.marker = 2. - self.marker;
    45	            self.direction = -1.;
    46	        }
    47	        if self.marker <= 0. {
    48	            self.marker = -self.marker;
    49	            self.direction = 1.;
    50	        }
    51	        self.remaining <= 0.
    52	    }
    53	    pub fn hit(&mut self) -> bool {
    54	        if !self.active || self.remaining <= 0. {
    55	            return false;
    56	        }
    57	        if (self.target..=self.target + self.width()).contains(&self.marker) {
    58	            self.success += 1;
    59	            if self.success >= self.required {
    60	                self.active = false;
    61	                return true;
    62	            }
    63	            self.next();
    64	        }
    65	        false
    66	    }
    67	}
    68	#[cfg(test)]
    69	mod tests {
    70	    use super::*;
    71	    #[test]
    72	    fn every_star_requires_exact_hits() {
    73	        for n in 1..=5 {
    74	            let mut c = Cuffs::default();
    75	            c.start(n, &mut 42);
    76	            for hit in 1..=n {
    77	                c.marker = c.target + c.width() / 2.;
    78	                assert_eq!(c.hit(), hit == n);
    79	            }
    80	            assert!(!c.active);
    81	        }
    82	    }
    83	    #[test]
    84	    fn misses_and_timeout() {
    85	        let mut c = Cuffs::default();
    86	        c.start(3, &mut 5);
    87	        c.marker = 0.;
    88	        assert!(!c.hit());
    89	        assert_eq!(c.success, 0);
    90	        assert!(c.tick(5.));
    91	        assert!(!c.hit());
    92	    }
    93	}

   157	    fn special_strike(&mut self) -> bool {

   183	    fn tick_heists(&mut self) {
   184	        self.heists.tick(STEP);
   185	        if let Some(w) = self.heists.riding {
   186	            let (p, _) = crate::heists::Heists::train(self.clock, w);
   187	            self.player.pos = Vec3::new(p.x, p.y + 2.8, p.z);
   188	            self.player.vy = 0.;

   191	            return;
   192	        };
   193	        let spec = crate::heists::SITES[id];

   195	            300. - self.wanted.min(5) as f32 * 40.
   196	        } else {
   197	            spec.delay / (1. + self.wanted.saturating_sub(1) as f32 * 0.12)
   198	        };
   199	        if self.heists.elapsed >= deadline && !self.heists.dispatched {
   200	            self.heists.dispatched = true;
   201	            let p = self.player.pos;
   202	            let center = self
   203	                .world
   204	                .interior(p)
   205	                .map(|i| self.world.buildings[i].entrance())
   206	                .unwrap_or(p);
   207	            for j in 0..6 {
   208	                let q = Vec3::new(center.x - 6. + j as f32 * 2.4, center.y, center.z - 4.);
   209	                let mut n = Npc::new(if j > 3 { Role::Swat } else { Role::Police }, q.x, q.z);
   210	                n.pos.y = self.world.walking_surface(q) + 1.;
   211	                n.home = n.pos;
   212	                self.npcs.push(n);
   213	            }
   214	            self.notify("POLICE PERIMETER - EXITS BLOCKED");
   215	        }
   216	        let p = self.player.pos;
   217	        let near = if id == 5 {
   218	            self.heists.riding.is_some()
   219	        } else {
   220	            (p.x - spec.x).abs() < 12. && (p.z - spec.z).abs() < 10.
   221	        };
   222	        let floor = self
   223	            .world
   224	            .buildings
   225	            .iter()
   226	            .find(|b| b.name == spec.name)
   227	            .map(|b| b.p.y)
   228	            .unwrap_or(0.);
   229	        let ready = match id {
   230	            0 => self.heists.strikes >= 3 && p.y > floor + 4.5 && p.y < floor + 7.5,
   231	            1 => true,
   232	            3 => self.heists.solved >= 5 && p.y < floor + 3.,
   233	            4 => self.heists.strikes >= 3,
   234	            5 => self.heists.opened,
   235	            _ => self.heists.solved >= spec.questions,
   236	        };
   237	        if self.holding && near && ready && !self.heists.quiz && self.heists.bag == 0 {
   238	            self.heists.progress += STEP;
   239	            if self.heists.progress >= 8. {

   241	                self.notify("BAG FULL - SOLVE EXIT IF NEEDED; DELIVER TO CRIMINAL BASE");
   242	            }
   243	        }
   244	        if id == 4
   245	            && self.heists.bag > 0
   246	            && !self.heists.dispatched
   247	            && p.distance(Vec3::new(spec.x, floor + 1., spec.z)) > 40.
   248	        {
   249	            let cash = self.heists.bag;
   250	            self.save.balance += cash;
   251	            self.heists.bag = 0;
   252	            self.heists.finish();
   253	            self.wanted = 0;
   254	            self.notify(&format!("ESCAPED GAS STATION WITH ${cash}"));
   255	        }
   256	        // Laser grids share exact visual and damage coordinates. Crouch or jump across beams.
   257	        if matches!(id, 0 | 3) && near && !self.heists.quiz {
   258	            let local = (p.z - spec.z + 8.).rem_euclid(4.);
   259	            if !(0.35..=3.65).contains(&local)
   260	                && self.stance == 0
   261	                && (p.y - floor - 1.).abs() < 0.25
   262	            {
   263	                self.player.health = (self.player.health - 20. * STEP).max(0.);
   264	            }
   265	        }
   266	    }
   267	    fn draw_heists(&self, r: &mut Renderer) {
   268	        if self.heists.progress > 0.2 || self.heists.bag > 0 {
   269	            let p = self.player.pos;

   303	                }
   304	            }
   305	        }
   306	        let quality=crate::quality::PRESETS[self.save.quality];
   307	        let eye=self.camera.unwrap_or([self.player.pos.x,self.player.pos.y,self.player.pos.z]);
   308	        let aspect=r.width as f32/r.height as f32;
   309	        let visible=|p:Vec3| crate::world_view::sphere_visible([p.x,p.y+1.,p.z],7.,eye,self.yaw,self.pitch,aspect,quality.distance);
   310	        for wagon in 0..25 {
   311	            let (p, a) = crate::heists::Heists::train(self.clock, wagon);
   312	            if p.distance(self.player.pos) > quality.distance || !visible(p) {
   313	                continue;
   314	            }
   315	            if p.distance(self.player.pos)>quality.detail {
   316	                r.cube([p.x,p.y,p.z],[3.5,1.4,8.5],[0.12,0.16,0.2],a);
   317	                r.cube([p.x,p.y+1.8,p.z],[3.2,2.3,7.8],if self.heists.gold(wagon){[0.5,0.4,0.17]}else{[0.18,0.35,0.45]},a);
   318	                continue;
   319	            }
   320	            r.rounded(
   321	                [p.x, p.y, p.z],
   322	                [3.5, 1.4, 8.5],
   323	                [0.12, 0.16, 0.2],
   324	                a,
   325	                8,
   326	                0.35,
   327	            );
   328	            let gold = self.heists.gold(wagon);
   329	            if self.heists.site == Some(5)
   330	                && self.heists.riding == Some(wagon)
   331	                && self.heists.opened
   332	            {
   333	                r.cube([p.x, p.y + 0.8, p.z], [3.2, 0.3, 7.8], [0.25, 0.3, 0.33], a);
   334	                r.rounded(
   335	                    [p.x, p.y + 1.6, p.z],
   336	                    [1.7, 1.4, 2.2],
   337	                    [0.3, 0.35, 0.38],
   338	                    a,
   339	                    8,
   340	                    0.3,
   341	                );
   342	            } else {
   343	                r.cube(
   344	                    [p.x, p.y + 1.8, p.z],
   345	                    [3.2, 2.3, 7.8],
   346	                    if gold {
   347	                        [0.5, 0.4, 0.17]
   348	                    } else {
   349	                        [0.18, 0.35, 0.45]
   350	                    },
   351	                    a,
   352	                );
   353	            }
   354	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   355	                for end in [-1., 1.] {
   356	                    r.rounded(
   357	                        [
   358	                            p.x + a.cos() * side * 1.8 + a.sin() * end * 2.6,
   359	                            p.y - 0.4,
   360	                            p.z - a.sin() * side * 1.8 + a.cos() * end * 2.6,
   361	                        ],
   362	                        [0.4, 1., 1.],
   363	                        [0.08, 0.09, 0.1],
   364	                        a,
   365	                        8,
   366	                        0.35,
   367	                    );
   368	                }
   369	            }
   370	            if gold {
   371	                r.cube([p.x, p.y + 3., p.z], [1.5, 0.3, 2.], [0.95, 0.75, 0.18], a);
   372	            }
   373	        }
   374	        let (p, a) = crate::heists::Heists::train(self.clock, 0);
   375	        let q = Vec3::new(p.x + a.sin() * 10., p.y, p.z + a.cos() * 10.);
   376	        if q.distance(self.player.pos) < quality.distance && visible(q) {
   377	            r.rounded(
   378	                [q.x, q.y + 1.4, q.z],
   379	                [4., 3.8, 9.],
   380	                [0.75, 0.3, 0.12],
   381	                a,
   382	                8,
   383	                0.35,
   384	            );
   385	        }
   386	        for id in [0, 3] {
   387	            let s = crate::heists::SITES[id];
   388	            let floor = self.world.surface(s.x, s.z);
   389	            if self.player.pos.distance(Vec3::new(s.x, floor + 1., s.z)) > 80. {
   390	                continue;
   391	            }
   392	            for i in 0..5 {
   393	                r.cube(
   394	                    [s.x, floor + 0.8, s.z - 8. + i as f32 * 4.],
   395	                    [22., 0.06, 0.06],
   396	                    [1., 0.12, 0.03],
   397	                    0.,
   398	                );
   399	            }
   400	        }
   401	        for (p, taken) in &self.drops {
   402	            if !taken && p.distance(self.player.pos) < 70. {
   403	                r.cube(
   404	                    [p.x, p.y - 0.6, p.z],
   405	                    [0.6, 0.25, 0.4],
   406	                    [0.4, 0.5, 0.22],
   407	                    0.,
   408	                );
   409	            }
   410	        }
   411	        if self.parachute
   412	            && self.player.pos.y > self.world.surface(self.player.pos.x, self.player.pos.z) + 3.
   413	        {
   414	            let p = self.player.pos;
   415	            r.rounded(
   416	                [p.x, p.y + 4., p.z],
   417	                [7., 1.2, 4.],
   418	                [0.9, 0.4, 0.1],
   419	                self.player.heading,
   420	                8,
   421	                0.7,
   422	            );
   423	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   424	                r.cube(
   425	                    [p.x + side * 1.3, p.y + 2., p.z],
   426	                    [0.03, 4., 0.03],
   427	                    WHITE,
   428	                    0.,
   429	                );
   430	            }
   431	        }
   432	        if self.player.pos.distance(Vec3::new(320., 1., 35.)) < 70. {
   433	            for z in [20., 24., 28.] {
   434	                r.cube([320., 0.8, z], [14., 0.06, 0.06], [1., 0.1, 0.05], 0.);
   435	            }
   436	        }
   437	        let y = self.world.surface(-290., 100.);
   438	        if self.player.pos.distance(Vec3::new(-290., y + 1., 100.)) < 70. {
   439	            draw_person(
   440	                r,
   441	                Vec3::new(-290., y + 1., 100.),
   442	                0.,
   443	                [0.15, 0.13, 0.15],
   444	                0.,
   445	                false,
   446	                0,
   447	                0.,
   448	                0.,
   449	                0.,
   450	                0,
   451	            );
   452	        }
   453	    }
   454	    fn draw_heist_ui(&self, r: &mut Renderer) {

   537	impl Game {
   538	    fn drop_c4(&mut self, id: usize) {
   539	        if self.npcs[id].health > 0. {
   540	            return;
   541	        }
   542	        if self.player.team != Team::Police {
   543	            self.wanted = (self.wanted + 1).min(5);
   544	            self.bounty += 150;
   545	        }
   546	        self.random = self
   547	            .random
   548	            .wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005)
   549	            .wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
   550	        if (self.random >> 32) % 100 < 30 {
   551	            self.drops.push((self.npcs[id].pos, false));
   552	        }
   553	        self.npcs[id].disabled = 45.;
   554	    }
   555	}

   567	impl Game {
   568	    fn set_engine(&mut self, target: u32) {
   569	        let Some(id) = self.workshop else {
   570	            return;
   571	        };
   572	        if target > 5 {
   573	            return;
   574	        }
   575	        let level = self.save.car_engine[self.cars[id].kind];
   576	        let cost = (level..target).map(|n| 150 + n * 100).sum::<u32>();
   577	        if self.save.balance < cost {
   578	            self.notify("NOT ENOUGH CASH FOR SELECTED ENGINE");
   579	            return;
   580	        }
   581	        self.save.balance -= cost;
   582	        self.cars[id].engine_level = target;
   583	        self.save.car_engine[self.cars[id].kind] = level.max(target);
   584	        self.save.car_engine_selected[self.cars[id].kind] = target;
   585	        self.notify("ENGINE CONFIGURED - ENTER TO SAVE PRESET");
   586	    }
   587	    fn draw_customs(&self, r: &mut Renderer) {
   588	        modal_title(r, "CUSTOMS - SELECT YOUR CONFIGURATION");
   589	        let id = self.workshop.unwrap();
   590	        let c = &self.cars[id];
   591	        text(
   592	            r,
   593	            210.,
   594	            195.,
   595	            2.,
   596	            &format!("{} / {} - {}", id + 1, CATALOG.len(), CATALOG[c.kind].name),
   597	            WHITE,
   598	        );
   599	        gui::button(r, [210., 224., 140., 35.], "< PREVIOUS", BLUE);
   600	        gui::button(r, [365., 224., 140., 35.], "NEXT >", BLUE);
   601	        text(r, 210., 278., 1.8, "SELECT ENGINE LEVEL (0-5)", GOLD);
   602	        for level in 0..=5 {
   603	            gui::button(
   604	                r,
   605	                [210. + level as f32 * 98., 302., 85., 40.],
   606	                &format!("LV {level}"),
   607	                if c.engine_level == level {
   608	                    ORANGE
   609	                } else {
   610	                    BLUE
   611	                },
   612	            );
   613	            let cost = (self.save.car_engine[c.kind]..level)
   614	                .map(|n| 150 + n * 100)
   615	                .sum::<u32>();
   616	            text(
   617	                r,
   618	                220. + level as f32 * 98.,
   619	                344.,
   620	                1.4,
   621	                &format!("${cost}"),
   622	                WHITE,
   623	            );
   624	        }
   625	        text(r, 210., 366., 1.8, "SPECIAL PAINT $25", WHITE);
   626	        for (i, color) in PAINTS.iter().enumerate() {
   627	            gui::button(
   628	                r,
   629	                [210. + i as f32 * 73., 383., 62., 38.],
   630	                &format!("{}", i + 1),
   631	                *color,
   632	            );
   633	        }
   634	        gui::button(
   635	            r,
   636	            [210., 439., 285., 35.],
   637	            "ENTER - SAVE PRESET",
   638	            [0.1, 0.6, 0.35],
   639	        );
   640	        gui::button(r, [515., 439., 285., 35.], "BACK TO SERVICE", INK);
   641	    }
   642	    fn customs_click(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool {
   643	        if self.workshop.is_none() {
   644	            return false;
   645	        }
   646	        if !self.workshop_config {
   647	            if gui::contains([530., 444., 280., 28.], x, y) {
   648	                self.workshop_config = true;
   649	                return true;
   650	            }
   651	            return false;
   652	        }
   653	        let id = self.workshop.unwrap();
   654	        if gui::contains([210., 224., 140., 35.], x, y) {
   655	            self.workshop = Some((id + CATALOG.len() - 1) % CATALOG.len());
   656	        }
   657	        if gui::contains([365., 224., 140., 35.], x, y) {
   658	            self.workshop = Some((id + 1) % CATALOG.len());
   659	        }
   660	        for level in 0..=5 {
   661	            if gui::contains([210. + level as f32 * 98., 302., 85., 40.], x, y) {
   662	                self.set_engine(level);
   663	            }
   664	        }
   665	        for (i, color) in PAINTS.iter().enumerate() {
   666	            if gui::contains([210. + i as f32 * 73., 383., 62., 38.], x, y) {
   667	                if self.save.balance >= 25 {
   668	                    self.save.balance -= 25;
   669	                    self.cars[id].color = *color;
   670	                    self.save.car_paint[self.cars[id].kind] = *color;
   671	                } else {
   672	                    self.notify("NOT ENOUGH CASH");
   673	                }
   674	            }
   675	        }
   676	        if gui::contains([210., 439., 285., 35.], x, y) {
   677	            self.save();
   678	        }
   679	        if gui::contains([515., 439., 285., 35.], x, y) {
   680	            self.workshop_config = false;
   681	        }
   682	        true
   683	    }
   684	}

   699	    #[test]
   700	    fn jewelry_has_storage_roof_and_collector_pays_once() {
   701	        let mut g = game();
   702	        g.player.pos = Vec3::new(254., 1., 190.);
   703	        assert!(g.special_interact());
   704	        assert_eq!(g.heists.site, Some(0));
   705	        for _ in 0..3 {
   706	            assert!(g.special_strike());
   707	        }
   708	        g.player.pos = Vec3::new(260., 1., 182.);
   709	        g.special_interact();
   710	        assert_eq!(g.player.pos.y, 5.);
   711	        g.special_interact();
   712	        assert_eq!(g.player.pos.y, 9.);
   713	        g.special_interact();
   714	        assert_eq!(g.player.pos.y, 13.);
   715	        assert_eq!(g.world.walking_surface(g.player.pos), 12.);
   716	        g.special_interact();
   717	        g.special_interact();
   718	        assert_eq!(g.player.pos.y, 5.);
   719	        g.player.pos.z = 190.;
   720	        g.holding = true;
   721	        for _ in 0..481 {
   722	            g.tick_heists();
   723	        }
   724	        assert!(g.heists.bag > 0);
   725	        assert_eq!(g.save.balance, 0);
   726	        g.player.pos = Vec3::new(-290., 1., 100.);
   727	        assert!(g.special_interact());
   728	        let paid = g.save.balance;
   729	        assert!(paid > 0);
   730	        g.special_interact();
   731	        assert_eq!(paid, g.save.balance);
   732	        assert!((300. ..=900.).contains(&g.heists.cooldown[0]));
   733	    }
   734	    #[test]

   772	        assert_eq!(g.save.balance, 1000);

   777	        assert_eq!(g.save.car_engine[0], 5);

   781	        assert_eq!(g.save.car_engine_selected[0], 5);

    52	    texture_applied: usize,
    53	    stamina: f32,
    54	    holding: bool,
    55	    punch_time: f32,
    56	    punch_done: bool,
    57	    movement: f32,
    58	    camera: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    59	    training_time: f32,

    67
