    77	impl Game {
    78	    fn new() -> Result<Self, String> {
    79	        Self::from_save(save_system::load()?)
    80	    }
    81	    fn from_save(mut save: save_system::Save) -> Result<Self, String> {
    82	        for i in 0..CATALOG.len() {
    83	            if save.car_engine_selected[i] == u32::MAX {
    84	                save.car_engine_selected[i] = save.car_engine[i];
    85	            }
    86	        }
    87	        save.weapon_owned[0] |= save.pistol_owned;
    88	        save.magazines[0] = save.ammo;
    89	        save.ammunition[0] = save.reserve;
    90	        let mut player = Player::new(save.team);
    91	        player.pos = save.position;
    92	        let pistol = weapons::Pistol {
    93	            ammo: if save.pistol_owned { save.ammo } else { 0 },
    94	            reserve: if save.pistol_owned { save.reserve } else { 0 },
    95	            ..Default::default()
    96	        };
    97	        let world = std::sync::Arc::new(World::new());
    98	        if !world::prison::underground(player.pos) {
    99	            player.pos.y = world.walking_surface(player.pos) + 1.;
   100	        }
   101	        let doors = world
   102	            .buildings
   103	            .iter()
   104	            .map(|_| crate::doors::Door::new())
   105	            .collect();
   106	        let mut cars = vec![
   107	            Car::new(0, Vec3::new(-95., 0.65, -76.)),
   108	            Car::new(1, Vec3::new(-74., 0.65, -76.)),
   109	            Car::new(2, Vec3::new(0., 0.65, -140.)),
   110	            Car::new(3, Vec3::new(750., 0.65, -430.)),
   111	            Car::new(4, Vec3::new(560., 0.65, 175.)),
   112	            Car::new(5, Vec3::new(430., 0.65, -72.)),
   113	            Car::new(6, Vec3::new(420., 0.65, 330.)),
   114	        ];
   115	        for car in &mut cars {
   116	            car.pos.y = world.surface(car.pos.x, car.pos.z) + 0.65;
   117	            configure_car(car, &save);
   118	        }
   119	        let mut heists = crate::heists::Heists::new(
   120	            std::time::SystemTime::now()
   121	                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
   122	                .unwrap_or_default()
   123	                .as_nanos() as u64,
   124	        );
   125	        heists.cooldown = save.heist_cooldown;
   126	        let wanted = save.wanted;
   127	        let bounty = save.bounty;
   128	        let alarm = Alarm {
   129	            cooldown: save.robbery_cooldown,
   130	            ..Default::default()
   131	        };
   132	        Ok(Self {
   133	            world: world.clone(),
   134	            doors,
   135	            slot: 0,
   136	            explosive: false,
   137	            charge_taken: false,
   138	            fuse: None,
   139	            breached: false,
   140	            stun: 0.,
   141	            blast: 0.,
   142	            response: None,
   143	            view: None,
   144	            captured: false,
   145	            capture_frame: 0,
   146	            scene_triangles: 0,
   147	            vehicle_triangles: 0,
   148	            npc_triangles: 0,
   149	            capture_at: 3.,
   150	            player,
   151	            cars,
   152	            driving: None,
   153	            save,
   154	            alarm,
   155	            npcs: {
   156	                let mut npcs = crate::npcs::population();
   157	                for n in &mut npcs {
   158	                    n.pos.y = world.walking_surface(n.pos) + 1.;
   159	                    n.home.y = n.pos.y;
   160	                }
   161	                npcs
   162	            },
   163	            wanted,
   164	            cuffs: Default::default(),
   165	            immunity: 0.,
   166	            bounty,
   167	            random: 0x6a09e667
   168	                ^ std::time::SystemTime::now()
   169	                    .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
   170	                    .unwrap_or_default()
   171	                    .as_nanos() as u64,
   172	            drops: Vec::new(),
   173	            parachute: false,
   174	            heists,
   175	            yaw: std::f32::consts::PI,
   176	            pitch: 0.32,
   177	            menu: true,
   178	            map: false,
   179	            garage: false,
   180	            workshop: None,
   181	            workshop_config: false,
   182	            training: false,
   183	            graphics_row: 0,
   184	            texture_applied: usize::MAX,
   185	            stamina: 100.,
   186	            holding: false,
   187	            punch_time: 0.,
   188	            punch_done: false,
   189	            movement: 0.,
   190	            camera: None,
   191	            training_time: 0.,
   192	            armory: false,
   193	            weapon_selection: 0,
   194	            housing: None,
   195	            cursor: false,
   196	            stance: 0,
   197	            prone: false,
   198	            crouched: false,
   199	
   200	            message: "PRISON LOCKED - SEWER MAZE OR C4; P PARACHUTE".into(),
   201	            message_time: 12.,
   202	            clock: 0.,
   203	            stats: profiling::Stats::new(),
   204	            shot: 0.,
   205	            debug: false,
   206	            waypoint: None,
   207	            pistol,
   208	        })
   209	    }
   210	    fn notify(&mut self, s: &str) {
   211	        self.message = s.into();
   212	        self.message_time = 8.;
   213	    }
   214	    fn save(&mut self) {
   215	        self.save.heist_cooldown = self.heists.cooldown;
   216	        self.save.robbery_cooldown = self.alarm.cooldown;
   217	        // Save-and-exit cannot bypass a robbery lockout; unbanked loot is forfeited.
   218	        if let Some(id) = self.heists.site {
   219	            self.save.heist_cooldown[id] = 900.;
   220	        }
   221	        if let Some(id) = self.alarm.site {
   222	            self.save.robbery_cooldown[id] = 900.;
   223	        }
   224	        self.save.wanted = self.wanted.min(5);
   225	        self.save.bounty = self.bounty;
   226	        self.save.magazines[self.pistol.kind] = self.pistol.ammo;
   227	        self.save.ammunition[self.pistol.kind] = self.pistol.reserve;
   228	        self.save.ammo = self.save.magazines[0];
   229	        self.save.reserve = self.save.ammunition[0];
   230	        self.save.position = self.player.pos;
   231	        self.save.team = self.player.team;
   232	        match save_system::store(&self.save) {
   233	            Ok(()) => self.notify("PROGRESS SAVED"),
   234	            Err(e) => self.notify(&format!("SAVE FAILED: {e}")),
   235	        }
   236	    }
   237	    fn blocked(&self, p: Vec3, r: f32) -> bool {
   238	        self.world.blocked(p, r)
   239	            || world::prison::barrier(p, r, self.breached)
   240	            || self
   241	                .doors
   242	                .iter()
   243	                .zip(&self.world.buildings)
   244	                .any(|(door, b)| door.blocked(b, p, r))
   245	    }
   246	    fn clear(&self, a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> bool {
   247	        if (a.y - b.y).abs() > 2. {
   248	            return false;
   249	        }
   250	        let n = (a.distance(b) / 0.35).ceil().max(1.) as usize;
   251	        (1..n).all(|j| {
   252	            let t = j as f32 / n as f32;
   253	            !self.blocked(
   254	                Vec3::new(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, a.y, a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t),
   255	                0.1,
   256	            )
   257	        })
   258	    }
   259	    fn key_action(&mut self, k: i32) -> bool {
   260	        if self.heists.quiz && !self.cuffs.active {
   261	            match k {
   262	                48..=57 => {
   263	                    if self.heists.answer.len() < 8 {
   264	                        self.heists.answer.push(char::from_u32(k as u32).unwrap());
   265	                    }
   266	                }
   267	                8 => {
   268	                    self.heists.answer.pop();
   269	                }
   270	                13 if !self.heists.submit() => self.notify("WRONG ANSWER - TRY AGAIN"),
   271	                _ => {}
   272	            }
   273	            return true;
   274	        }
   275	        if self.cuffs.active {
   276	            if k == 32 && self.cuffs.hit() {
   277	                self.immunity = 12.;
   278	                self.stun = 0.;
   279	                self.notify("ESCAPED CUFFS - 12S ARREST / STUN IMMUNITY");
   280	            }
   281	            return true;
   282	        }
   283	        match k {
   284	            112 if !self.modal() => self.parachute = !self.parachute,
   285	            9 => self.cursor = !self.cursor,
   286	            122 if !self.modal() => {
   287	                self.prone = !self.prone;
   288	                self.crouched = false;
   289	            }
   290	            99 if !self.modal()
   291	                && !self.world.interior(self.player.pos).is_some_and(|id| {
   292	                    matches!(
   293	                        self.world.buildings[id].name,
   294	                        "Grocery" | "Donut Shop" | "Gas Station"
   295	                    )
   296	                }) =>
   297	            {
   298	                self.crouched = !self.crouched;
   299	                self.prone = false;
   300	            }
   301	            49..=51 if self.armory => self.weapon_selection = (k - 49) as usize,
   302	            13 | 98 if self.armory => {
   303	                self.buy_weapon(self.weapon_selection);
   304	            }
   305	            49 if self.housing.is_some() => self.lease(self.housing.unwrap()),
   306	            50 if self.housing.is_some() => {
   307	                let id = self.housing.unwrap();
   308	                self.housing = None;
   309	                self.slot = 0;
   310	                if id >= 2 {
   311	                    self.notify("RENT THIS HOME TO REST HERE");
   312	                    return true;
   313	                }
   314	                self.notify("FACE THE CASE - F TO BREAK THE LOCK");
   315	            }
   316	            51 if self.housing.is_some() => {
   317	                if self.save.leases[self.housing.unwrap()] > 0. {
   318	                    self.player.health = 100.;
   319	                    self.stamina = 100. + self.save.endurance_level as f32 * 20.;
   320	                    self.notify("RESTED AT HOME");
   321	                }
   322	            }
   323	            27 if self.modal() => self.close_panels(),
   324	            27 => {
   325	                self.menu = !self.menu;
   326	                self.workshop = None;
   327	                self.training = false;
   328	                self.armory = false;
   329	                self.housing = None;
   330	            }
   331	            13 if self.workshop.is_some() && self.workshop_config => self.save(),
   332	            13 => {
   333	                self.menu = false;
   334	                self.garage = false;
   335	                self.armory = false;
   336	                self.housing = None;
   337	                self.workshop = None;
   338	                self.training = false;
   339	                self.armory = false;
   340	                self.housing = None;
   341	            }
   342	            110 if self.workshop.is_some() => self.workshop_config = !self.workshop_config,
   343	            1073741903 if self.workshop.is_some() && self.workshop_config => {
   344	                self.workshop = Some((self.workshop.unwrap() + 1) % CATALOG.len())
   345	            }
   346	            1073741904 if self.workshop.is_some() && self.workshop_config => {
   347	                self.workshop = Some((self.workshop.unwrap() + CATALOG.len() - 1) % CATALOG.len())
   348	            }
   349	
   350	            48..=53 if self.workshop.is_some() && self.workshop_config => {
   351	                self.set_engine((k - 48) as u32)
   352	            }
   353	            49..=53 if self.workshop.is_some() => self.service((k - 48) as u32),
   354	            49..=51 if self.training => self.train((k - 48) as u32),
   355	            49..=51 if self.menu => {
   356	                self.player = Player::new(match k {
   357	                    49 => Team::Prisoner,
   358	                    50 => Team::Police,
   359	                    _ => Team::Criminal,
   360	                });
   361	                self.driving = None;
   362	                self.wanted = 0;
   363	                self.bounty = 0;
   364	                self.heists.bag = 0;
   365	                self.heists.finish();
   366	                self.cuffs.active = false;
   367	                self.immunity = 0.;
   368	                self.camera = None;
   369	                self.alarm.cancel();
   370	                self.menu = false;
   371	            }
   372	            101 if !self.modal() => self.interact(),
   373	            109 => {
   374	                let open = !self.map;
   375	                self.close_panels();
   376	                self.map = open;
   377	            }
   378	            106 => {
   379	                if self.workshop.is_some() {
   380	                    self.close_panels();
   381	                } else {
   382	                    self.close_panels();
   383	                    self.open_workshop();
   384	                }
   385	            }
   386	            103 => {
   387	                let open = !self.garage;
   388	                self.close_panels();
   389	                self.garage = open;
   390	            }
   391	            98 if !self.menu
   392	                && !self.garage
   393	                && !self.map
   394	                && self.world.interior(self.player.pos).is_some_and(|id| {
   395	                    matches!(
   396	                        self.world.buildings[id].name,
   397	                        "Grocery" | "Donut Shop" | "Gas Station"
   398	                    )
   399	                }) =>
   400	            {
   401	                self.supplies(true)
   402	            }
   403	            99 if !self.menu && !self.garage && !self.map => self.supplies(false),
   404	            98 if !self.menu && self.save.pistol_owned => {
   405	                if self
   406	                    .world
   407	                    .interior(self.player.pos)
   408	                    .is_some_and(|id| self.world.buildings[id].name == "Weapons")
   409	                    && self.save.balance >= 50
   410	                {
   411	                    self.save.balance -= 50;
   412	                    self.pistol.reserve =
   413	                        (self.pistol.reserve + 36).min(36 + self.save.carry_level * 24);
   414	                    self.notify("36 ROUNDS PURCHASED - $50");
   415	                } else {
   416	                    self.notify("B AT WEAPONS: 36 ROUNDS COST $50");
   417	                }
   418	            }
   419	
   420	            1073741906 if self.garage => self.graphics_row = (self.graphics_row + 2) % 3,
   421	            1073741905 if self.garage => self.graphics_row = (self.graphics_row + 1) % 3,
   422	            1073741904 | 1073741903 if self.garage => {
   423	                let d = if k == 1073741904 { 3 } else { 1 };
   424	                match self.graphics_row {
   425	                    0 => self.save.quality = (self.save.quality + d) % 4,
   426	                    1 => self.save.texture_level = (self.save.texture_level + d) % 4,
   427	                    _ => self.save.object_shadows = !self.save.object_shadows,
   428	                }
   429	            }
   430	            1073741886 => self.save(),
   431	            1073741884 => self.debug = !self.debug,
   432	            113 if self.menu => return false,
   433	            49..=55 if !self.modal() => {
   434	                self.slot = (k - 49) as usize;
   435	                match self.slot {
   436	                    1 => self.equip_weapon(0),
   437	                    5 => self.equip_weapon(1),
   438	                    6 => self.equip_weapon(2),
   439	                    _ => {}
   440	                }
   441	            }
   442	            108 => self.save.quality = (self.save.quality + 1) % 4,
   443	            114 if !self.modal() && matches!(self.slot, 1 | 5 | 6) => self.pistol.reload(),
   444	            102 if !self.modal() => self.fire(),
   445	            _ => {}
   446	        }
   447	        true
   448	    }
   449	    fn modal(&self) -> bool {
   450	        self.menu
   451	            || self.map
   452	            || self.garage
   453	            || self.workshop.is_some()
   454	            || self.training
   455	            || self.armory
   456	            || self.housing.is_some()
   457	    }
   458	    fn close_panels(&mut self) {
   459	        self.menu = false;
   460	        self.map = false;
   461	        self.garage = false;
   462	        self.workshop = None;
   463	        self.training = false;
   464	        self.armory = false;
   465	        self.housing = None;
   466	    }
   467	    fn equip_weapon(&mut self, id: usize) {
   468	        self.save.magazines[self.pistol.kind] = self.pistol.ammo;
   469	        self.save.ammunition[self.pistol.kind] = self.pistol.reserve;
   470	        self.pistol = weapons::Pistol {
   471	            kind: id,
   472	            ammo: self.save.magazines[id],
   473	            reserve: self.save.ammunition[id],
   474	            ..Default::default()
   475	        };
   476	        self.slot = match id {
   477	            0 => 1,
   478	            1 => 5,
   479	            _ => 6,
   480	        };
   481	    }
   482	    fn buy_weapon(&mut self, id: usize) -> bool {
   483	        let spec = weapons::CATALOG[id];
   484	        if self.save.weapon_owned[id] {
   485	            self.equip_weapon(id);
   486	            self.notify("ALREADY OWNED - EQUIPPED");
   487	            return false;
   488	        }
   489	        if self.save.balance < spec.price {
   490	            self.notify("NOT ENOUGH CASH FOR THIS WEAPON");
   491	            return false;
   492	        }
   493	        self.save.balance -= spec.price;
   494	        self.save.weapon_owned[id] = true;
   495	        if id == 0 {
   496	            self.save.pistol_owned = true;
   497	        }
   498	        self.save.magazines[self.pistol.kind] = self.pistol.ammo;
   499	        self.save.ammunition[self.pistol.kind] = self.pistol.reserve;
   500	        self.pistol = weapons::Pistol {
   501	            kind: id,
   502	            ammo: spec.magazine,
   503	            reserve: spec.reserve,
   504	            ..Default::default()
   505	        };
   506	        self.save.magazines[id] = spec.magazine;
   507	        self.save.ammunition[id] = spec.reserve;
   508	        self.slot = match id {
   509	            0 => 1,
   510	            1 => 5,
   511	            _ => 6,
   512	        };
   513	        self.notify(&format!("{} PURCHASED ${}", spec.name, spec.price));
   514	        true
   515	    }
   516	    fn buy_pistol(&mut self) -> bool {
   517	        self.buy_weapon(0)
   518	    }
   519	    fn lease(&mut self, id: usize) {
   520	        let price = [150, 180, 500, 100][id];
   521	        if self.save.balance < price {
   522	            self.notify("NOT ENOUGH CASH TO RENT");
   523	            return;
   524	        }
   525	        self.save.balance -= price;
   526	        self.save.leases[id] = 900.;
   527	        self.notify("RENTED FOR 15 MINUTES OF PLAY - 3 REST AT HOME");
   528	    }
   529	    fn property(&self) -> Option<usize> {
   530	        let p = self.player.pos;
   531	        [(-220., 210.), (-300., 260.), (350., -50.), (-335., 320.)]
   532	            .iter()
   533	            .position(|&(x, z)| p.distance(Vec3::new(x, 0., z)) < 14.)
   534	    }
   535	    fn player_blocked(&self, p: Vec3, r: f32) -> bool {
   536	        if self.stance == 0 {
   537	            self.blocked(p, r)
   538	        } else {
   539	            self.world
   540	                .body_blocked(p, r, if self.stance == 2 { 0.65 } else { 1.6 })
   541	                || world::prison::barrier(p, r, self.breached)
   542	                || self
   543	                    .doors
   544	                    .iter()
   545	                    .zip(&self.world.buildings)
   546	                    .any(|(d, b)| d.blocked(b, p, r))
   547	        }
   548	    }
   549	    fn steal(&mut self, id: usize) {
   550	        if self.response.as_ref().is_some_and(|(_, car)| *car == id) {
   551	            self.response = None;
   552	        }
   553	        self.camera = None;
   554	        self.driving = Some(id);
   555	        self.player.team = Team::Criminal;
   556	        self.wanted = (self.wanted + 1).min(5);
   557	        self.bounty += 100;
   558	        self.yaw = std::f32::consts::PI - self.cars[id].angle;
   559	        self.notify("VEHICLE STOLEN - YOU ARE NOW A CRIMINAL - E EXIT");
   560	    }
   561	    fn arrest(&mut self) {
   562	        self.cuffs.active = false;
   563	        self.immunity = 0.;
   564	        self.bounty = 0;
   565	        self.heists.bag = 0;
   566	        self.heists.finish();
   567	        self.camera = None;
   568	        self.player = Player::new(Team::Prisoner);
   569	        self.driving = None;
   570	        self.wanted = 0;
   571	        self.alarm.cancel();
   572	        self.save.pistol_owned = false;
   573	        self.save.weapon_owned = [false; 3];
   574	        self.save.magazines = [0; 3];
   575	        self.save.ammunition = [0; 3];
   576	        self.close_panels();
   577	        self.pistol.ammo = 0;
   578	        self.pistol.reserve = 0;
   579	        self.slot = 0;
   580	        self.explosive = false;
   581	        self.charge_taken = false;
   582	        self.fuse = None;
   583	        self.breached = false;
   584	        self.stun = 0.;
   585	        self.response = None;
   586	        self.workshop = None;
   587	        self.training = false;
   588	        self.punch_time = 0.;
   589	        self.notify("ARRESTED - LOOT AND CONTRABAND CONFISCATED - BACK TO PRISON");
   590	    }
   591	    fn interact(&mut self) {
   592	        if self.stun > 0. || self.cuffs.active {
   593	            return;
   594	        }
   595	        if let Some(i) = self
   596	            .drops
   597	            .iter()
   598	            .position(|(q, taken)| !taken && q.distance(self.player.pos) < 3.)
   599	        {
   600	            self.drops[i].1 = true;
   601	            self.explosive = true;
   602	            self.notify("C4 FOUND ON BODY");
   603	            return;
   604	        }
   605	        if let Some(i) = self.driving {
   606	            let c = &self.cars[i];
   607	            for side in [1., -1.] {
   608	                let mut p = Vec3::new(
   609	                    c.pos.x + side * c.angle.cos() * 3.,
   610	                    c.pos.y,
   611	                    c.pos.z - side * c.angle.sin() * 3.,
   612	                );
   613	                p.y = self.world.surface(p.x, p.z) + 1.;
   614	                if !self.blocked(p, 0.5) {
   615	                    self.player.pos = p;
   616	                    self.player.vy = 0.;
   617	                    self.driving = None;
   618	                    self.camera = None;
   619	                    break;
   620	                }
   621	            }
   622	            return;
   623	        }
   624	        let p = self.player.pos;
   625	        if self.special_interact() {
   626	            return;
   627	        }
   628	        if p.distance(Vec3::new(350., 1., -65.)) < 3. && p.y < 8. {
   629	            self.player.pos = Vec3::new(350., 19., -58.);
   630	            self.notify("PENTHOUSE LIFT - E HERE TO GO DOWN");
   631	            return;
   632	        }
   633	        if p.distance(Vec3::new(350., 19., -58.)) < 3. && p.y > 15. {
   634	            self.player.pos = Vec3::new(350., 1., -66.);
   635	            self.notify("LIFT TO STREET");
   636	            return;
   637	        }
   638	        for hatch in [world::prison::HATCH, world::prison::EXIT] {
   639	            if p.distance(hatch) < 2.5 {
   640	                self.player.pos = Vec3::new(hatch.x, if p.y < -0.5 { 1. } else { -3. }, hatch.z);
   641	                self.player.vy = 0.;
   642	                self.notify("SEWER LADDER - WALK TO THE OTHER HATCH - E CLIMB");
   643	                return;
   644	            }
   645	        }
   646	        if !self.charge_taken && p.distance(world::prison::CHARGE) < 3. && p.y > 0. {
   647	            self.explosive = true;
   648	            self.charge_taken = true;
   649	            self.slot = 2;
   650	            self.notify("C4 FOUND - SLOT 3 - E AT CRACKED WEST WALL");
   651	            return;
   652	        }
   653	        if self.slot == 2 && self.explosive && p.distance(world::prison::WEAK) < 4. {
   654	            self.explosive = false;
   655	            self.fuse = Some(3.);
   656	            self.notify("C4 PLANTED - 3 SECONDS - STEP BACK");
   657	            return;
   658	        }
   659	        if let Some(id) = self.world.buildings.iter().position(|b| {
   660	            b.interior && p.distance(Vec3::new(b.p.x, 1., b.p.z - b.size.z / 2.)) < 4.5 && p.y > 0.
   661	        }) {
   662	            self.doors[id].open = !self.doors[id].open;
   663	            self.notify("DOOR OPEN / CLOSE");
   664	            return;
   665	        }
   666	        if let Some(id) = self.world.interior(p) {
   667	            let name = self.world.buildings[id].name;
   668	            if name == "Weapons" || name.contains("Police") {
   669	                self.armory = true;
   670	                self.weapon_selection = 0;
   671	                return;
   672	            }
   673	            if matches!(name, "Garage" | "Desert Garage") {
   674	                self.open_workshop();
   675	                return;
   676	            }
   677	            if name == "Gym" {
   678	                self.training = true;
   679	                return;
   680	            }
   681	            if let Some(id) = self.property() {
   682	                if self.alarm.site.is_some() && self.alarm.hits.iter().any(|n| *n >= 3) {
   683	                    self.notify("HOLD E TO COLLECT");
   684	                    return;
   685	                }
   686	                self.housing = Some(id);
   687	                return;
   688	            }
   689	            if matches!(name, "Criminal Base" | "Safehouse") {
   690	                self.notify("SAFEHOUSE - GYM NEARBY - NO FREE GUNS");
   691	                return;
   692	            }
   693	            if matches!(name, "Canteen" | "Infirmary") {
   694	                self.player.health = 100.;
   695	                self.notify("HEALTH RESTORED");
   696	                return;
   697	            }
   698	            if let Some(site) = SITES
   699	                .iter()
   700	                .position(|site| site.center.distance(self.world.buildings[id].p) < 1.)
   701	            {
   702	                if self.player.team == Team::Police {
   703	                    self.notify("POLICE CANNOT ROB STORES");
   704	                    return;
   705	                }
   706	                self.notify(if self.alarm.hits[site] < 3 {
   707	                    "SLOT 1 - F OR LEFT CLICK: HIT THE GLASS 3 TIMES"
   708	                } else {
   709	                    "HOLD E NEAR THE BROKEN CASE TO TAKE LOOT"
   710	                });
   711	                return;
   712	            }
   713	        }
   714	        if self.player.team == Team::Police {
   715	            if let Some(id) = self.npcs.iter().position(|n| {
   716	                n.role == Role::Robber
   717	                    && n.disabled <= 0.
   718	                    && n.pos.distance(p) < 3.
   719	                    && self.clear(p, n.pos)
   720	            }) {
   721	                self.npcs[id].disabled = 60.;
   722	                self.save.balance += 50;
   723	                self.notify("ROBBER ARRESTED - $50");
   724	                return;
   725	            }
   726	        }
   727	        if let Some(id) = self
   728	            .cars
   729	            .iter()
   730	            .position(|c| p.distance(c.pos) < 4.5 && (p.y - c.pos.y).abs() < 2.)
   731	        {
   732	            self.steal(id);
   733	        }
   734	    }
   735	    fn prepare_response(&mut self, site: usize) {
   736	        let target = SITES[site].center;
   737	        let road = self
   738	            .world
   739	            .roads
   740	            .iter()
   741	            .min_by(|a, b| a.distance(target).0.total_cmp(&b.distance(target).0))
   742	            .unwrap();
   743	        let end = road
   744	            .points
   745	            .iter()
   746	            .enumerate()
   747	            .min_by(|(_, a), (_, b)| a.distance(target).total_cmp(&b.distance(target)))
   748	            .unwrap()
   749	            .0;
   750	        let (start, end) = if end >= 12 {
   751	            (end - 12, end)
   752	        } else {
   753	            (end, (end + 12).min(road.points.len() - 1))
   754	        };
   755	        let mut route = road.points[start..=end].to_vec();
   756	        if route.last().unwrap().distance(target) > route[0].distance(target) {
   757	            route.reverse();
   758	        }
   759	        let b = self
   760	            .world
   761	            .buildings
   762	            .iter()
   763	            .min_by(|a, b| a.p.distance(target).total_cmp(&b.p.distance(target)))
   764	            .unwrap();
   765	        let mut curb = b.entrance();
   766	        curb.z -= 4.;
   767	        curb.y = self.world.surface(curb.x, curb.z);
   768	        route.push(curb);
   769	        let mut car = Car::new(2, route[0]);
   770	        configure_car(&mut car, &self.save);
   771	        car.pos.y += 0.65;
   772	        let id = self.cars.len();
   773	        self.cars.push(car);
   774	        self.response = Some((route, id));
   775	    }
   776	    fn punch(&mut self) {
   777	        if self.punch_time > 0.
   778	            || self.stun > 0.
   779	            || self.driving.is_some()
   780	            || self.training_time > 0.
   781	        {
   782	            return;
   783	        }
   784	        self.player.heading = std::f32::consts::PI - self.yaw;
   785	        self.punch_time = 0.55;
   786	        self.punch_done = false;
   787	    }
   788	    fn punch_impact(&mut self) {
   789	        if self.special_strike() {
   790	            return;
   791	        }
   792	        let p = self.player.pos;
   793	        for id in 0..SITES.len() {
   794	            let case = Alarm::case(id);
   795	            if id >= 5 && self.save.leases[id - 5] > 0. && p.distance(case) < 2.6 {
   796	                self.notify("YOUR RENTED HOME CANNOT BE ROBBED");
   797	                continue;
   798	            }
   799	            let a = self.player.heading;
   800	            let dx = case.x - p.x;
   801	            let dz = case.z - p.z;
   802	            let facing = dx * a.sin() + dz * a.cos();
   803	            if p.distance(case) < 2.6
   804	                && facing > 0.3
   805	                && self.player.team != Team::Police
   806	                && self.clear(p, case)
   807	            {
   808	                let starting = self.alarm.site.is_none();
   809	                if self.alarm.strike(id) {
   810	                    self.player.team = Team::Criminal;
   811	                    self.wanted = self.wanted.max(3);
   812	                    if starting {
   813	                        self.prepare_response(id);
   814	                    }
   815	                    self.notify(if self.alarm.hits[id] >= 3 {
   816	                        "GLASS BROKEN - HOLD E TO TAKE LOOT - ESCAPE BEFORE 30S"
   817	                    } else {
   818	                        "GLASS CRACKED - ALARM 30S - HIT AGAIN"
   819	                    });
   820	                }
   821	                return;
   822	            }
   823	        }
   824	        if let Some(id) = self
   825	            .npcs
   826	            .iter()
   827	            .position(|n| n.disabled <= 0. && n.pos.distance(p) < 2. && self.clear(p, n.pos))
   828	        {
   829	            self.npcs[id].health -= 15.;
   830	            self.drop_c4(id);
   831	            self.player.team = Team::Criminal;
   832	            self.wanted = self.wanted.max(1);
   833	            self.notify("ASSAULT - POLICE ALERTED");
   834	        }
   835	    }
   836	    fn open_workshop(&mut self) {
   837	        let near = self.world.buildings.iter().any(|b| {
   838	            matches!(b.name, "Garage" | "Desert Garage") && self.player.pos.distance(b.p) < 27.
   839	        });
   840	        if !near {
   841	            self.notify("J SERVICE: BRING A STOLEN CAR TO THE GARAGE");
   842	            return;
   843	        }
   844	        let id = self.driving.or_else(|| {
   845	            self.cars
   846	                .iter()
   847	                .position(|c| c.pos.distance(self.player.pos) < 6.)
   848	        });
   849	        if let Some(id) = id {
   850	            self.workshop = Some(id);
   851	        } else {
   852	            self.notify("PARK YOUR STOLEN CAR NEAR THE GARAGE");
   853	        }
   854	    }
   855	    fn service(&mut self, option: u32) {
   856	        let Some(id) = self.workshop else {
   857	            return;
   858	        };
   859	        if option == 3 {
   860	            let target = self.cars[id].engine_level + 1;
   861	            if target > 5 {
   862	                self.notify("UPGRADE ALREADY AT MAXIMUM");
   863	                return;
   864	            }
   865	            self.set_engine(target);
   866	            return;
   867	        }
   868	        let car = &self.cars[id];
   869	        let (level, cap) = match option {
   870	            3 => (car.engine_level, 5),
   871	            4 => (car.brake_level, 3),
   872	            5 => (car.suspension_level, 2),
   873	            _ => (0, 1),
   874	        };
   875	        if level >= cap {
   876	            self.notify("UPGRADE ALREADY AT MAXIMUM");
   877	            return;
   878	        }
   879	        let cost = match option {
   880	            1 => 40,
   881	            2 => 25,
   882	            3 => 150 + level * 100,
   883	            4 => 100 + level * 80,
   884	            _ => 120 + level * 100,
   885	        };
   886	        if self.save.balance < cost {
   887	            self.notify("NOT ENOUGH CASH");
   888	            return;
   889	        }
   890	        self.save.balance -= cost;
   891	        if option == 1 {
   892	            self.cars[id].damage = 0.;
   893	        } else if option == 2 {
   894	            let c = &mut self.cars[id];
   895	            c.color = if c.color[0] > 0.5 {
   896	                [0.17, 0.3, 0.42]
   897	            } else {
   898	                [0.68, 0.19, 0.12]
   899	            };
   900	        }
   901	        if option == 3 {
   902	            self.cars[id].engine_level += 1;
   903	        } else if option == 4 {
   904	            self.cars[id].brake_level += 1;
   905	        } else if option == 5 {
   906	            self.cars[id].suspension_level += 1;
   907	        }
   908	        let c = &self.cars[id];
   909	        self.save.car_engine[c.kind] = self.save.car_engine[c.kind].max(c.engine_level);
   910	        self.save.car_engine_selected[c.kind] = c.engine_level;
   911	        self.save.car_brakes[c.kind] = c.brake_level;
   912	        self.save.car_suspension[c.kind] = c.suspension_level;
   913	        self.save.car_paint[c.kind] = c.color;
   914	        self.notify("SERVICE COMPLETE");
   915	    }
   916	    fn train(&mut self, kind: u32) {
   917	        let level = match kind {
   918	            1 => self.save.run_level,
   919	            2 => self.save.endurance_level,
   920	            _ => self.save.carry_level,
   921	        };
   922	        let cost = 60 + level * 40;
   923	        if self.training_time > 0. || level >= 5 || self.save.balance < cost {
   924	            self.notify("TRAINING: MAX LEVEL OR NOT ENOUGH CASH");
   925	            return;
   926	        }
   927	        self.save.balance -= cost;
   928	        match kind {
   929	            1 => self.save.run_level += 1,
   930	            2 => self.save.endurance_level += 1,
   931	            _ => self.save.carry_level += 1,
   932	        };
   933	        self.training = false;
   934	        self.training_time = 3.;
   935	        self.notify("TRAINING 3S - SKILL UPGRADED");
   936	    }
   937	    fn supplies(&mut self, water: bool) {
   938	        let store = self.world.interior(self.player.pos).is_some_and(|id| {
   939	            matches!(
   940	                self.world.buildings[id].name,
   941	                "Grocery" | "Donut Shop" | "Gas Station"
   942	            )
   943	        });
   944	        let cost = if water { 8 } else { 12 };
   945	        let stock = if water {
   946	            self.save.water
   947	        } else {
   948	            self.save.food
   949	        };
   950	        let vendor = self.npcs.iter().any(|n| {
   951	            n.role == Role::Vendor
   952	                && n.pos.distance(self.player.pos) < 5.
   953	                && self.clear(self.player.pos, n.pos)
   954	        });
   955	        if !store
   956	            || !vendor
   957	            || self.save.balance < cost
   958	            || stock >= 20
   959	            || self.save.water + self.save.food >= 8 + self.save.carry_level * 2
   960	        {
   961	            self.notify("AT STORE: B WATER $8 / C FOOD $12 - MAX 20");
   962	            return;
   963	        }
   964	        self.save.balance -= cost;
   965	        if water {
   966	            self.save.water += 1;
   967	        } else {
   968	            self.save.food += 1;
   969	        }
   970	        self.notify("SUPPLIES PURCHASED - SLOT 4/5 - F USE");
   971	    }
   972	    fn fire(&mut self) {
   973	        if self.heists.quiz || self.cuffs.active {
   974	            return;
   975	        }
   976	
   977	        if self.slot == 0 {
   978	            self.punch();
   979	            return;
   980	        }
   981	        if self.slot == 3 && self.save.water > 0 {
   982	            self.save.water -= 1;
   983	            self.stamina = 100. + self.save.endurance_level as f32 * 20.;
   984	            self.notify("WATER - STAMINA RESTORED");
   985	            return;
   986	        }
   987	        if self.slot == 4 && self.save.food > 0 {
   988	            self.save.food -= 1;
   989	            self.player.health = (self.player.health + 25.).min(100.);
   990	            self.notify("FOOD +25 HP");
   991	            return;
   992	        }
   993	
   994	        if self.stun > 0.
   995	            || !matches!(self.slot, 1 | 5 | 6)
   996	            || !self.save.weapon_owned[self.pistol.kind]
   997	        {
   998	            self.notify("NO PISTOL EQUIPPED - BUY FOR $350 AT WEAPONS");
   999	            return;
  1000	        }
  1001	        if !self.pistol.fire() {
  1002	            self.notify("R RELOAD");
  1003	            return;
  1004	        }
  1005	        self.shot = 0.15;
  1006	        if self.player.team != Team::Police {
  1007	            self.player.team = Team::Criminal;
  1008	            self.wanted = self.wanted.max(2);
  1009	        }
  1010	        let p = self.player.pos;
  1011	        let victim = self
  1012	            .npcs
  1013	            .iter()
  1014	            .enumerate()
  1015	            .filter(|(_, n)| n.disabled <= 0. && self.clear(p, n.pos))
  1016	            .filter_map(|(id, n)| {
  1017	                weapons::ray_distance_range(
  1018	                    p,
  1019	                    self.yaw,
  1020	                    n.pos,
  1021	                    weapons::CATALOG[self.pistol.kind].range,
  1022	                )
  1023	                .map(|d| (id, d))
  1024	            })
  1025	            .min_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1))
  1026	            .map(|(id, _)| id);
  1027	        if let Some(id) = victim {
  1028	            self.npcs[id].health -= weapons::CATALOG[self.pistol.kind].damage;
  1029	            self.drop_c4(id);
  1030	            self.notify("HIT");
  1031	        }
  1032	    }
  1033	    fn update(&mut self, r: &Renderer) {
  1034	        let forward = r.key(26) as i32 as f32 - r.key(22) as i32 as f32;
  1035	        let side = r.key(7) as i32 as f32 - r.key(4) as i32 as f32;
  1036	        self.holding = r.key(8);
  1037	        self.stance = if self.prone {
  1038	            2
  1039	        } else if self.crouched || r.key(224) {
  1040	            1
  1041	        } else {
  1042	            0
  1043	        };
  1044	        self.simulate(forward, side, r.key(225), r.key(224), r.key(44));
  1045	    }
  1046	    fn simulate(&mut self, forward: f32, side: f32, sprint: bool, crouch: bool, jump: bool) {
  1047	        if self.modal() {
  1048	            return;
  1049	        }
  1050	        self.immunity = (self.immunity - STEP).max(0.);
  1051	        if self.cuffs.active {
  1052	            if self.cuffs.tick(STEP) {
  1053	                self.arrest();
  1054	            }
  1055	            return;
  1056	        }
  1057	        self.tick_heists();
  1058	        self.bounty = self.bounty.max(self.wanted * 100);
  1059	        for lease in &mut self.save.leases {
  1060	            *lease = (*lease - STEP).max(0.);
  1061	        }
  1062	        let previous = self.player.pos;
  1063	        let forward = if self.heists.quiz || self.heists.riding.is_some() {
  1064	            0.
  1065	        } else {
  1066	            forward
  1067	        };
  1068	        let side = if self.heists.quiz || self.heists.riding.is_some() {
  1069	            0.
  1070	        } else {
  1071	            side
  1072	        };
  1073	        self.training_time = (self.training_time - STEP).max(0.);
  1074	        if self.punch_time > 0. {
  1075	            self.punch_time = (self.punch_time - STEP).max(0.);
  1076	            if self.punch_time < 0.3 && !self.punch_done {
  1077	                self.punch_done = true;
  1078	                self.punch_impact();
  1079	            }
  1080	        }
  1081	        let sprint = sprint && self.stamina > 1. && self.training_time <= 0. && self.stance == 0;
  1082	        if sprint && (forward.abs() + side.abs() > 0.) && self.driving.is_none() {
  1083	            self.stamina = (self.stamina - 22. * STEP).max(0.);
  1084	        } else {
  1085	            self.stamina =
  1086	                (self.stamina + 13. * STEP).min(100. + self.save.endurance_level as f32 * 20.);
  1087	        }
  1088	        let (forward, side, jump) = if self.training_time > 0. {
  1089	            (0., 0., false)
  1090	        } else {
  1091	            (forward, side, jump)
  1092	        };
  1093	        self.clock += STEP;
  1094	        self.pistol.tick(STEP);
  1095	        self.stun = (self.stun - STEP).max(0.);
  1096	        self.blast = (self.blast - STEP).max(0.);
  1097	        let (forward, side, jump) = if self.stun > 0. {
  1098	            (0., 0., false)
  1099	        } else {
  1100	            (forward, side, jump)
  1101	        };
  1102	        for (door, b) in self.doors.iter_mut().zip(&self.world.buildings) {
  1103	            if b.interior
  1104	                && self.npcs.iter().any(|n| {
  1105	                    n.disabled <= 0.
  1106	                        && n.pos
  1107	                            .distance(Vec3::new(b.p.x, b.p.y + 1., b.p.z - b.size.z / 2.))
  1108	                            < 5.
  1109	                })
  1110	            {
  1111	                door.open = true;
  1112	            }
  1113	            door.tick(STEP);
  1114	        }
  1115	        if let Some(t) = self.fuse {
  1116	            if t <= STEP {
  1117	                self.fuse = None;
  1118	                self.breached = true;
  1119	                self.blast = 0.7;
  1120	                if self.player.pos.distance(world::prison::WEAK) < 8. {
  1121	                    self.player.health = (self.player.health - 40.).max(1.);
  1122	                }
  1123	                self.notify("WEST WALL BREACHED - ESCAPE THROUGH THE OPENING");
  1124	            } else {
  1125	                self.fuse = Some(t - STEP);
  1126	            }
  1127	        }
  1128	
  1129	        self.message_time -= STEP;
  1130	        self.shot = (self.shot - STEP).max(0.);
  1131	        if let Some(i) = self.driving {
  1132	            let world = &self.world;
  1133	            let doors = &self.doors;
  1134	            let breached = self.breached;
  1135	            let (before, rest) = self.cars.split_at_mut(i);
  1136	            let (c, after) = rest.split_first_mut().unwrap();
  1137	            let mut next = vehicle_physics::step(c, forward, -side, jump || self.stun > 0., STEP);
  1138	            let ground = self.world.surface(next.x, next.z);
  1139	            next.y = ground + 0.65;
  1140	            let hit = (1..=4).any(|j| {
  1141	                let t = j as f32 / 4.;
  1142	                let p = Vec3::new(
  1143	                    c.pos.x + (next.x - c.pos.x) * t,
  1144	                    next.y,
  1145	                    c.pos.z + (next.z - c.pos.z) * t,
  1146	                );
  1147	                [-1.5, 0., 1.5].iter().any(|offset| {
  1148	                    let q = Vec3::new(
  1149	                        p.x + c.angle.sin() * offset,
  1150	                        p.y,
  1151	                        p.z + c.angle.cos() * offset,
  1152	                    );
  1153	                    world.blocked(q, 1.05)
  1154	                        || world::prison::barrier(q, 1.05, breached)
  1155	                        || doors
  1156	                            .iter()
  1157	                            .zip(&world.buildings)
  1158	                            .any(|(d, b)| d.blocked(b, q, 1.05))
  1159	                })
  1160	            });
  1161	            let other_car = before
  1162	                .iter()
  1163	                .chain(after.iter())
  1164	                .any(|other| next.distance(other.pos) < 3.4 && (next.y - other.pos.y).abs() < 2.);
  1165	            if hit || other_car || ground < -0.3 || (next.y - c.pos.y).abs() > 0.6 {
  1166	                if c.speed.abs() > 3. {
  1167	                    c.damage = (c.damage + c.speed.abs() * 0.12).min(100.);
  1168	                }
  1169	                c.speed = 0.;
  1170	            } else {
  1171	                c.pos = next;
  1172	            }
  1173	            self.player.pos = c.pos;
  1174	            self.player.heading = c.angle;
  1175	            let delta = (std::f32::consts::PI - c.angle - self.yaw)
  1176	                .sin()
  1177	                .atan2((std::f32::consts::PI - c.angle - self.yaw).cos());
  1178	            self.yaw += delta * STEP * 2.;
  1179	            self.pitch += (0.18 - self.pitch) * STEP * 2.;
  1180	        } else {
  1181	            let length = (forward * forward + side * side).sqrt().max(1.);
  1182	            let speed = if self.stance == 2 {
  1183	                1.6
  1184	            } else if sprint {
  1185	                9. + self.save.run_level as f32 * 0.6
  1186	            } else if crouch || self.stance == 1 {
  1187	                2.5
  1188	            } else {
  1189	                6.
  1190	            };
  1191	            let dx = (self.yaw.sin() * forward + self.yaw.cos() * side) / length * speed * STEP;
  1192	            let dz = (-self.yaw.cos() * forward + self.yaw.sin() * side) / length * speed * STEP;
  1193	            let mut p = self.player.pos;
  1194	            p.x += dx;
  1195	            if !self.player_blocked(p, 0.45) {
  1196	                self.player.pos.x = p.x;
  1197	            }
  1198	            p = self.player.pos;
  1199	            p.z += dz;
  1200	            if !self.player_blocked(p, 0.45) {
  1201	                self.player.pos.z = p.z;
  1202	            }
  1203	            if dx.abs() + dz.abs() > 0. {
  1204	                let desired = dx.atan2(dz);
  1205	                let delta = (desired - self.player.heading)
  1206	                    .sin()
  1207	                    .atan2((desired - self.player.heading).cos());
  1208	                self.player.heading += delta * (STEP * 12.).min(1.);
  1209	            }
  1210	            let ground = self.world.walking_surface(self.player.pos) + 1.;
  1211	            if jump && self.stance == 0 && self.player.pos.y <= ground + 0.01 {
  1212	                self.player.vy = 7.;
  1213	            }
  1214	            self.player.vy -= 18. * STEP;
  1215	            if self.parachute && self.player.pos.y > ground + 3. {
  1216	                self.player.vy = self.player.vy.max(-3.);
  1217	            } else if self.player.pos.y <= ground + 0.1 {
  1218	                self.parachute = false;
  1219	            }
  1220	            self.player.pos.y = (self.player.pos.y + self.player.vy * STEP).max(ground);
  1221	            let ceiling = self.world.ceiling(self.player.pos) - 0.8;
  1222	            if self.player.pos.y > ceiling {
  1223	                self.player.pos.y = ceiling;
  1224	                self.player.vy = 0.;
  1225	            }
  1226	            if self.player.pos.y == ground {
  1227	                self.player.vy = 0.;
  1228	            }
  1229	            if self.player.escaped() {
  1230	                self.notify("ESCAPED - E STEAL A PARKED CAR - ROB A STORE TO BUY A PISTOL");
  1231	            }
  1232	        }
  1233	        if matches!(self.slot, 1 | 5 | 6) && self.save.weapon_owned[self.pistol.kind] {
  1234	            let goal = std::f32::consts::PI - self.yaw;
  1235	            let delta = (goal - self.player.heading)
  1236	                .sin()
  1237	                .atan2((goal - self.player.heading).cos());
  1238	            self.player.heading += delta * STEP * 12.;
  1239	        }
  1240	        if self.heists.site == Some(1) && self.heists.solved < 1 {
  1241	            if let Some(b) = self.world.buildings.iter().find(|b| b.name == "Museum") {
  1242	                if b.inside(previous) && !b.inside(self.player.pos) {
  1243	                    self.player.pos = previous;
  1244	                    self.notify("MUSEUM EXIT LOCKED - E TO SOLVE EQUATION AFTER LOOTING");
  1245	                }
  1246	            }
  1247	        }
  1248	        let moving = self.player.pos.distance(previous) > 0.001 && self.driving.is_none();
  1249	        self.movement += ((if moving { 1. } else { 0. }) - self.movement) * STEP * 12.;
  1250	        self.player.animation += STEP * (if sprint { 1.5 } else { 1. });
  1251	        self.player.pos.x = self.player.pos.x.clamp(-1000., 1000.);
  1252	        self.player.pos.z = self.player.pos.z.clamp(-1000., 1000.);
  1253	        self.alarm.collecting =
  1254	            self.holding && self.slot == 0 && self.punch_time <= 0. && self.stun <= 0.;
  1255	        self.alarm.capacity = 8 + self.save.carry_level * 2;
  1256	        match self.alarm.tick(self.player.pos, STEP) {
  1257	            Outcome::Escaped(cash) => {
  1258	                self.save.balance += cash;
  1259	                self.save.robberies += 1;
  1260	                self.wanted = 0;
  1261	                self.response = None;
  1262	                self.notify(&format!("ESCAPED WITH ${cash}"));
  1263	            }
  1264	            Outcome::Dispatch(site) => {
  1265	                let curb = self
  1266	                    .response
  1267	                    .as_ref()
  1268	                    .map(|(route, _)| *route.last().unwrap())
  1269	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| {
  1270	                        self.world
  1271	                            .roads
  1272	                            .iter()
  1273	                            .flat_map(|r| r.points.iter())
  1274	                            .min_by(|a, b| {
  1275	                                a.distance(SITES[site].center)
  1276	                                    .total_cmp(&b.distance(SITES[site].center))
  1277	                            })
  1278	                            .copied()
  1279	                            .unwrap_or(SITES[site].center)
  1280	                    });
  1281	                if self.npcs.len() > crate::npcs::population().len() {
  1282	                    self.npcs.truncate(crate::npcs::population().len());
  1283	                }
  1284	                for (j, role) in [Role::Police, Role::Police, Role::Swat].iter().enumerate() {
  1285	                    let mut p = Vec3::new(curb.x + j as f32 * 2., 1., curb.z);
  1286	                    if self.world.blocked(p, 0.45) {
  1287	                        p = curb;
  1288	                    }
  1289	                    let mut npc = Npc::new(*role, p.x, p.z);
  1290	                    npc.pos.y = self.world.walking_surface(npc.pos) + 1.;
  1291	                    npc.home.y = npc.pos.y;
  1292	                    self.npcs.push(npc);
  1293	                }
  1294	                self.response = None;
  1295	                self.notify("POLICE AND SWAT ARRIVED - TASERS AND WEAPONS");
  1296	            }
  1297	            Outcome::None => {}
  1298	        }
  1299	        if let (Some(site), Some((route, id))) = (self.alarm.site, &self.response) {
  1300	            let t = (1. - self.alarm.remaining / 30.).clamp(0., 1.) * (route.len() - 1) as f32;
  1301	            let i = (t.floor() as usize).min(route.len() - 2);
  1302	            let a = route[i];
  1303	            let b = route[i + 1];
  1304	            let f = (t - i as f32).clamp(0., 1.);
  1305	            let car = &mut self.cars[*id];
  1306	            car.pos = Vec3::new(
  1307	                a.x + (b.x - a.x) * f,
  1308	                a.y + (b.y - a.y) * f + 0.65,
  1309	                a.z + (b.z - a.z) * f,
  1310	            );
  1311	            car.angle = (b.x - a.x).atan2(b.z - a.z);
  1312	            let _ = site;
  1313	        }
  1314	        if self
  1315	            .world
  1316	            .interior(self.player.pos)
  1317	            .is_some_and(|id| self.world.buildings[id].name == "Bank")
  1318	        {
  1319	            let p = self.player.pos;
  1320	            let beam = (p.z - 20.).rem_euclid(4.);
  1321	            if p.x > 313.
  1322	                && p.x < 327.
  1323	                && (20. ..=28.).contains(&p.z)
  1324	                && !(0.25..=3.75).contains(&beam)
  1325	                && p.y < 1.3
  1326	                && self.stance == 0
  1327	            {
  1328	                self.player.health = (self.player.health - 20. * STEP).max(0.);
  1329	            }
  1330	        }
  1331	        self.tick_npcs();
  1332	    }
  1333	    fn tick_npcs(&mut self) {
  1334	        let target = self.player.pos;
  1335	        let pursuit = self.wanted > 0 && self.player.team == Team::Criminal;
  1336	        let dispatched = self.alarm.dispatched
  1337	            || self.heists.dispatched
  1338	            || (self.alarm.site.is_none()
  1339	                && self.heists.site.is_none()
  1340	                && self.wanted >= 3
  1341	                && pursuit);
  1342	        if pursuit && dispatched {
  1343	            for (door, b) in self.doors.iter_mut().zip(&self.world.buildings) {
  1344	                if b.interior
  1345	                    && self.npcs.iter().any(|n| {
  1346	                        n.officer() && n.disabled <= 0. && n.pos.distance(b.entrance()) < 3.
  1347	                    })
  1348	                {
  1349	                    door.open = true;
  1350	                }
  1351	            }
  1352	        }
  1353	        let mut taser = false;
  1354	        let mut damage = 0.;
  1355	        let mut arrested = false;
  1356	        let mut caught_robbers = Vec::new();
  1357	        let robber_targets: Vec<(usize, Vec3)> = self
  1358	            .npcs
  1359	            .iter()
  1360	            .enumerate()
  1361	            .filter(|(_, n)| n.role == Role::Robber && n.disabled <= 0.)
  1362	            .map(|(i, n)| (i, n.pos))
  1363	            .collect();
  1364	        let world = &self.world;
  1365	        let doors = &self.doors;
  1366	        let breached = self.breached;
  1367	        for (i, n) in self.npcs.iter_mut().enumerate() {
  1368	            if n.pos.distance(target) > 220. {
  1369	                continue;
  1370	            }
  1371	            let visible_suspect = n.officer()
  1372	                && pursuit
  1373	                && n.pos.distance(target) < 24.
  1374	                && (n.pos.y - target.y).abs() < 2.
  1375	                && (1..=24).all(|j| {
  1376	                    let t = j as f32 / 24.;
  1377	                    let q = Vec3::new(
  1378	                        n.pos.x + (target.x - n.pos.x) * t,
  1379	                        n.pos.y,
  1380	                        n.pos.z + (target.z - n.pos.z) * t,
  1381	                    );
  1382	                    !world.blocked(q, 0.1)
  1383	                        && !world::prison::barrier(q, 0.1, breached)
  1384	                        && !doors
  1385	                            .iter()
  1386	                            .zip(&world.buildings)
  1387	                            .any(|(d, b)| d.blocked(b, q, 0.1))
  1388	                });
  1389	            let chasing = n.officer()
  1390	                && pursuit
  1391	                && ((self.wanted >= 3 && dispatched) || visible_suspect)
  1392	                && n.pos.distance(target) < 140.;
  1393	            let report = self
  1394	                .alarm
  1395	                .site
  1396	                .filter(|_| self.alarm.dispatched)
  1397	                .map(|id| SITES[id].center)
  1398	                .or_else(|| {
  1399	                    self.heists
  1400	                        .site
  1401	                        .filter(|_| self.heists.dispatched)
  1402	                        .map(|id| {
  1403	                            let s = crate::heists::SITES[id];
  1404	                            Vec3::new(s.x, world.surface(s.x, s.z) + 1., s.z)
  1405	                        })
  1406	                });
  1407	            let investigating = n.officer() && pursuit && !chasing && report.is_some();
  1408	            let hostile = n.role == Role::Robber
  1409	                && n.disabled <= 0.
  1410	                && self.player.team != Team::Prisoner
  1411	                && n.pos.distance(target) < 18.;
  1412	            let scared = n.role == Role::Resident && pursuit && n.pos.distance(target) < 16.;
  1413	            let criminal = if n.officer() && !chasing {
  1414	                robber_targets
  1415	                    .iter()
  1416	                    .filter(|(_, p)| p.distance(n.pos) < 20.)
  1417	                    .min_by(|a, b| a.1.distance(n.pos).total_cmp(&b.1.distance(n.pos)))
  1418	                    .copied()
  1419	            } else {
  1420	                None
  1421	            };
  1422	            let goal = if n.role == Role::Vendor {
  1423	                n.home
  1424	            } else if chasing || hostile {
  1425	                target
  1426	            } else if investigating {
  1427	                report.unwrap()
  1428	            } else if let Some((_, p)) = criminal {
  1429	                p
  1430	            } else if n.role == Role::Robber && (self.clock + i as f32 * 5.) % 45. < 18. {
  1431	                SITES[i % 3].center
  1432	            } else if scared {
  1433	                Vec3::new(
  1434	                    n.pos.x + (n.pos.x - target.x) * 2.,
  1435	                    1.,
  1436	                    n.pos.z + (n.pos.z - target.z) * 2.,
  1437	                )
  1438	            } else {
  1439	                Vec3::new(
  1440	                    n.home.x
  1441	                        + (self.clock * 0.12 + i as f32).sin()
  1442	                            * if n.role == Role::Prisoner { 3. } else { 8. },
  1443	                    1.,
  1444	                    n.home.z + (self.clock * 0.12 + i as f32).cos() * 3.,
  1445	                )
  1446	            };
  1447	            let goal = if chasing && i % 3 != 0 {
  1448	                if let Some(id) = world.interior(target) {
  1449	                    let entry = world.buildings[id].entrance();
  1450	                    Vec3::new(
  1451	                        entry.x + if i % 3 == 1 { -3. } else { 3. },
  1452	                        entry.y,
  1453	                        entry.z - 1.,
  1454	                    )
  1455	                } else {
  1456	                    target
  1457	                }
  1458	            } else if !chasing
  1459	                && !investigating
  1460	                && !scared
  1461	                && (n.role == Role::Resident
  1462	                    || (n.officer() && n.home.y < world.surface(n.home.x, n.home.z) + 3.))
  1463	            {
  1464	                crate::npcs::sidewalk_goal(world, n.home, self.clock, i)
  1465	            } else {
  1466	                goal
  1467	            };
  1468	            let old = n.pos;
  1469	            n.step(
  1470	                world,
  1471	                goal,
  1472	                if chasing || investigating || criminal.is_some() {
  1473	                    6.5
  1474	                } else if scared {
  1475	                    4.
  1476	                } else {
  1477	                    1.5
  1478	                },
  1479	                STEP,
  1480	            );
  1481	            if world::prison::barrier(n.pos, 0.45, breached)
  1482	                || doors
  1483	                    .iter()
  1484	                    .zip(&world.buildings)
  1485	                    .any(|(d, b)| d.blocked(b, n.pos, 0.45))
  1486	            {
  1487	                n.pos = old;
  1488	                n.plan = 0.5;
  1489	            }
  1490	            if n.disabled > 0. {
  1491	                continue;
  1492	            }
  1493	            if let Some((id, p)) = criminal {
  1494	                if n.pos.distance(p) < 2.
  1495	                    && (n.pos.y - p.y).abs() < 1.8
  1496	                    && (1..=8).all(|j| {
  1497	                        let t = j as f32 / 8.;
  1498	                        let q = Vec3::new(
  1499	                            n.pos.x + (p.x - n.pos.x) * t,
  1500	                            n.pos.y,
  1501	                            n.pos.z + (p.z - n.pos.z) * t,
  1502	                        );
  1503	                        !world.blocked(q, 0.1)
  1504	                            && !doors
  1505	                                .iter()
  1506	                                .zip(&world.buildings)
  1507	                                .any(|(door, b)| door.blocked(b, q, 0.1))
  1508	                    })
  1509	                {
  1510	                    caught_robbers.push(id);
  1511	                }
  1512	            }
  1513	            let d = n.pos.distance(target);
  1514	            let clear = chasing
  1515	                && d < 24.
  1516	                && (n.pos.y - target.y).abs() < 1.8
  1517	                && (1..=16).all(|j| {
  1518	                    let t = j as f32 / 16.;
  1519	                    let p = Vec3::new(
  1520	                        n.pos.x + (target.x - n.pos.x) * t,
  1521	                        n.pos.y,
  1522	                        n.pos.z + (target.z - n.pos.z) * t,
  1523	                    );
  1524	                    !world.blocked(p, 0.15)
  1525	                        && !world::prison::barrier(p, 0.15, breached)
  1526	                        && !doors
  1527	                            .iter()
  1528	                            .zip(&world.buildings)
  1529	                            .any(|(door, b)| door.blocked(b, p, 0.15))
  1530	                });
  1531	            if hostile
  1532	                && d < 2.
  1533	                && n.cooldown <= 0.
  1534	                && (n.pos.y - target.y).abs() < 1.5
  1535	                && !world.blocked(
  1536	                    Vec3::new(
  1537	                        (n.pos.x + target.x) / 2.,
  1538	                        n.pos.y,
  1539	                        (n.pos.z + target.z) / 2.,
  1540	                    ),
  1541	                    0.1,
  1542	                )
  1543	            {
  1544	                damage += 8.;
  1545	                n.cooldown = 1.2;
  1546	            }
  1547	            if chasing && clear && n.cooldown <= 0. && (d >= 10. || self.immunity <= 0.) {
  1548	                if d < 10. {
  1549	                    taser = true;
  1550	                    n.cooldown = 3.;
  1551	                } else if d < 24. {
  1552	                    damage += if n.role == Role::Swat { 14. } else { 8. };
  1553	                    n.cooldown = 1.5;
  1554	                }
  1555	            }
  1556	            if chasing
  1557	                && clear
  1558	                && d < 2.5
  1559	                && self.immunity <= 0.
  1560	                && (self.driving.is_none() || self.stun > 0.)
  1561	            {
  1562	                arrested = true;
  1563	            }
  1564	        }
  1565	        for id in caught_robbers {
  1566	            self.npcs[id].disabled = 60.;
  1567	        }
  1568	        if taser && self.immunity <= 0. {
  1569	            self.stun = 2.5;
  1570	        }
  1571	        self.player.health = (self.player.health - damage).max(0.);
  1572	        if self.player.health <= 0. {
  1573	            self.arrest();
  1574	        } else if arrested && !self.cuffs.active {
  1575	            self.cuffs.start(self.wanted.clamp(1, 5), &mut self.random);
  1576	            self.notify("CUFFED - SPACE WHEN MARKER IS IN TARGET");
  1577	        }
  1578	    }
  1579	    fn draw(&mut self, r: &mut Renderer) {
  1580	        self.capture_frame += 1;
  1581	        let p = self.player.pos;
  1582	        let dist = if world::prison::underground(p) {
  1583	            2.5
  1584	        } else if self.world.interior(p).is_some() {
  1585	            3.
  1586	        } else if let Some(id) = self.driving {
  1587	            9. + self.cars[id].speed.abs() * 0.045
  1588	        } else {
  1589	            7.
  1590	        };
  1591	        let mut eye = [
  1592	            p.x - self.yaw.sin() * dist,
  1593	            p.y + 1.5 + self.pitch.sin() * dist,
  1594	            p.z + self.yaw.cos() * dist,
  1595	        ];
  1596	        let pivot = [p.x, p.y + 0.3, p.z];
  1597	        let desired = eye;
  1598	        let mut clear = pivot;
  1599	        for i in 1..=20 {
  1600	            let t = i as f32 / 20.;
  1601	            let q = Vec3::new(
  1602	                pivot[0] + (desired[0] - pivot[0]) * t,
  1603	                pivot[1] + (desired[1] - pivot[1]) * t,
  1604	                pivot[2] + (desired[2] - pivot[2]) * t,
  1605	            );
  1606	            if self.blocked(q, 0.2) || q.y > self.world.ceiling(q).min(self.world.ceiling(p)) - 0.2
  1607	            {
  1608	                break;
  1609	            }
  1610	            clear = [q.x, q.y, q.z];
  1611	        }
  1612	        eye = clear;
  1613	        // Follow lag uses render delta; resolve collisions again so smoothing cannot cross a wall.
  1614	        if self.driving.is_some() {
  1615	            let prior = self.camera.unwrap_or(eye);
  1616	            let blend = (1. - (-6. / self.stats.fps.max(30.)).exp()).clamp(0.02, 0.3);

  2097	    fn draw_map(&self, r: &mut Renderer, rect: [f32; 4]) {
  2098	        r.rect(rect[0], rect[1], rect[2], rect[3], [0.14, 0.27, 0.21]);
  2099	        if let Some(view) = &self.view {
  2100	            r.texture_rect(view.map, rect);
  2101	        }
  2102	        for poi in &self.world.pois {
  2103	            let q = minimap::project(poi.p.x, poi.p.z, rect);
  2104	            r.rect(q[0] - 2., q[1] - 2., 4., 4., poi.color);
  2105	            if self.map
  2106	                && rect[2] > 300.
  2107	                && matches!(
  2108	                    poi.name,
  2109	                    "Bank"
  2110	                        | "Weapons"
  2111	                        | "Garage"
  2112	                        | "Prison"
  2113	                        | "Criminal Base"
  2114	                        | "Gym"
  2115	                        | "Safehouse"
  2116	                        | "Airport"
  2117	                        | "Industrial"
  2118	                        | "Jewelry"
  2119	                        | "Casino"
  2120	                        | "Museum"
  2121	                        | "Power Plant"
  2122	                        | "Gas Station"
  2123	                        | "Donut Shop"
  2124	                        | "Grocery"
  2125	                )
  2126	            {
  2127	                let offset = match poi.name {
  2128	                    "Safehouse" => 12.,
  2129	                    "Gym" => 25.,
  2130	                    _ => 0.,
  2131	                };
  2132	                text(r, q[0] + 5., q[1] + offset, 0.9, poi.name, WHITE);
  2133	            }
  2134	        }
  2135	        for n in &self.npcs {
  2136	            let q = minimap::project(n.pos.x, n.pos.z, rect);
  2137	            r.rect(q[0], q[1], 3., 3., [0.2, 0.4, 1.]);
  2138	        }
  2139	        if let Some(id) = self.alarm.site {
  2140	            let site = SITES[id];
  2141	            for i in 0..48 {
  2142	                let a = i as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU / 48.;
  2143	                let q = minimap::project(
  2144	                    site.center.x + a.sin() * site.radius,
  2145	                    site.center.z + a.cos() * site.radius,
  2146	                    rect,
  2147	                );
  2148	                r.rect(q[0], q[1], 2., 2., [1., 0.15, 0.1]);
  2149	            }
  2150	        }
  2151	        if let Some(w) = self.waypoint {
  2152	            let q = minimap::project(w.x, w.z, rect);
  2153	            r.rect(q[0] - 3., q[1] - 3., 6., 6., [0.4, 1., 0.8]);
  2154	        }
  2155	        let tip = minimap::project(
  2156	            self.player.pos.x + self.player.heading.sin() * 35.,
  2157	            self.player.pos.z + self.player.heading.cos() * 35.,
  2158	            rect,
  2159	        );
  2160	        r.rect(tip[0] - 1., tip[1] - 1., 2., 2., GOLD);
  2161	        let q = minimap::project(self.player.pos.x, self.player.pos.z, rect);
  2162	        r.rect(q[0] - 3., q[1] - 3., 6., 6., WHITE);
  2163	    }
  2164	}
  2165	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] // Render primitive parameters match the renderer API.
  2166	fn part(
  2167	    r: &mut Renderer,
  2168	    p: [f32; 3],
  2169	    size: [f32; 3],
  2170	    color: [f32; 3],
  2171	    a: f32,
  2172	    detail: bool,
  2173	    n: usize,
  2174	    round: f32,
  2175	) {
  2176	    if detail {
  2177	        r.rounded(p, size, color, a, n, round);
  2178	    } else {
  2179	        r.cube(p, size, color, a);
  2180	    }
  2181	}
  2182	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
  2183	fn draw_person(
  2184	    r: &mut Renderer,
  2185	    p: Vec3,
  2186	    a: f32,
  2187	    c: [f32; 3],
  2188	    t: f32,
  2189	    detail: bool,
  2190	    n: usize,
  2191	    motion: f32,
  2192	    action: f32,
  2193	    training: f32,
  2194	    stance: u8,
  2195	) {
  2196	    if stance == 2 {
  2197	        draw_crawler(r, p, a, c, t, motion);
  2198	        return;
  2199	    }
  2200	    let p = Vec3::new(p.x, p.y - if stance == 1 { 0.35 } else { 0. }, p.z);
  2201	    let bob = (t * 18.).cos() * 0.025 * motion;
  2202	    let local = |x: f32, y: f32, z: f32| {
  2203	        [
  2204	            p.x + x * a.cos() + z * a.sin(),
  2205	            p.y + y + bob,
  2206	            p.z - x * a.sin() + z * a.cos(),
  2207	        ]
  2208	    };
  2209	    // Original block avatar: flat faces, slight bevels, articulated elbows and knees.
  2210	    part(
  2211	        r,
  2212	        local(0., 0., 0.),
  2213	        [0.74, 0.8, 0.38],
  2214	        c,
  2215	        a,
  2216	        detail,
  2217	        n,
  2218	        0.16,
  2219	    );
  2220	    part(
  2221	        r,
  2222	        local(0., 0.68, 0.),
  2223	        [0.48, 0.49, 0.46],
  2224	        [0.76, 0.59, 0.42],
  2225	        a,
  2226	        detail,
  2227	        n,
  2228	        0.18,
  2229	    );
  2230	    if detail {
  2231	        part(
  2232	            r,
  2233	            local(0., 0.95, -0.02),
  2234	            [0.5, 0.14, 0.47],
  2235	            [0.18, 0.14, 0.1],
  2236	            a,
  2237	            true,
  2238	            n,
  2239	            0.12,
  2240	        );
  2241	        r.cube(
  2242	            local(0., -0.32, 0.2),
  2243	            [0.74, 0.08, 0.025],
  2244	            [0.12, 0.14, 0.15],
  2245	            a,
  2246	        );
  2247	        r.cube(
  2248	            local(0.2, 0.18, 0.2),
  2249	            [0.18, 0.16, 0.025],
  2250	            [c[0] * 0.7, c[1] * 0.7, c[2] * 0.7],
  2251	            a,
  2252	        );
  2253	        for x in [-0.1, 0.1] {
  2254	            r.cube(
  2255	                local(x, 0.72, 0.24),
  2256	                [0.045, 0.055, 0.025],
  2257	                [0.08, 0.07, 0.06],
  2258	                a,
  2259	            );
  2260	        }
  2261	        r.cube(
  2262	            local(0., 0.59, 0.241),
  2263	            [0.13, 0.023, 0.02],
  2264	            [0.24, 0.15, 0.11],
  2265	            a,
  2266	        );
  2267	    }
  2268	    let squat = if training > 0. {
  2269	        (training * 5.).sin().abs() * 0.18
  2270	    } else {
  2271	        0.
  2272	    };
  2273	    for side in [-1., 1.] {
  2274	        let swing = (t * 9.).sin() * 0.42 * side * motion;
  2275	        let hip = local(side * 0.19, -0.4 - squat, 0.);
  2276	        let knee = local(
  2277	            side * 0.19,
  2278	            -0.69 - squat + if stance == 1 { 0.25 } else { 0. },
  2279	            swing * 0.35 + if stance == 1 { 0.25 } else { 0. },
  2280	        );
  2281	        let foot = local(
  2282	            side * 0.19,
  2283	            -0.96 + if stance == 1 { 0.35 } else { 0. },
  2284	            swing * 0.6,
  2285	        );
  2286	        r.bone(hip, knee, 0.29, 0.3, a, [0.19, 0.22, 0.27]);
  2287	        r.bone(knee, foot, 0.27, 0.28, a, [0.16, 0.19, 0.24]);
  2288	        r.cube(
  2289	            [foot[0] + 0.04 * a.sin(), foot[1], foot[2] + 0.04 * a.cos()],
  2290	            [0.29, 0.13, 0.4],
  2291	            [0.08, 0.1, 0.12],
  2292	            a,
  2293	        );
  2294	        let reach = if side > 0. {
  2295	            action * 0.72
  2296	        } else {
  2297	            action * 0.25
  2298	        };
  2299	        let shoulder = local(side * 0.51, 0.28 - squat, 0.);
  2300	        let elbow = local(
  2301	            side * 0.5,
  2302	            -0.04 - squat + reach * 0.28,
  2303	            -swing * 0.16 + reach * 0.35,
  2304	        );
  2305	        let hand = local(
  2306	            side * 0.5,
  2307	            -0.4 - squat + reach * 0.5,
  2308	            -swing * 0.28 + reach,
  2309	        );
  2310	        r.bone(shoulder, elbow, 0.26, 0.28, a, c);
  2311	        r.bone(elbow, hand, 0.24, 0.25, a, c);
  2312	        part(
  2313	            r,
  2314	            hand,
  2315	            [0.24, 0.22, 0.25],
  2316	            [0.76, 0.59, 0.42],
  2317	            a,
  2318	            detail,
  2319	            n,
  2320	            0.18,
  2321	        );
  2322	    }
  2323	}
  2324	fn draw_weapon(r: &mut Renderer, p: Vec3, a: f32, swat: bool) {
  2325	    draw_weapon_model(r, p, a, if swat { 2 } else { 0 });
  2326	}
  2327	fn draw_car(r: &mut Renderer, c: &Car, color: [f32; 3], detail: bool, n: usize) {
  2328	    let p = c.pos;
  2329	    let a = c.angle;
  2330	    let length = match c.kind {
  2331	        1 => 3.65,
  2332	        3 => 4.5,
  2333	        4 => 5.1,
  2334	        5 => 4.8,
  2335	        _ => 4.5,
  2336	    };
  2337	    let local = |x: f32, y: f32, z: f32| {
  2338	        [
  2339	            p.x + x * a.cos() + z * a.sin(),
  2340	            p.y + y,
  2341	            p.z - x * a.sin() + z * a.cos(),
  2342	        ]
  2343	    };
  2344	    thread_local! { static BODIES: Vec<engine_core::Mesh> = (0..CATALOG.len()).map(vehicles::body::mesh).collect(); }
  2345	    BODIES.with(|b| r.solid_model(&b[c.kind], [p.x, p.y, p.z], a, color));
  2346	    for x in [-1.02, 1.02] {
  2347	        for z in [-length * 0.31, length * 0.31] {
  2348	            part(
  2349	                r,

  2355	                n,

  2357	            );
  2358	            if detail {

  2365	                    true,
  2366	                    n,

  2369	            }
  2370	        }
  2371	    }
  2372	    for x in [-0.68, 0.68] {

  2376	            [0.46, 0.18, 0.12],

  2379	            detail,
  2380	            n,
  2381	            0.6,

  2383	        part(

  2385	            local(x, 0.4, -length / 2. - 0.02),
  2386	            [0.46, 0.18, 0.12],
  2387	            [0.8, 0.08, 0.05],
  2388	            a,
  2389	            detail,
  2390	            n,
  2391	            0.6,
  2392	        );
  2393	        if detail {
  2394	            part(
  2395	                r,
  2396	                local(x.signum() * 1.02, 0.86, 0.5),
  2397	                [0.2, 0.12, 0.24],
  2398	                color,
  2399	                a,
  2400	                true,
  2401	                n,
  2402	                0.6,
  2403	            );
  2404	        }
  2405	    }
  2406	    if detail {
  2407	        r.cube(
  2408	            local(0., 0.35, length / 2. + 0.03),
  2409	            [0.85, 0.23, 0.07],
  2410	            [0.14, 0.16, 0.18],
  2411	            a,
  2412	        );
  2413	    }
  2414	    if detail && matches!(c.kind, 0..=2) {
  2415	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
  2416	            if c.kind == 1 {
  2417	                r.cube(
  2418	                    local(side * 0.7, 0.67, length / 2. - 0.3),
  2419	                    [0.45, 0.35, 0.45],
  2420	                    color,
  2421	                    a,
  2422	                );
  2423	            }
  2424	            for dx in [0.48, 0.78] {
  2425	                r.rounded(
  2426	                    local(side * dx, 0.48, length / 2. + 0.09),
  2427	                    [0.22, 0.22, 0.07],
  2428	                    [1., 0.9, 0.45],
  2429	                    a,
  2430	                    6,
  2431	                    1.,
  2432	                );
  2433	            }
  2434	        }
  2435	    }
  2436	    if c.kind == 2 {
  2437	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
  2438	            part(
  2439	                r,
  2440	                local(side * 0.45, 1.42, -0.2),
  2441	                [0.4, 0.15, 0.25],
  2442	                if side < 0. {
  2443	                    [0.9, 0.1, 0.08]
  2444	                } else {
  2445	                    [0.1, 0.25, 0.95]
  2446	                },
  2447	                a,
  2448	                detail,
  2449	                n,

  2452	        }
  2453	    }
  2454	    if detail {
