  2456	            local(0., 0.18, length / 2. + 0.04),
  2457	            [1.3, 0.17, 0.06],
  2458	            [0.1, 0.12, 0.14],
  2459	            a,
  2460	        );
  2461	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
  2462	            r.cube(
  2463	                local(side * 1.04, 0.6, 0.),
  2464	                [0.025, 0.4, 0.025],
  2465	                [0.11, 0.14, 0.16],
  2466	                a,

  2478	                a,
  2479	            );
  2480	            r.cube(

  2482	                [0.22, 0.12, 0.16],
  2483	                [0.2, 0.22, 0.22],
  2484	                a,
  2485	            );

  2488	}

  2661	        if scene == "alarm" {
  2662	            g.player.pos = Vec3::new(110., 1., 234.);
  2663	            g.alarm.start(1);
  2664	            g.alarm.hits[1] = 2;
  2665	            g.player.team = Team::Criminal;
  2666	            g.wanted = 3;
  2667	            g.prepare_response(1);
  2668	        }
  2669	        if scene == "map" {
  2670	            g.map = true;
  2671	        }
  2672	        if scene == "service" {
  2673	            g.player.pos = Vec3::new(430., 1., -70.);
  2674	            g.cars[0].pos = g.player.pos;
  2675	            g.workshop = Some(0);
  2676	        }
  2677	        if scene == "training" {
  2678	            g.training = true;
  2679	        }
  2680	        if scene == "driving" {
  2681	            g.driving = Some(0);
  2682	            g.player.pos = g.cars[0].pos;
  2683	            g.cars[0].speed = 15.;
  2684	        }
  2685	        if scene == "graphics" {
  2686	            g.garage = true;
  2687	        }
  2688	    }
  2689	
  2690	    if smoke {
  2691	        g.menu = std::env::var("JAILBREAK_SCENE").as_deref() == Ok("menu");
  2692	        g.debug = std::env::var("JAILBREAK_DEBUG").as_deref() != Ok("0");
  2693	    }
  2694	    let mut last = std::time::Instant::now();
  2695	    let mut accumulator = 0.;
  2696	    if std::env::var("JAILBREAK_TIME").as_deref() == Ok("night") {
  2697	        g.clock = std::f32::consts::PI * 120.;
  2698	    }
  2699	    g.capture_at =
  2700	        if g.modal() || std::env::var("JAILBREAK_SCENE").is_ok_and(|s| s.ends_with("-new")) {
  2701	            g.clock
  2702	        } else {
  2703	            g.clock + 3.
  2704	        };
  2705	    let frame_limit = std::env::var("JAILBREAK_FRAMES")
  2706	        .ok()
  2707	        .and_then(|s| s.parse::<usize>().ok())
  2708	        .unwrap_or(480)
  2709	        .clamp(60, 2000);
  2710	    let mut timings = Vec::with_capacity(if smoke { frame_limit } else { 0 });
  2711	    let tour = smoke && std::env::var("JAILBREAK_SCENE").as_deref() == Ok("tour");
  2712	    let mut frames = 0;
  2713	    let mut running = true;
  2714	    while running {
  2715	        let frame_start = std::time::Instant::now();
  2716	        if tour {
  2717	            let x = (-520. + frames as f32 * 2.5).min(840.);
  2718	            g.player.pos = Vec3::new(x, g.world.surface(x, 0.) + 1., 0.);
  2719	            g.player.team = Team::Criminal;
  2720	            g.yaw = std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
  2721	        }
  2722	
  2723	        while let Some(e) = r.poll() {
  2724	            match e.kind() {
  2725	                0x100 => running = false,
  2726	                0x400 => {
  2727	                    if !g.modal() && !g.cursor {
  2728	                        let (x, y) = e.motion();
  2729	                        g.yaw += x as f32 * g.save.sensitivity;
  2730	                        g.pitch = (g.pitch + y as f32 * g.save.sensitivity).clamp(-0.1, 0.9);
  2731	                    }
  2732	                }
  2733	                0x401 => {
  2734	                    let (x, y) = e.click();
  2735	                    let x = x as f32 * 1024. / r.width as f32;
  2736	                    let y = y as f32 * 576. / r.height as f32;
  2737	                    if g.modal() || g.cursor {
  2738	                        g.ui_click(x, y);
  2739	                    } else {
  2740	                        g.fire();
  2741	                    }
  2742	                    r.capture(!g.modal() && !g.cursor);
  2743	                }
  2744	                0x300 if !e.repeat() => {
  2745	                    let k = e.key();
  2746	                    running = g.key_action(k);
  2747	                    r.capture(!g.modal() && !g.cursor);
  2748	                }
  2749	                _ => {}
  2750	            }
  2751	        }
  2752	        let now = std::time::Instant::now();
  2753	        accumulator += (now - last).as_secs_f32().min(0.1);
  2754	        last = now;
  2755	        let update_start = std::time::Instant::now();
  2756	        while accumulator >= STEP {
  2757	            g.update(&r);
  2758	            accumulator -= STEP;
  2759	        }
  2760	        g.stats.update_ms = update_start.elapsed().as_secs_f32() * 1000.;
  2761	        let render_start = std::time::Instant::now();
  2762	        g.draw(&mut r);
  2763	        g.stats.render_ms = render_start.elapsed().as_secs_f32() * 1000.;
  2764	        if smoke {
  2765	            timings.push(frame_start.elapsed().as_secs_f32() * 1000.);
  2766	        }
  2767	        if smoke {
  2768	            r.validate()?;
  2769	        }
  2770	        frames += 1;
  2771	        if smoke && frames >= frame_limit {
  2772	            running = false;
  2773	        }
  2774	        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(1));
  2775	    }
  2776	    r.validate()?;
  2777	    if smoke {
  2778	        timings.sort_by(|a, b| a.total_cmp(b));
  2779	        let mean = timings.iter().sum::<f32>() / timings.len() as f32;
  2780	        let p95 = timings[(timings.len() as f32 * 0.95) as usize];
  2781	        let maximum = timings.last().copied().unwrap_or(0.);
  2782	        if let Some(v) = &g.view {
  2783	            println!(
  2784	                "GEOMETRY scene_triangles={} world_triangles={} interior_triangles={} quality={} vehicles={} actors_and_effects={}",
  2785	                g.scene_triangles, v.submitted_triangles, v.interior_triangles, g.save.quality, g.vehicle_triangles, g.npc_triangles
  2786	            );
  2787	            println!("PROFILE scene={} frames={} mean_ms={:.2} p95_ms={:.2} max_ms={:.2} rss_mb={:.1} gpu_mb={:.1} active_chunks={} visible_chunks={} effective_distance={:.0}",std::env::var("JAILBREAK_SCENE").unwrap_or_else(|_|"prison".into()),frames,mean,p95,maximum,profiling::rss_mb(),v.bytes as f32/1048576.,v.active(),v.visible,v.effective_distance);
  2788	        }
  2789	    }
  2790	    g.view.take();
  2791	    if !smoke {
  2792	        g.save();
  2793	    }
  2794	    println!(
  2795	        "Rendered {frames} frames; observed {:.1} FPS (host only)",
  2796	        g.stats.fps
  2797	    );
  2798	    Ok(())
  2799	}

  2802	    c.engine_level = if s.car_engine_selected[c.kind] == u32::MAX {
  2803	        s.car_engine[c.kind]
  2804	    } else {

  2806	    };
  2807	    c.brake_level = s.car_brakes[c.kind];
  2808	    c.suspension_level = s.car_suspension[c.kind];
  2809	    if s.car_paint[c.kind] != [0.; 3] {
  2810	        c.color = s.car_paint[c.kind];
  2811	    }
  2812	}

    61	#[derive(Default)]
    62	pub struct Heists {
    63	    pub site: Option<usize>,
    64	    pub cooldown: [f32; 6],
    65	    pub elapsed: f32,
    66	    pub progress: f32,
    67	    pub bag: u32,
    68	    pub solved: u32,
    69	    pub quiz: bool,
    70	    pub answer: String,
    71	    pub expression: String,
    72	    pub expected: i32,
    73	    pub dispatched: bool,
    74	    pub strikes: u32,
    75	    pub bomb: f32,
    76	    pub opened: bool,
    77	    pub train_gold: [usize; 3],
    78	    pub train_count: usize,
    79	    pub riding: Option<usize>,
    80	    random: u64,
    81	}
    82	impl Heists {
    83	    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
    84	        let mut s = Self {
    85	            random: seed,
    86	            ..Default::default()
    87	        };
    88	        s.train_count = (s.next() % 3 + 1) as usize;
    89	        for i in 0..s.train_count {
    90	            loop {
    91	                let n = s.next() as usize % 25;
    92	                if !s.train_gold[..i].contains(&n) {
    93	                    s.train_gold[i] = n;
    94	                    break;
    95	                }
    96	            }
    97	        }
    98	        s
    99	    }
   100	    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
   101	        self.random = self
   102	            .random
   103	            .wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005)
   104	            .wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
   105	        self.random >> 32
   106	    }
   107	    pub fn start(&mut self, id: usize) -> bool {
   108	        if id >= 6 || self.site.is_some() || self.bag > 0 || self.cooldown[id] > 0. {
   109	            return false;
   110	        }
   111	        self.site = Some(id);
   112	        self.elapsed = 0.;
   113	        self.progress = 0.;
   114	        self.solved = 0;
   115	        self.strikes = 0;
   116	        self.dispatched = false;
   117	        self.opened = id != 5;
   118	        true
   119	    }
   120	    pub fn question(&mut self) {
   121	        let a = (self.next() % 12 + 2) as i32;
   122	        let x = (self.next() % 20 + 1) as i32;
   123	        let b = (self.next() % 30 + 1) as i32;
   124	        self.expected = x;
   125	        self.expression = match self.next() % 3 {
   126	            0 => format!("{} * x + {} = {}", a, b, a * x + b),
   127	            1 => {
   128	                self.expected = x * a;
   129	                format!("x / {} + {} = {}", a, b, x + b)
   130	            }
   131	            _ => format!("x + {} = {}", b, x + b),
   132	        };
   133	        self.answer.clear();
   134	        self.quiz = true;
   135	    }
   136	    pub fn submit(&mut self) -> bool {
   137	        if self.answer.parse::<i32>().ok() != Some(self.expected) {
   138	            self.answer.clear();
   139	            return false;
   140	        }
   141	        self.solved += 1;
   142	        let n = self.site.map(|id| SITES[id].questions).unwrap_or(0);
   143	        if self.solved >= n {
   144	            self.quiz = false;
   145	        } else {
   146	            self.question();
   147	        }
   148	        true
   149	    }
   150	    pub fn tick(&mut self, dt: f32) {
   151	        for c in &mut self.cooldown {
   152	            *c = (*c - dt).max(0.);
   153	        }
   154	        if self.site.is_some() {
   155	            self.elapsed += dt;
   156	        }
   157	        if self.bomb > 0. {
   158	            self.bomb = (self.bomb - dt).max(0.);
   159	            if self.bomb == 0. {
   160	                self.opened = true;
   161	            }
   162	        }
   163	    }
   164	    pub fn finish(&mut self) {
   165	        if let Some(id) = self.site {
   166	            self.cooldown[id] = 300. + (self.next() % 601) as f32;
   167	        }
   168	        self.site = None;
   169	        self.quiz = false;
   170	        self.progress = 0.;
   171	        self.strikes = 0;
   172	        self.riding = None;
   173	    }
   174	    pub fn train(clock: f32, wagon: usize) -> (Vec3, f32) {
   175	        let a = clock * 0.014 - wagon as f32 * 0.013;
   176	        let x = 800. * a.cos();
   177	        let z = 750. * a.sin();
   178	        let y = terrain::height(x, z).max(0.) + 1.;
   179	        (Vec3::new(x, y, z), (-800. * a.sin()).atan2(750. * a.cos()))
   180	    }
   181	    pub fn gold(&self, wagon: usize) -> bool {
   182	        self.train_gold[..self.train_count].contains(&wagon)
   183	    }
   184	}
   185	#[cfg(test)]
   186	mod tests {
   187	    use super::*;
   188	    #[test]
   189	    fn questions_are_solvable_and_gate_completion() {
   190	        let mut h = Heists::new(9);
   191	        h.start(2);
   192	        for _ in 0..7 {
   193	            h.question();
   194	            h.answer = "-1".into();
   195	            assert!(!h.submit());
   196	            h.answer = h.expected.to_string();
   197	            assert!(h.submit());
   198	        }
   199	        assert_eq!(h.solved, 7);
   200	        assert!(!h.quiz);
   201	    }
   202	    #[test]
   203	    fn cooldown_and_gold() {
   204	        for seed in 1..20 {
   205	            let mut h = Heists::new(seed);
   206	            assert!((1..=3).contains(&h.train_count));
   207	            assert_eq!((0..25).filter(|i| h.gold(*i)).count(), h.train_count);
   208	            assert!(h.start(5));
   209	            h.finish();
   210	            assert!((300. ..=900.).contains(&h.cooldown[5]));
   211	            assert!(!h.start(5));
   212	        }
   213	    }
   214	}

   523	    fn buy_ammo(&mut self) {
   524	        let id = self.weapon_selection;
   525	        if !self.save.weapon_owned[id] || self.save.balance < 50 {
   526	            self.notify("BUY THE WEAPON FIRST / NEED $50");
   527	            return;
   528	        }
   529	        let current = if self.pistol.kind == id {
   530	            self.pistol.reserve
   531	        } else {
   532	            self.save.ammunition[id]
   533	        };
   534	        if current >= weapons::CATALOG[id].reserve + self.save.carry_level * 24 {
   535	            self.notify("AMMO BAG FULL - NO CHARGE");
   536	            return;
   537	        }
   538	        self.save.balance -= 50;
   539	        let count = weapons::CATALOG[id].reserve;
   540	        self.save.ammunition[id] =
   541	            (self.save.ammunition[id] + count).min(count + self.save.carry_level * 24);
   542	        if self.pistol.kind == id {
   543	            self.pistol.reserve =
   544	                (self.pistol.reserve + count).min(count + self.save.carry_level * 24);
   545	        }
   546	        self.notify("AMMUNITION PURCHASED");
   547	    }
   548	}
   549	fn modal_title(r: &mut Renderer, title: &str) {

   578	fn draw_weapon_model(r: &mut Renderer, p: Vec3, a: f32, kind: usize) {

   613	            [0.3, 0.21, 0.13],
   614	            a,
   615	        );
   616	        r.cube(

   637	}
   638	fn draw_crawler(r: &mut Renderer, p: Vec3, a: f32, c: [f32; 3], t: f32, motion: f32) {
   639	    let local = |x: f32, y: f32, z: f32| {
   640	        [
   641	            p.x + x * a.cos() + z * a.sin(),
   642	            p.y + y,
   643	            p.z - x * a.sin() + z * a.cos(),
   644	        ]
   645	    };
   646	    r.bone(
   647	        local(0., -0.65, -0.3),
   648	        local(0., -0.65, 0.35),
   649	        0.74,
   650	        0.32,
   651	        a,
   652	        c,
   653	    );
   654	    r.cube(
   655	        local(0., -0.57, 0.55),
   656	        [0.46, 0.43, 0.45],
   657	        [0.76, 0.59, 0.42],
   658	        a,
   659	    );
   660	    for side in [-1., 1.] {
   661	        let swing = (t * 8.).sin() * side * motion * 0.18;
   662	        r.bone(
   663	            local(side * 0.22, -0.68, -0.25),
   664	            local(side * 0.24, -0.84, -0.95 + swing),
   665	            0.24,
   666	            0.25,
   667	            a,
   668	            [0.16, 0.19, 0.25],
   669	        );
   670	        r.bone(
   671	            local(side * 0.5, -0.63, 0.2),
   672	            local(side * 0.55, -0.85, 0.75 - swing),
   673	            0.23,
   674	            0.23,
   675	            a,
   676	            c,
   677	        );
   678	    }
   679	}

     4	pub enum Role {
     5	    Resident,
     6	    Vendor,
     7	    Robber,
     8	    Prisoner,
     9	    Police,
    10	    Swat,
    11	}
    12	pub struct Npc {
    13	    pub pos: Vec3,
    14	    pub home: Vec3,
    15	    pub heading: f32,
    16	    pub role: Role,
    17	    pub phase: f32,
    18	    pub motion: f32,
    19	    pub cooldown: f32,
    20	    pub waypoint: Vec3,
    21	    pub plan: f32,
    22	    pub health: f32,
    23	    pub disabled: f32,
    24	}
    25	impl Npc {
    26	    pub fn new(role: Role, x: f32, z: f32) -> Self {
    27	        let p = Vec3::new(x, 1., z);
    28	        Self {
    29	            pos: p,
    30	            home: p,
    31	            heading: 0.,
    32	            role,
    33	            phase: 0.,
    34	            motion: 0.,
    35	            cooldown: 0.,
    36	            waypoint: p,
    37	            plan: ((x * 0.137 + z * 0.071).abs() % 1.5) + 0.1,
    38	            health: 100.,
    39	            disabled: 0.,
    40	        }
    41	    }
    42	    pub fn color(&self) -> [f32; 3] {
    43	        match self.role {
    44	            Role::Resident => match (self.home.x as i32 / 50).rem_euclid(4) {
    45	                0 => [0.32, 0.62, 0.46],
    46	                1 => [0.4, 0.45, 0.68],
    47	                2 => [0.65, 0.48, 0.29],
    48	                _ => [0.55, 0.58, 0.6],
    49	            },
    50	            Role::Vendor => [0.86, 0.83, 0.7],
    51	            Role::Robber => [0.6, 0.12, 0.18],
    52	            Role::Prisoner => [0.92, 0.4, 0.1],
    53	            Role::Police => [0.12, 0.25, 0.48],
    54	            Role::Swat => [0.12, 0.16, 0.18],
    55	        }
    56	    }
    57	    pub fn officer(&self) -> bool {
    58	        matches!(self.role, Role::Police | Role::Swat)
    59	    }
    60	    pub fn step(&mut self, world: &World, goal: Vec3, speed: f32, dt: f32) {
    61	        self.cooldown = (self.cooldown - dt).max(0.);
    62	        self.disabled = (self.disabled - dt).max(0.);
    63	        if self.disabled > 0. {
    64	            return;
    65	        }
    66	        if self.health <= 0. {
    67	            self.disabled = 45.;
    68	            self.health = 100.;
    69	            self.pos = self.home;
    70	            return;
    71	        }
    72	        self.plan -= dt;
    73	        if self.plan <= 0. {
    74	            self.waypoint = goal;
    75	            self.plan = 1.5;
    76	        }
    77	        let dx = self.waypoint.x - self.pos.x;
    78	        let dz = self.waypoint.z - self.pos.z;
    79	        let len = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt().max(0.001);
    80	        let d = (speed * dt).min(len);
    81	        let mut p = Vec3::new(
    82	            self.pos.x + dx / len * d,
    83	            self.pos.y,
    84	            self.pos.z + dz / len * d,
    85	        );
    86	        p.y = world.walking_surface(p) + 1.;
    87	        if !world.blocked(p, 0.45) && (p.y - self.pos.y).abs() < 0.6 && self.pos.distance(p) > 0.001
    88	        {
    89	            let target = dx.atan2(dz);
    90	            let delta = (target - self.heading)
    91	                .sin()
    92	                .atan2((target - self.heading).cos());
    93	            self.heading += delta * (dt * 10.).min(1.);
    94	            self.pos = p;
    95	            self.phase += dt * speed / 6.;
    96	            self.motion += (1. - self.motion) * (dt * 10.).min(1.);
    97	        } else {
    98	            self.phase += dt * 0.3;
    99	            self.motion += (0. - self.motion) * (dt * 10.).min(1.);
   100	        }
   101	    }
   102	}
   103	pub fn population() -> Vec<Npc> {

   152	
   153	pub fn sidewalk_goal(world: &World, home: Vec3, clock: f32, id: usize) -> Vec3 {
   154	    let Some(road) = world
   155	        .roads
   156	        .iter()
   157	        .min_by(|a, b| a.distance(home).0.total_cmp(&b.distance(home).0))
   158	    else {
   159	        return home;
   160	    };
   161	    let nearest = road
   162	        .points
   163	        .iter()
   164	        .enumerate()
   165	        .min_by(|(_, a), (_, b)| a.distance(home).total_cmp(&b.distance(home)))
   166	        .map(|(i, _)| i)
   167	        .unwrap_or(0);
   168	    let phase = ((clock / 12.) as usize + id) % 8;
   169	    let offset = if phase < 4 { phase } else { 7 - phase };
   170	    let i = (nearest + offset).min(road.points.len() - 1);
   171	    let q = road.points[i];
   172	    let (nx, nz) = road.normal(i);
   173	    let side = if id.is_multiple_of(2) { 1. } else { -1. };
   174	    Vec3::new(
   175	        q.x + nx * (road.width / 2. + 1.) * side,
   176	        q.y + 1.,
   177	        q.z + nz * (road.width / 2. + 1.) * side,
   178	    )
   179	}

  [62/133] –§–ê–ô–õ: ./game/src/world_view.rs

     1	use engine_core::Vec3;
     2	use renderer_gl21::{GpuMesh, Renderer, Texture};
     3	use std::{
     4	    collections::{HashMap, HashSet},
     5	    sync::Arc,
     6	};
     7	use world::{cell, Streamer, World, CHUNK};
     8	struct Resident {
     9	    lod: u8,
    10	    mesh: GpuMesh,
    11	}
    12	pub struct WorldView {
    13	    world: Arc<World>,
    14	    stream: Streamer,
    15	    resident: HashMap<(i32, i32), Resident>,
    16	    pending: HashSet<((i32, i32), u8)>,
    17	    pub map: Texture,
    18	    interior: Option<((usize, usize), GpuMesh)>,
    19	    pub submitted_triangles: usize,
    20	    pub interior_triangles: usize,
    21	    roofs: HashMap<usize, GpuMesh>,
    22	    pub visible: usize,
    23	    pub bytes: usize,
    24	    pub effective_distance: f32,
    25	    visible_meshes: Vec<(f32, GpuMesh)>,
    26	    pub occluded: usize,
    27	}
    28	impl WorldView {
    29	    pub fn new(world: Arc<World>, r: &mut Renderer, p: Vec3, distance: f32) -> Self {
    30	        let map = r.texture(256, 256, &world.navigation_image());
    31	        let stream = Streamer::new(world.clone());
    32	        let mut resident = HashMap::new();
    33	        let center = cell(p.x, p.z);
    34	        for dx in -1..=1 {
    35	            for dz in -1..=1 {
    36	                let key = (center.0 + dx, center.1 + dz);
    37	                let d =
    38	                    ((key.0 as f32 + 0.5) * CHUNK - p.x).hypot((key.1 as f32 + 0.5) * CHUNK - p.z);
    39	                let lod = chunk_lod(distance, d);
    40	                let mesh = r.upload(&world.chunk(key, lod));
    41	                resident.insert(key, Resident { lod, mesh });
    42	            }
    43	        }
    44	        Self {
    45	            world,
    46	            stream,
    47	            resident,
    48	            pending: HashSet::new(),
    49	            map,
    50	            interior: None,
    51	            submitted_triangles: 0,
    52	            interior_triangles: 0,
    53	            roofs: HashMap::new(),
    54	            visible: 0,
    55	            bytes: 0,
    56	            effective_distance: distance,
    57	            visible_meshes: Vec::with_capacity(256),
    58	            occluded: 0,
    59	        }
    60	    }
    61	    pub fn update(&mut self, r: &mut Renderer, p: Vec3, distance: f32, fps: f32) {
    62	        let target = if fps > 0. && fps < 32. {
    63	            distance * 0.8
    64	        } else {
    65	            distance
    66	        };
    67	        self.effective_distance += (target - self.effective_distance) * 0.005;
    68	        self.effective_distance = self.effective_distance.clamp(128., distance.max(128.));
    69	        let center = cell(p.x, p.z);
    70	        let radius = (self.effective_distance / CHUNK).ceil() as i32 + 1;
    71	        self.resident.retain(|key, value| {
    72	            let keep =
    73	                (key.0 - center.0).abs() <= radius + 1 && (key.1 - center.1).abs() <= radius + 1;
    74	            if !keep {
    75	                r.release(value.mesh);
    76	            }
    77	            keep
    78	        });
    79	        let start = std::time::Instant::now();
    80	        for _ in 0..2 {
    81	            let Some(data) = self.stream.poll() else {
    82	                break;
    83	            };
    84	            self.pending.remove(&(data.key, data.lod));
    85	            if (data.key.0 - center.0).abs() <= radius + 1
    86	                && (data.key.1 - center.1).abs() <= radius + 1
    87	            {
    88	                let mesh = r.upload(&data.mesh);
    89	                if let Some(old) = self.resident.insert(
    90	                    data.key,
    91	                    Resident {
    92	                        lod: data.lod,
    93	                        mesh,
    94	                    },
    95	                ) {
    96	                    r.release(old.mesh);
    97	                }
    98	            }
    99	            self.stream.recycle(data.mesh);
   100	            if start.elapsed().as_millis() >= 3 {
   101	                break;
   102	            }
   103	        }
   104	        // Request near rings first; bounded channel prevents unbounded generation work.
   105	        for ring in 0..=radius {
   106	            for dx in -ring..=ring {
   107	                for dz in -ring..=ring {
   108	                    if dx.abs() != ring && dz.abs() != ring {
   109	                        continue;
   110	                    }
   111	                    let key = (center.0 + dx, center.1 + dz);
   112	                    if key.0 < -8 || key.0 >= 8 || key.1 < -8 || key.1 >= 8 {
   113	                        continue;
   114	                    }
   115	                    let d = Vec3::new(
   116	                        (key.0 as f32 + 0.5) * CHUNK,
   117	                        0.,
   118	                        (key.1 as f32 + 0.5) * CHUNK,
   119	                    )
   120	                    .distance(p);
   121	                    if d > self.effective_distance + CHUNK {
   122	                        continue;
   123	                    }
   124	                    let lod = chunk_lod(distance, d);
   125	                    if self.resident.get(&key).is_some_and(|c| c.lod == lod)
   126	                        || self.pending.iter().any(|v| v.0 == key)
   127	                    {
   128	                        continue;
   129	                    }
   130	                    if self.stream.request(key, lod) {
   131	                        self.pending.insert((key, lod));
   132	                    }
   133	                }
   134	            }
   135	        }
   136	        let inside = interior_key(&self.world, p);
   137	        if self.interior.as_ref().map(|i| i.0) != inside {
   138	            if let Some((_, old)) = self.interior.take() {
   139	                r.release(old);
   140	            }
   141	            if let Some((id, floor)) = inside {
   142	                let mesh = if id == usize::MAX {
   143	                    world::prison::sewer_mesh()
   144	                } else {
   145	                    self.world.buildings[id].interior_mesh_at(floor)
   146	                };
   147	                self.interior = Some(((id, floor), r.upload(&mesh)));
   148	            }
   149	        }
   150	        // Interior cameras stay below the ceiling; keep the roof for enclosed rooms.
   151	        for b in &self.world.buildings {
   152	            if !b.interior {
   153	                continue;
   154	            }
   155	            let wanted = b.p.distance(p) < self.effective_distance;
   156	            if wanted && !self.roofs.contains_key(&b.id) {
   157	                self.roofs.insert(b.id, r.upload(&b.roof_mesh()));
   158	            } else if !wanted {
   159	                if let Some(mesh) = self.roofs.remove(&b.id) {
   160	                    r.release(mesh);
   161	                }
   162	            }
   163	        }
   164	        self.interior_triangles = self
   165	            .interior
   166	            .as_ref()
   167	            .map_or(0, |(_, m)| m.vertices as usize / 3);
   168	        self.bytes = self.resident.values().map(|v| v.mesh.bytes).sum::<usize>()
   169	            + self.roofs.values().map(|v| v.bytes).sum::<usize>()
   170	            + self.interior.as_ref().map_or(0, |i| i.1.bytes);
   171	    }
   172	    pub fn draw(&mut self, r: &mut Renderer, eye: [f32; 3], yaw: f32, pitch: f32) {
   173	        let triangles_before = r.triangles;
   174	        r.fog(self.effective_distance);
   175	        self.visible = 0;
   176	        if self
   177	            .interior
   178	            .as_ref()
   179	            .is_some_and(|((id, _), _)| *id == usize::MAX)
   180	        {
   181	            if let Some((_, mesh)) = self.interior {
   182	                r.mesh(mesh);
   183	            }
   184	            self.submitted_triangles = r.triangles - triangles_before;
   185	            return;
   186	        }
   187	
   188	        let aspect = r.width as f32 / r.height.max(1) as f32;
   189	        self.visible_meshes.clear();
   190	        self.occluded = 0;
   191	        for (key, c) in &self.resident {
   192	            let center = [
   193	                (key.0 as f32 + 0.5) * CHUNK,
   194	                35.,
   195	                (key.1 as f32 + 0.5) * CHUNK,
   196	            ];
   197	            if !sphere_visible(
   198	                center,
   199	                125.,
   200	                eye,
   201	                yaw,
   202	                pitch,
   203	                aspect,
   204	                self.effective_distance,
   205	            ) {
   206	                continue;
   207	            }
   208	            let distance = (center[0] - eye[0]).hypot(center[2] - eye[2]);
   209	            let hidden = distance > 256.
   210	                && self
   211	                    .world
   212	                    .buildings
   213	                    .iter()
   214	                    .filter(|b| !b.interior && b.p.distance(Vec3::new(eye[0], 0., eye[2])) < 100.)
   215	                    .any(|b| {
   216	                        let min = [b.p.x - b.size.x / 2., b.p.y, b.p.z - b.size.z / 2.];
   217	                        let max = [
   218	                            b.p.x + b.size.x / 2.,
   219	                            b.p.y + b.size.y,
   220	                            b.p.z + b.size.z / 2.,
   221	                        ];
   222	                        [-64., 64.].into_iter().all(|dx| {
   223	                            [-64., 64.].into_iter().all(|dz| {
   224	                                [-8., 190.].into_iter().all(|y| {
   225	                                    occluded_ray(eye, [center[0] + dx, y, center[2] + dz], min, max)
   226	                                })
   227	                            })
   228	                        })
   229	                    });
   230	            if hidden {
   231	                self.occluded += 1;
   232	                continue;
   233	            }
   234	            self.visible_meshes.push((distance, c.mesh));
   235	        }
   236	        self.visible_meshes
   237	            .sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
   238	        for (_, mesh) in &self.visible_meshes {
   239	            r.mesh(*mesh);
   240	            self.visible += 1;
   241	        }
   242	        for (id, mesh) in &self.roofs {
   243	            let b = &self.world.buildings[*id];
   244	            let center = [b.p.x, b.p.y + b.size.y, b.p.z];
   245	            let radius = b.size.x.hypot(b.size.z) * 0.5;
   246	            if sphere_visible(
   247	                center,
   248	                radius,
   249	                eye,
   250	                yaw,
   251	                pitch,
   252	                aspect,
   253	                self.effective_distance,
   254	            ) {
   255	                r.mesh(*mesh);
   256	            }
   257	        }
   258	        if let Some((_, mesh)) = self.interior {
   259	            r.mesh(mesh);
   260	        }
   261	        self.submitted_triangles = r.triangles - triangles_before;
   262	    }
   263	    pub fn active(&self) -> usize {
   264	        self.resident.len()
   265	    }
   266	}
   267	fn chunk_lod(distance: f32, d: f32) -> u8 {
   268	    if distance > 180. && d < distance * 0.5 {
   269	        0
   270	    } else {
   271	        1
   272	    }
   273	}
   274	fn interior_key(world: &World, p: Vec3) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
   275	    if world::prison::underground(p) {
   276	        return Some((usize::MAX, 0));
   277	    }
   278	    world
   279	        .interior(p)
   280	        .map(|id| (id, world.buildings[id].rendered_floor(p)))
   281	}
   282	pub(crate) fn sphere_visible(
   283	    c: [f32; 3],
   284	    radius: f32,
   285	    eye: [f32; 3],
   286	    yaw: f32,
   287	    pitch: f32,
   288	    aspect: f32,
   289	    far: f32,
   290	) -> bool {
   291	    let dx = c[0] - eye[0];
   292	    let dy = c[1] - eye[1];
   293	    let dz = c[2] - eye[2];
   294	    let right = dx * yaw.cos() + dz * yaw.sin();
   295	    let horizontal = dx * yaw.sin() - dz * yaw.cos();
   296	    let depth = horizontal * pitch.cos() - dy * pitch.sin();
   297	    let up = dy * pitch.cos() + horizontal * pitch.sin();
   298	    if depth + radius < 0. || depth - radius > far {
   299	        return false;
   300	    }
   301	    let half_v = 0.7;
   302	    let half_h = half_v * aspect;
   303	    right.abs() <= depth * half_h + radius * (1. + half_h * half_h).sqrt()
   304	        && up.abs() <= depth * half_v + radius * (1. + half_v * half_v).sqrt()
   305	}
   306	
   307	fn occluded_ray(eye: [f32; 3], target: [f32; 3], min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
   308	    let mut near = 0f32;
   309	    let mut far = 1f32;
   310	    for i in 0..3 {
   311	        let d = target[i] - eye[i];
   312	        if d.abs() < 0.0001 {
   313	            if eye[i] < min[i] || eye[i] > max[i] {
   314	                return false;
   315	            }
   316	        } else {
   317	            let a = (min[i] - eye[i]) / d;
   318	            let b = (max[i] - eye[i]) / d;
   319	            near = near.max(a.min(b));
   320	            far = far.min(a.max(b));
   321	            if near > far {
   322	                return false;
   323	            }
   324	        }
   325	    }
   326	    near > 0. && far < 0.98
   327	}
   328

     2	pub struct Player {
     3	    pub pos: Vec3,
     4	    pub team: Team,
     5	    pub health: f32,
     6	    pub vy: f32,

     8	    pub animation: f32,
     9	}
    10	impl Player {
    11	    pub fn new(team: Team) -> Self {
    12	        Self {
    13	            pos: match team {
    14	                Team::Prisoner => Vec3::new(-100., 1., -160.),
    15	                Team::Police => Vec3::new(0., 1., -140.),
    16	                Team::Criminal => Vec3::new(-95., 1., -80.),
    17	            },
    18	            team,
    19	            health: 100.,
    20	            vy: 0.,
    21	            heading: 0.,
    22	            animation: 0.,
    23	        }
    24	    }
    25	    pub fn escaped(&mut self) -> bool {
    26	        if self.team == Team::Prisoner
    27	            && self.pos.y > 0.2
    28	            && (self.pos.z > -96. || self.pos.x < -175. || self.pos.x > -25.)
    29	        {
    30	            self.team = Team::Criminal;
    31	            true
    32	        } else {
    33	            false
    34	        }
    35	    }
    36	}

     1	use engine_core::Vec3;
     2	pub struct Patrol {
     3	    pub pos: Vec3,
     4	    pub heading: f32,
     5	    pub waypoint: Vec3,
     6	    pub replan: f32,
     7	    pub animation: f32,
     8	}
     9	pub fn tick(n: &mut Patrol, target: Vec3, wanted: u32, dt: f32) -> Vec3 {
    10	    if wanted > 0 {
    11	        let dx = target.x - n.pos.x;
    12	        let dz = target.z - n.pos.z;
    13	        let d = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt();
    14	        n.heading = dx.atan2(dz);
    15	        if d > 1. {
    16	            return Vec3::new(n.pos.x + dx / d * 7. * dt, 1., n.pos.z + dz / d * 7. * dt);
    17	        }
    18	    }
    19	    n.pos
    20	}

     1	[package]
     2	name = "profiling"

================================================================
  [77/133] –§–ê–ô–õ: ./profiling/src/lib.rs
================================================================

     1	use std::time::Instant;
     2	pub struct Stats {
     3	    start: Instant,
     4	    pub frames: u32,
     5	    pub fps: f32,
     6	    pub draws: usize,
     7	    pub rss_mb: f32,
     8	    pub update_ms: f32,
     9	    pub render_ms: f32,
    10	}
    11	impl Stats {
    12	    pub fn new() -> Self {
    13	        Self {
    14	            start: Instant::now(),
    15	            frames: 0,
    16	            fps: 0.,
    17	            draws: 0,
    18	            rss_mb: 0.,
    19	            update_ms: 0.,
    20	            render_ms: 0.,
    21	        }
    22	    }
    23	    pub fn frame(&mut self) {
    24	        self.frames += 1;
    25	        if self.start.elapsed().as_secs_f32() >= 1. {
    26	            self.fps = self.frames as f32 / self.start.elapsed().as_secs_f32();
    27	            self.rss_mb = rss_mb();
    28	            self.frames = 0;
    29	            self.start = Instant::now();
    30	        }
    31	    }
    32	}
    33	
    34	impl Default for Stats {
    35	    fn default() -> Self {
    36	        Self::new()
    37	    }
    38	}
    39	
    40	pub fn rss_mb() -> f32 {
    41	    std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/status")
    42	        .ok()
    43	        .and_then(|s| {
    44	            s.lines()
    45	                .find(|l| l.starts_with("VmRSS:"))
    46	                .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))
    47	                .and_then(|v| v.parse::<f32>().ok())
    48	        })
    49	        .unwrap_or(0.)
    50	        / 1024.
    51	}

1	␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ 41	␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ˇˇˇ‘ˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇÃ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ˇˇˇˇˇˇ[ˇˇˇ¸ˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇˇÀ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀   [84/133] –§–ê–ô–õ: ./renderer_gl21/shaders/world.frag

     1	#version 120
     2	uniform sampler2D atlas;
     3	uniform float daylight;
     4	uniform float opacity;
     5	uniform float fog_end;
     6	uniform float detail_amount;
     7	uniform int mesh_mode;
     8	varying vec4 col;
     9	varying vec2 uv;
    10	varying float dist;
    11	void main(){
    12	 vec3 base=col.rgb;float emission=0.;
    13	 if(mesh_mode==1){
    14	  base*=texture2D(atlas,uv).rgb;emission=col.a;
    15	  float grain=sin(uv.x*1200.)*sin(uv.y*900.);
    16	  base*=1.+detail_amount*grain*(1.-clamp(dist/160.,0.,1.));
    17	 }
    18	 float light=max(0.25+daylight*0.75,emission);
    19	 vec3 sky=vec3(0.08+daylight*0.35,0.11+daylight*0.49,0.2+daylight*0.52);
    20	 float fog=clamp((dist-fog_end*0.55)/(fog_end*0.45),0.,1.);
    21	 vec3 lit=base*light;
    22	 lit=mix(lit,lit*vec3(1.035,1.01,0.98),detail_amount*4.);
    23	 gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(lit,sky,fog),opacity);
    24	}

  [86/133] –§–ê–ô–õ: ./renderer_gl21/src/lib.rs

     1	use std::ffi::{c_char, c_void, CStr, CString};
     2	#[repr(C, align(8))]
     3	pub struct Event {
     4	    pub data: [u8; 56],
     5	}
     6	impl Event {
     7	    pub fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
     8	        u32::from_ne_bytes(self.data[0..4].try_into().unwrap())
     9	    }
    10	    pub fn key(&self) -> i32 {
    11	        let scan = i32::from_ne_bytes(self.data[16..20].try_into().unwrap());
    12	        match scan {
    13	            4..=29 => 97 + scan - 4,
    14	            30..=38 => 49 + scan - 30,
    15	            39 => 48,
    16	            40 => 13,
    17	            41 => 27,
    18	            44 => 32,
    19	            _ => {
    20	                if scan >= 58 {
    21	                    1073741824 + scan
    22	                } else {
    23	                    i32::from_ne_bytes(self.data[20..24].try_into().unwrap())
    24	                }
    25	            }
    26	        }
    27	    }
    28	    pub fn synthetic_key(scan: i32, symbol: i32) -> Self {
    29	        let mut e = Self { data: [0; 56] };
    30	        e.data[0..4].copy_from_slice(&0x300u32.to_ne_bytes());
    31	        e.data[16..20].copy_from_slice(&scan.to_ne_bytes());
    32	        e.data[20..24].copy_from_slice(&symbol.to_ne_bytes());
    33	        e
    34	    }
    35	    pub fn click(&self) -> (i32, i32) {
    36	        (
    37	            i32::from_ne_bytes(self.data[20..24].try_into().unwrap()),
    38	            i32::from_ne_bytes(self.data[24..28].try_into().unwrap()),
    39	        )
    40	    }
    41	    pub fn repeat(&self) -> bool {
    42	        self.data[13] != 0
    43	    }
    44	    pub fn motion(&self) -> (i32, i32) {
    45	        (
    46	            i32::from_ne_bytes(self.data[28..32].try_into().unwrap()),
    47	            i32::from_ne_bytes(self.data[32..36].try_into().unwrap()),
    48	        )
    49	    }
    50	}

   155	pub struct Renderer {
   156	    window: *mut c_void,
   157	    context: *mut c_void,
   158	    pub width: i32,
   159	    pub height: i32,
   160	    pub driver: String,
   161	    pub draws: usize,
   162	    pub triangles: usize,
   163	    ui_open: bool,
   164	    buffers: std::collections::HashSet<u32>,
   165	    textures: Vec<u32>,
   166	    program: u32,
   167	    atlas: u32,
   168	    font: u32,
   169	    day_uniform: i32,
   170	    mesh_uniform: i32,
   171	    fog_uniform: i32,
   172	    quality_uniform: i32,
   173	    opacity_uniform: i32,
   174	}
   175	impl Renderer {
   176	    pub fn new() -> Result<Self, String> {
   177	        unsafe {
   178	            if SDL_Init(0x20) != 0 {
   179	                return Err(error());
   180	            }
   181	            SDL_GL_SetAttribute(17, 2);
   182	            SDL_GL_SetAttribute(18, 1);
   183	            SDL_GL_SetAttribute(5, 1);
   184	            SDL_GL_SetAttribute(6, 24);
   185	            let title = CString::new("JAILBREAK RS | Original open-world prototype").unwrap();
   186	            let w = SDL_CreateWindow(title.as_ptr(), 0x2fff0000, 0x2fff0000, 1024, 576, 2 | 32);
   187	            if w.is_null() {
   188	                return Err(error());
   189	            }
   190	            let c = SDL_GL_CreateContext(w);
   191	            if c.is_null() {
   192	                SDL_DestroyWindow(w);
   193	                return Err(error());
   194	            }
   195	            SDL_GL_SetSwapInterval(1);
   196	            let raw = glGetString(0x1f01);
   197	            let driver = if raw.is_null() {
   198	                "unknown".into()
   199	            } else {
   200	                CStr::from_ptr(raw.cast()).to_string_lossy().into_owned()
   201	            };
   202	            // SDL/Mesa context probing can leave GL_INVALID_ENUM on a 2.1 context.
   203	            // Clear startup errors before validating calls made by our renderer.
   204	            while glGetError() != 0 {}
   205	            let mut renderer = Self {
   206	                window: w,
   207	                context: c,
   208	                width: 1024,
   209	                height: 576,
   210	                driver,
   211	                draws: 0,
   212	                triangles: 0,
   213	                ui_open: false,
   214	                buffers: Default::default(),
   215	                textures: Vec::new(),
   216	                program: 0,
   217	                atlas: 0,
   218	                font: 0,
   219	                day_uniform: -1,
   220	                mesh_uniform: -1,
   221	                fog_uniform: -1,
   222	                quality_uniform: -1,
   223	                opacity_uniform: -1,
   224	            };
   225	            renderer.setup()?;
   226	            Ok(renderer)
   227	        }
   228	    }
   229	    fn setup(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
   230	        unsafe {
   231	            let vertex = compile(0x8b31, include_str!("../shaders/world.vert"))?;
   232	            let fragment = compile(0x8b30, include_str!("../shaders/world.frag"))?;
   233	            let program = glCreateProgram();
   234	            glAttachShader(program, vertex);
   235	            glAttachShader(program, fragment);
   236	            glLinkProgram(program);
   237	            glDeleteShader(vertex);
   238	            glDeleteShader(fragment);
   239	            let mut ok = 0;
   240	            glGetProgramiv(program, 0x8b82, &mut ok);
   241	            if ok == 0 {
   242	                let mut log = vec![0u8; 2048];
   243	                glGetProgramInfoLog(program, 2048, std::ptr::null_mut(), log.as_mut_ptr().cast());
   244	                glDeleteProgram(program);
   245	                return Err(String::from_utf8_lossy(&log).into_owned());
   246	            }
   247	            self.program = program;
   248	            let uniform = |name: &str| {
   249	                let c = CString::new(name).unwrap();
   250	                glGetUniformLocation(program, c.as_ptr())
   251	            };
   252	            self.day_uniform = uniform("daylight");
   253	            self.mesh_uniform = uniform("mesh_mode");
   254	            self.fog_uniform = uniform("fog_end");
   255	            self.quality_uniform = uniform("detail_amount");
   256	            self.opacity_uniform = uniform("opacity");
   257	            glUseProgram(program);
   258	            glUniform1f(self.opacity_uniform, 1.);
   259	            glUniform1i(uniform("atlas"), 0);
   260	            glUniform1f(self.fog_uniform, 450.);
   261	            let pixels = atlas_pixels(64);
   262	            self.atlas = self.texture(256, 256, &pixels).id;
   263	            glUseProgram(0);
   264	            glGenTextures(1, &mut self.font);
   265	            glBindTexture(0x0de1, self.font);
   266	            glTexImage2D(
   267	                0x0de1,
   268	                0,
   269	                0x1908,
   270	                512,
   271	                640,
   272	                0,
   273	                0x1908,
   274	                0x1401,
   275	                include_bytes!("../assets/ui-font.rgba").as_ptr().cast(),
   276	            );
   277	            glTexParameteri(0x0de1, 0x2801, 0x2601);
   278	            glTexParameteri(0x0de1, 0x2800, 0x2601);
   279	            self.textures.push(self.font);
   280	            Ok(())
   281	        }
   282	    }
   283	    pub fn fog(&self, end: f32) {
   284	        unsafe {
   285	            glUniform1f(self.fog_uniform, end);
   286	        }
   287	    }
   288	    pub fn detail(&mut self, amount: f32) {
   289	        unsafe {
   290	            glUseProgram(self.program);
   291	            glUniform1f(self.quality_uniform, amount);
   292	        }
   293	    }
   294	    /// Rounded superellipsoid: exponent 1 is an ellipsoid, 0.3 is a beveled box.
   295	    pub fn rounded(
   296	        &mut self,
   297	        p: [f32; 3],
   298	        size: [f32; 3],
   299	        color: [f32; 3],
   300	        angle: f32,
   301	        n: usize,
   302	        exponent: f32,
   303	    ) {
   304	        let n = n.clamp(6, 24);
   305	        let rings = n / 2;
   306	        let signed = |x: f32| x.signum() * x.abs().powf(exponent);
   307	        unsafe {
   308	            glUniform1i(self.mesh_uniform, 0);
   309	            glPushMatrix();
   310	            glTranslatef(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
   311	            glRotatef(angle.to_degrees(), 0., 1., 0.);
   312	            glBegin(7);
   313	            for ring in 0..rings {
   314	                for slice in 0..n {
   315	                    for (i, j) in [
   316	                        (ring, slice),
   317	                        (ring, slice + 1),
   318	                        (ring + 1, slice + 1),
   319	                        (ring + 1, slice),
   320	                    ] {
   321	                        let lat = -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2
   322	                            + std::f32::consts::PI * i as f32 / rings as f32;
   323	                        let lon = std::f32::consts::TAU * j as f32 / n as f32;
   324	                        let x = signed(lat.cos()) * signed(lon.cos());
   325	                        let y = signed(lat.sin());
   326	                        let z = signed(lat.cos()) * signed(lon.sin());
   327	                        let shade = (0.76 + 0.16 * y + 0.09 * x - 0.06 * z).clamp(0.4, 1.);
   328	                        glColor3f(color[0] * shade, color[1] * shade, color[2] * shade);
   329	                        glVertex3f(x * size[0] * 0.5, y * size[1] * 0.5, z * size[2] * 0.5);
   330	                    }
   331	                }
   332	            }
   333	            glEnd();
   334	            glPopMatrix();
   335	        }
   336	        self.draws += 1;
   337	        self.triangles += n * rings * 2;
   338	    }
   339	    pub fn material_resolution(&mut self, level: usize) {
   340	        let tile = [64, 128, 256, 512][level.min(3)];
   341	        let pixels = atlas_pixels(tile);
   342	        unsafe {
   343	            glBindTexture(0x0de1, self.atlas);
   344	            glTexImage2D(
   345	                0x0de1,
   346	                0,
   347	                0x1907,
   348	                (tile * 4) as i32,
   349	                (tile * 4) as i32,
   350	                0,
   351	                0x1907,
   352	                0x1401,
   353	                pixels.as_ptr().cast(),
   354	            );
   355	        }
   356	    }
   357	    pub fn texture(&mut self, w: i32, h: i32, pixels: &[u8]) -> Texture {
   358	        assert_eq!(pixels.len(), (w * h * 3) as usize);
   359	        unsafe {
   360	            let mut id = 0;
   361	            glGenTextures(1, &mut id);
   362	            glBindTexture(0x0de1, id);
   363	            glPixelStorei(0x0cf5, 1);
   364	            glTexImage2D(
   365	                0x0de1,
   366	                0,
   367	                0x1907,
   368	                w,
   369	                h,
   370	                0,
   371	                0x1907,
   372	                0x1401,
   373	                pixels.as_ptr().cast(),
   374	            );
   375	            glTexParameteri(0x0de1, 0x2801, 0x2601);
   376	            glTexParameteri(0x0de1, 0x2800, 0x2601);
   377	            glTexParameteri(0x0de1, 0x2802, 0x812f);
   378	            glTexParameteri(0x0de1, 0x2803, 0x812f);
   379	            self.textures.push(id);
   380	            Texture { id }
   381	        }
   382	    }
   383	    pub fn texture_rect(&mut self, texture: Texture, rect: [f32; 4]) {
   384	        let [x, y, w, h] = rect;
   385	        let resume = self.ui_open;
   386	        self.finish_ui();
   387	        unsafe {
   388	            glEnable(0x0de1);
   389	            glBindTexture(0x0de1, texture.id);
   390	            glColor3f(1., 1., 1.);
   391	            glBegin(7);
   392	            for (px, py, u, v) in [
   393	                (x, y, 0., 0.),
   394	                (x + w, y, 1., 0.),
   395	                (x + w, y + h, 1., 1.),
   396	                (x, y + h, 0., 1.),
   397	            ] {
   398	                glTexCoord2f(u, v);
   399	                glVertex3f(px, py, 0.);
   400	            }
   401	            glEnd();
   402	            glDisable(0x0de1);
   403	            if resume {
   404	                glBegin(7);
   405	                self.ui_open = true;
   406	            }
   407	        }
   408	        self.draws += if resume { 2 } else { 1 };
   409	    }
   410	    pub fn solid_model(
   411	        &mut self,
   412	        mesh: &engine_core::Mesh,
   413	        p: [f32; 3],
   414	        angle: f32,
   415	        tint: [f32; 3],
   416	    ) {
   417	        unsafe {
   418	            glUniform1i(self.mesh_uniform, 0);
   419	            glPushMatrix();
   420	            glTranslatef(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
   421	            glRotatef(angle.to_degrees(), 0., 1., 0.);
   422	            glBegin(4);
   423	            for v in &mesh.vertices {
   424	                glColor3f(
   425	                    v.color[0] * tint[0],
   426	                    v.color[1] * tint[1],
   427	                    v.color[2] * tint[2],
   428	                );
   429	                glVertex3f(v.position[0], v.position[1], v.position[2]);
   430	            }
   431	            glEnd();
   432	            glPopMatrix();
   433	        }
   434	        self.triangles += mesh.vertices.len() / 3;
   435	        self.draws += 1;
   436	    }
   437	    pub fn upload(&mut self, mesh: &engine_core::Mesh) -> GpuMesh {
   438	        unsafe {
   439	            let mut id = 0;
   440	            glGenBuffers(1, &mut id);
   441	            glBindBuffer(0x8892, id);
   442	            let bytes = mesh.vertices.len() * std::mem::size_of::<engine_core::Vertex>();
   443	            glBufferData(
   444	                0x8892,
   445	                bytes as isize,
   446	                mesh.vertices.as_ptr().cast(),
   447	                0x88e4,
   448	            );
   449	            glBindBuffer(0x8892, 0);
   450	            self.buffers.insert(id);
   451	            GpuMesh {
   452	                id,
   453	                vertices: mesh.vertices.len() as i32,
   454	                bytes,
   455	            }
   456	        }
   457	    }
   458	    pub fn release(&mut self, mesh: GpuMesh) {
   459	        if self.buffers.remove(&mesh.id) {
   460	            unsafe {
   461	                glDeleteBuffers(1, &mesh.id);
   462	            }
   463	        }
   464	    }
   465	    pub fn mesh(&mut self, mesh: GpuMesh) {
   466	        unsafe {
   467	            glUniform1i(self.mesh_uniform, 1);
   468	            glBindTexture(0x0de1, self.atlas);
   469	            glBindBuffer(0x8892, mesh.id);
   470	            let stride = std::mem::size_of::<engine_core::Vertex>() as i32;
   471	            glEnableClientState(0x8074);
   472	            glEnableClientState(0x8076);
   473	            glEnableClientState(0x8078);
   474	            glVertexPointer(3, 0x1406, stride, std::ptr::null());
   475	            glColorPointer(4, 0x1406, stride, 12usize as *const c_void);
   476	            glTexCoordPointer(2, 0x1406, stride, 28usize as *const c_void);
   477	            glDrawArrays(4, 0, mesh.vertices);
   478	            glDisableClientState(0x8074);
   479	            glDisableClientState(0x8076);
   480	            glDisableClientState(0x8078);
   481	            glBindBuffer(0x8892, 0);
   482	            glUniform1i(self.mesh_uniform, 0);
   483	        }
   484	        self.draws += 1;
   485	        self.triangles += mesh.vertices as usize / 3;
   486	    }
   487	    pub fn version(&self) -> String {
   488	        unsafe {
   489	            CStr::from_ptr(glGetString(0x1f02).cast())
   490	                .to_string_lossy()
   491	                .into_owned()
   492	        }
   493	    }
   494	    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
   495	        let code = unsafe { glGetError() };
   496	        if code == 0 {
   497	            Ok(())
   498	        } else {
   499	            Err(format!("OpenGL error 0x{code:x}"))
   500	        }
   501	    }
   502	    pub fn poll(&self) -> Option<Event> {
   503	        let mut e = Event { data: [0; 56] };
   504	        unsafe {
   505	            if SDL_PollEvent(&mut e) != 0 {
   506	                Some(e)
   507	            } else {
   508	                None
   509	            }
   510	        }
   511	    }
   512	    pub fn key(&self, scan: usize) -> bool {
   513	        unsafe {
   514	            let mut n = 0;
   515	            let p = SDL_GetKeyboardState(&mut n);
   516	            scan < n as usize && *p.add(scan) != 0
   517	        }
   518	    }
   519	    pub fn capture(&self, on: bool) {
   520	        unsafe {
   521	            SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode(on as i32);
   522	        }
   523	    }
   524	    pub fn begin(&mut self, eye: [f32; 3], yaw: f32, pitch: f32, day: f32) {
   525	        unsafe {
   526	            SDL_GetWindowSize(self.window, &mut self.width, &mut self.height);
   527	            self.draws = 0;
   528	            self.triangles = 0;
   529	            glUseProgram(self.program);
   530	            glUniform1f(self.day_uniform, day);
   531	            glUniform1i(self.mesh_uniform, 0);
   532	            glViewport(0, 0, self.width, self.height);
   533	            glClearColor(0.08 + day * 0.35, 0.11 + day * 0.49, 0.2 + day * 0.52, 1.);
   534	            glClear(0x4100);
   535	            glEnable(0xb71);
   536	            glMatrixMode(0x1701);
   537	            glLoadIdentity();
   538	            let aspect = self.width as f64 / self.height.max(1) as f64;
   539	            glFrustum(-aspect * 0.07, aspect * 0.07, -0.07, 0.07, 0.1, 650.);
   540	            glMatrixMode(0x1700);
   541	            glLoadIdentity();
   542	            glRotatef(pitch.to_degrees(), 1., 0., 0.);
   543	            glRotatef(yaw.to_degrees(), 0., 1., 0.);
   544	            glTranslatef(-eye[0], -eye[1], -eye[2]);
   545	        }
   546	    }
   547	    pub fn cube(&mut self, p: [f32; 3], s: [f32; 3], c: [f32; 3], angle: f32) {
   548	        unsafe {
   549	            glUniform1i(self.mesh_uniform, 0);
   550	            glPushMatrix();
   551	            glTranslatef(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
   552	            glRotatef(angle.to_degrees(), 0., 1., 0.);
   553	            glScalef(s[0], s[1], s[2]);
   554	            glBegin(7);
   555	            let verts = [
   556	                [-0.5, -0.5, -0.5],
   557	                [0.5, -0.5, -0.5],
   558	                [0.5, 0.5, -0.5],
   559	                [-0.5, 0.5, -0.5],
   560	                [-0.5, -0.5, 0.5],
   561	                [0.5, -0.5, 0.5],
   562	                [0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
   563	                [-0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
   564	            ];
   565	            for (face, shade) in [
   566	                ([0, 1, 2, 3], 0.7),
   567	                ([5, 4, 7, 6], 0.85),
   568	                ([4, 0, 3, 7], 0.75),
   569	                ([1, 5, 6, 2], 0.9),
   570	                ([3, 2, 6, 7], 1.),
   571	                ([4, 5, 1, 0], 0.6),
   572	            ] {
   573	                glColor3f(c[0] * shade, c[1] * shade, c[2] * shade);
   574	                for i in face {
   575	                    let v = verts[i];
   576	                    glVertex3f(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
   577	                }
   578	            }
   579	            glEnd();
   580	            glPopMatrix();
   581	        }
   582	        self.draws += 1;
   583	    }
   584	    pub fn glass(&mut self, p: [f32; 3], size: [f32; 3], color: [f32; 3], angle: f32) {
   585	        unsafe {
   586	            glUniform1f(self.opacity_uniform, 0.28);
   587	            glEnable(0xbe2);
   588	            glBlendFunc(0x302, 0x303);
   589	            glDepthMask(0);
   590	        }
   591	        self.cube(p, size, color, angle);
   592	        unsafe {
   593	            glDepthMask(1);
   594	            glDisable(0xbe2);
   595	            glUniform1f(self.opacity_uniform, 1.);
   596	        }
   597	    }
   598	    /// A rigid cuboid aligned between two joints, for articulated limbs.
   599	    pub fn bone(
   600	        &mut self,
   601	        a: [f32; 3],
   602	        b: [f32; 3],
   603	        width: f32,
   604	        depth: f32,
   605	        yaw: f32,
   606	        c: [f32; 3],
   607	    ) {
   608	        let side = [yaw.cos(), 0., -yaw.sin()];
   609	        let dy = b[1] - a[1];
   610	        let horizontal = ((b[0] - a[0]).powi(2) + (b[2] - a[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
   611	        let length = (horizontal * horizontal + dy * dy).sqrt().max(0.001);
   612	        let axis = [(b[0] - a[0]) / length, dy / length, (b[2] - a[2]) / length];
   613	        let front = [
   614	            side[1] * axis[2] - side[2] * axis[1],
   615	            side[2] * axis[0] - side[0] * axis[2],
   616	            side[0] * axis[1] - side[1] * axis[0],
   617	        ];
   618	        let mut v = [[0.; 3]; 8];
   619	        for (i, signs) in [
   620	            (-1., -1., false),
   621	            (1., -1., false),
   622	            (1., 1., false),
   623	            (-1., 1., false),
   624	            (-1., -1., true),
   625	            (1., -1., true),
   626	            (1., 1., true),
   627	            (-1., 1., true),
   628	        ]
   629	        .iter()
   630	        .enumerate()
   631	        {
   632	            let center = if signs.2 { b } else { a };
   633	            for j in 0..3 {
   634	                v[i][j] =
   635	                    center[j] + side[j] * signs.0 * width * 0.5 + front[j] * signs.1 * depth * 0.5;
   636	            }
   637	        }
   638	        unsafe {
   639	            glBegin(7);
   640	            for (face, shade) in [
   641	                ([0, 1, 2, 3], 0.65),
   642	                ([4, 7, 6, 5], 0.9),
   643	                ([0, 4, 5, 1], 0.75),
   644	                ([3, 2, 6, 7], 1.),
   645	                ([0, 3, 7, 4], 0.8),
   646	                ([1, 5, 6, 2], 0.88),
   647	            ] {
   648	                glColor3f(c[0] * shade, c[1] * shade, c[2] * shade);
   649	                for i in face {
   650	                    glVertex3f(v[i][0], v[i][1], v[i][2]);
   651	                }
   652	            }
   653	            glEnd();
   654	        }
   655	        self.draws += 1;
   656	        self.triangles += 12;
   657	    }
   658	    pub fn object_shadow(&mut self, p: [f32; 3], size: [f32; 3], ground: f32) {
   659	        let h = (p[1] + size[1] * 0.5 - ground).max(0.);
   660	        let x = p[0] - size[0] * 0.5;
   661	        let z = p[2] - size[2] * 0.5;
   662	        let sx = size[0];
   663	        let sz = size[2];
   664	        let dx = h * 0.55;
   665	        let dz = h * 0.3;
   666	        unsafe {
   667	            glBegin(7);
   668	            glColor3f(0.18, 0.21, 0.18);
   669	            for v in [
   670	                [x, ground + 0.035, z],
   671	                [x + sx + dx, ground + 0.035, z + dz],
   672	                [x + sx + dx, ground + 0.035, z + sz + dz],
   673	                [x, ground + 0.035, z + sz],
   674	            ] {
   675	                glVertex3f(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
   676	            }
   677	            glEnd();
   678	        }
   679	        self.draws += 1;
   680	        self.triangles += 2;
   681	    }
   682	    pub fn ui(&mut self) {
   683	        unsafe {
   684	            glUseProgram(0);
   685	            glDisable(0x0de1);
   686	            glDisable(0xb71);
   687	            glMatrixMode(0x1701);
   688	            glLoadIdentity();
   689	            glOrtho(0., 1024., 576., 0., -1., 1.);
   690	            glMatrixMode(0x1700);
   691	            glLoadIdentity();
   692	            glBegin(7);
   693	            self.ui_open = true;
   694	            self.draws += 1;
   695	        }
   696	    }
   697	    pub fn rect(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32, c: [f32; 3]) {
   698	        unsafe {
   699	            glColor3f(c[0], c[1], c[2]);
   700	            if !self.ui_open {
   701	                glBegin(7);
   702	            }
   703	            for (px, py) in [(x, y), (x + w, y), (x + w, y + h), (x, y + h)] {
   704	                glVertex3f(px, py, 0.);
   705	            }
   706	            if !self.ui_open {
   707	                glEnd();
   708	                self.draws += 1;
   709	            }
   710	        }
   711	    }
   712	    pub fn label(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32, size: f32, t: &str, c: [f32; 3]) {
   713	        let resume = self.ui_open;
   714	        self.finish_ui();
   715	        unsafe {
   716	            glEnable(0x0de1);
   717	            glBindTexture(0x0de1, self.font);
   718	            glEnable(0xbe2);
   719	            glBlendFunc(0x302, 0x303);
   720	            glColor4f(c[0], c[1], c[2], 1.);
   721	            glBegin(7);
   722	            let scale = size * 7. / 25.;
   723	            let mut cursor = x;
   724	            for ch in t.chars() {
   725	                let code = ch as usize;
   726	                let id = if (32..127).contains(&code) {
   727	                    code - 32
   728	                } else if (0x400..0x460).contains(&code) {
   729	                    95 + code - 0x400
   730	                } else {
   731	                    31
   732	                };
   733	                let u = (id % 16) as f32 / 16.;
   734	                let v = (id / 16) as f32 / 16.;
   735	                for (px, py, tu, tv) in [
   736	                    (cursor, y, u, v),
   737	                    (cursor + 32. * scale, y, u + 1. / 16., v),
   738	                    (
   739	                        cursor + 32. * scale,
   740	                        y + 40. * scale,
   741	                        u + 1. / 16.,
   742	                        v + 1. / 16.,
   743	                    ),
   744	                    (cursor, y + 40. * scale, u, v + 1. / 16.),
   745	                ] {
   746	                    glTexCoord2f(tu, tv);
   747	                    glVertex3f(px, py, 0.);
   748	                }
   749	                cursor += include_bytes!("../assets/ui-font-widths.bin")[id] as f32 * scale;
   750	            }
   751	            glEnd();
   752	            glDisable(0x0de1);
   753	            glDisable(0xbe2);
   754	            if resume {
   755	                glBegin(7);
   756	                self.ui_open = true;
   757	            }
   758	        }
   759	        self.draws += 2;
   760	    }
   761	    pub fn panel(&mut self, rect: [f32; 4], color: [f32; 3], alpha: f32, radius: f32) {
   762	        let resume = self.ui_open;
   763	        self.finish_ui();
   764	        let [x, y, w, h] = rect;
   765	        let radius = radius.min(w / 2.).min(h / 2.);
   766	        unsafe {
   767	            glEnable(0xbe2);
   768	            glBlendFunc(0x302, 0x303);
   769	            glColor4f(color[0], color[1], color[2], alpha);
   770	            glBegin(6);
   771	            glVertex3f(x + w / 2., y + h / 2., 0.);
   772	            for (cx, cy, start) in [
   773	                (x + w - radius, y + radius, -90.),
   774	                (x + w - radius, y + h - radius, 0.),
   775	                (x + radius, y + h - radius, 90.),
   776	                (x + radius, y + radius, 180.),
   777	            ] {
   778	                for i in 0..=8 {
   779	                    let a = (start + i as f32 * 90. / 8.).to_radians();
   780	                    glVertex3f(cx + radius * a.cos(), cy + radius * a.sin(), 0.);
   781	                }
   782	            }
   783	            glVertex3f(x + w - radius, y, 0.);
   784	            glEnd();
   785	            glDisable(0xbe2);
   786	            if resume {
   787	                glBegin(7);
   788	                self.ui_open = true;
   789	            }
   790	        }
   791	        self.draws += 2;
   792	    }
   793	    fn finish_ui(&mut self) {
   794	        if self.ui_open {
   795	            unsafe {
   796	                glEnd();
   797	            }
   798	            self.ui_open = false;
   799	        }
   800	    }
   801	    pub fn capture_ppm(&mut self, path: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
   802	        self.finish_ui();
   803	        let mut data = vec![0u8; (self.width * self.height * 3) as usize];
   804	        unsafe {
   805	            glPixelStorei(0x0d05, 1);
   806	            glReadPixels(
   807	                0,
   808	                0,
   809	                self.width,
   810	                self.height,
   811	                0x1907,
   812	                0x1401,
   813	                data.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
   814	            );
   815	        }
   816	        use std::io::Write;
   817	        let mut file = std::fs::File::create(path)?;
   818	        write!(file, "P6\n{} {}\n255\n", self.width, self.height)?;
   819	        for row in data.chunks_exact(self.width as usize * 3).rev() {
   820	            file.write_all(row)?;
   821	        }
   822	        Ok(())
   823	    }
   824	    pub fn end(&mut self) {
   825	        self.finish_ui();
   826	        unsafe { SDL_GL_SwapWindow(self.window) }
   827	    }
   828	}
   829	impl Drop for Renderer {
   830	    fn drop(&mut self) {
   831	        unsafe {
   832	            for id in &self.buffers {
   833	                glDeleteBuffers(1, id);
   834	            }
   835	            for id in &self.textures {
   836	                glDeleteTextures(1, id);
   837	            }
   838	            glDeleteProgram(self.program);
   839	            SDL_GL_DeleteContext(self.context);
   840	            SDL_DestroyWindow(self.window);
   841	            SDL_Quit();
   842	        }
   843	    }
   844	}
   845	unsafe fn error() -> String {
   846	    CStr::from_ptr(SDL_GetError())
   847	        .to_string_lossy()
   848	        .into_owned()
   849	}
   850	
   851	unsafe fn compile(kind: u32, source: &str) -> Result<u32, String> {
   852	    let id = glCreateShader(kind);
   853	    let source = CString::new(source).unwrap();
   854	    let p = source.as_ptr();
   855	    glShaderSource(id, 1, &p, std::ptr::null());
   856	    glCompileShader(id);
   857	    let mut ok = 0;
   858	    glGetShaderiv(id, 0x8b81, &mut ok);
   859	    if ok == 0 {
   860	        let mut log = vec![0u8; 2048];
   861	        glGetShaderInfoLog(id, 2048, std::ptr::null_mut(), log.as_mut_ptr().cast());
   862	        glDeleteShader(id);
   863	        return Err(String::from_utf8_lossy(&log).into_owned());
   864	    }
   865	    Ok(id)
   866	}
   867	fn atlas_pixels(tile: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
   868	    let mut pixels = vec![0u8; (tile * 4) * (tile * 4) * 3];
   869	    for y in 0..tile * 4 {
   870	        for x in 0..tile * 4 {
   871	            let mat = (y / tile) * 4 + x / tile;
   872	            let u = (x % tile) * 64 / tile;
   873	            let v = (y % tile) * 64 / tile;
   874	            let grain = ((x * 73 + y * 151 + x * y * 3) % 23) as u8;
   875	            let value = match mat {
   876	                0 => 160 + grain,
   877	                1 => 205 + grain,
   878	                2 => {
   879	                    if v % 16 < 2 || (u + (v / 16) % 2 * 16) % 32 < 2 {
   880	                        140
   881	                    } else {
   882	                        220 + grain / 2
   883	                    }
   884	                }
   885	                3 => {
   886	                    if u % 16 < 2 || v % 16 < 2 {
   887	                        120
   888	                    } else {
   889	                        210 + grain / 2
   890	                    }
   891	                }
   892	                4 => {
   893	                    if v.is_multiple_of(8) {
   894	                        155
   895	                    } else {
   896	                        220
   897	                    }
   898	                }
   899	                5 => 210 + grain,
   900	                6 => 185 + grain,
   901	                7 => 160 + grain * 2,
   902	                8 => 190 + grain,
   903	                9 => 255,
   904	                10 => {
   905	                    if u.is_multiple_of(9) {
   906	                        145
   907	                    } else {
   908	                        210 + grain
   909	                    }
   910	                }
   911	                11 => {
   912	                    if v % 12 < 2 {
   913	                        130
   914	                    } else {
   915	                        200 + grain
   916	                    }
   917	                }
   918	                _ => 220,
   919	            };
   920	            let i = (y * tile * 4 + x) * 3;
   921	            let micro = if tile > 64 {
   922	                ((x * 17 + y * 31) % 7) as u8
   923	            } else {
   924	                0
   925	            };
   926	            pixels[i..i + 3].fill(value.saturating_sub(micro));
   927	        }
   928	    }
   929	    pixels
   930	}
