     1	use engine_core::{Mesh, Vec3};
     2	#[derive(Clone)]
     3	pub struct Road {
     4	    pub name: &'static str,
     5	    pub points: Vec<Vec3>,
     6	    pub width: f32,
     7	    pub highway: bool,
     8	}
     9	impl Road {
    10	    pub fn normal(&self, i: usize) -> (f32, f32) {
    11	        let a = self.points[i.saturating_sub(1)];
    12	        let b = self.points[(i + 1).min(self.points.len() - 1)];
    13	        let len = a.distance(b).max(0.001);
    14	        (-(b.z - a.z) / len, (b.x - a.x) / len)
    15	    }
    16	    pub fn distance(&self, p: Vec3) -> (f32, f32) {
    17	        let mut best = (f32::MAX, 0.);
    18	        for seg in self.points.windows(2) {
    19	            let a = seg[0];
    20	            let b = seg[1];
    21	            let dx = b.x - a.x;
    22	            let dz = b.z - a.z;
    23	            let t = ((p.x - a.x) * dx + (p.z - a.z) * dz) / (dx * dx + dz * dz).max(0.001);
    24	            let t = t.clamp(0., 1.);
    25	            let q = Vec3::new(a.x + dx * t, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t, a.z + dz * t);
    26	            let d = ((p.x - q.x).powi(2) + (p.z - q.z).powi(2)).sqrt();
    27	            if d < best.0 {
    28	                best = (d, q.y);
    29	            }
    30	        }
    31	        best
    32	    }
    33	    pub fn mesh(&self, key: (i32, i32), lod: u8, m: &mut Mesh) {
    34	        let x0 = key.0 as f32 * 128.;
    35	        let z0 = key.1 as f32 * 128.;
    36	        for (i, s) in self.points.windows(2).enumerate() {
    37	            let a = s[0];
    38	            let b = s[1];
    39	            let middle = Vec3::new((a.x + b.x) / 2., 0., (a.z + b.z) / 2.);
    40	            if middle.x < x0 - 20.
    41	                || middle.x > x0 + 148.
    42	                || middle.z < z0 - 20.
    43	                || middle.z > z0 + 148.
    44	            {
    45	                continue;
    46	            }
    47	            let (nx, nz) = self.normal(i);
    48	            let (bx, bz) = self.normal(i + 1);
    49	            let quad = |width: f32, dy: f32| {
    50	                [
    51	                    [a.x + nx * width, a.y + dy, a.z + nz * width],
    52	                    [b.x + bx * width, b.y + dy, b.z + bz * width],
    53	                    [b.x - bx * width, b.y + dy, b.z - bz * width],
    54	                    [a.x - nx * width, a.y + dy, a.z - nz * width],
    55	                ]
    56	            };
    57	            m.quad(quad(self.width / 2. + 2., 0.025), [0.52, 0.54, 0.52], 1, 0.);
    58	            m.quad(quad(self.width / 2., 0.05), [0.32, 0.34, 0.37], 0, 0.);
    59	            if i % 2 == 0 {
    60	                m.quad(quad(0.1, 0.07), [0.97, 0.81, 0.31], 1, 0.);
    61	            }
    62	            if self.highway {
    63	                for offset in [-3.5, 3.5] {
    64	                    let shift = offset;
    65	                    let mut q = quad(0.075, 0.08);
    66	                    for v in &mut q {
    67	                        v[0] += nx * shift;
    68	                        v[2] += nz * shift;
    69	                    }
    70	                    m.quad(q, [0.9, 0.92, 0.88], 1, 0.);
    71	                }
    72	            }
    73	            if lod == 0 && i % 6 == 0 {
    74	                let x = a.x + nx * (self.width / 2. + 3.);
    75	                let z = a.z + nz * (self.width / 2. + 3.);
    76	                m.cuboid(
    77	                    [x, a.y + 3.5, z],
    78	                    [0.18, 7., 0.18],
    79	                    [0.3, 0.33, 0.35],
    80	                    4,
    81	                    0.,
    82	                );
    83	                m.cuboid(
    84	                    [x - nx, a.y + 7., z - nz],
    85	                    [2.2, 0.2, 0.4],
    86	                    [0.65, 0.66, 0.6],
    87	                    4,
    88	                    0.,
    89	                );
    90	                m.cuboid(
    91	                    [x - nx, a.y + 6.85, z - nz],
    92	                    [1.7, 0.06, 0.3],
    93	                    [1., 0.85, 0.45],
    94	                    9,
    95	                    1.,
    96	                );
    97	            }
    98	            if a.y > 0.8 && terrain::height(a.x, a.z) < 0. {
    99	                for side in [-1., 1.] {
   100	                    let mut q = quad(0.15, 1.);
   101	                    for v in &mut q {
   102	                        v[0] += nx * side * (self.width / 2. + 0.5);
   103	                        v[2] += nz * side * (self.width / 2. + 0.5);
   104	                    }
   105	                    m.quad(q, [0.55, 0.57, 0.6], 4, 0.);
   106	                }
   107	                if i % 4 == 0 {
   108	                    m.cuboid(
   109	                        [a.x, a.y / 2. - 2., a.z],
   110	                        [2., a.y + 4., 2.],
   111	                        [0.5, 0.52, 0.5],
   112	                        1,
   113	                        0.,
   114	                    );
   115	                }
   116	            }
   117	        }
   118	    }
   119	}
   120	fn spline(name: &'static str, control: &[(f32, f32)], width: f32, highway: bool) -> Road {
   121	    let mut points = Vec::new();
   122	    for i in 0..control.len() - 1 {
   123	        let p0 = control[i.saturating_sub(1)];
   124	        let p1 = control[i];
   125	        let p2 = control[i + 1];
   126	        let p3 = control[(i + 2).min(control.len() - 1)];
   127	        let count = (((p1.0 - p2.0).hypot(p1.1 - p2.1) / 8.).ceil() as usize).max(2);
   128	        for j in 0..count {
   129	            let t = j as f32 / count as f32;
   130	            let f = |a: f32, b: f32, c: f32, d: f32| {
   131	                0.5 * ((2. * b)
   132	                    + (-a + c) * t
   133	                    + (2. * a - 5. * b + 4. * c - d) * t * t
   134	                    + (-a + 3. * b - 3. * c + d) * t * t * t)
   135	            };
   136	            let x = f(p0.0, p1.0, p2.0, p3.0);
   137	            let z = f(p0.1, p1.1, p2.1, p3.1);
   138	            points.push(Vec3::new(x, deck(x, z), z));
   139	        }
   140	    }
   141	    let (x, z) = *control.last().unwrap();
   142	    points.push(Vec3::new(x, deck(x, z), z));
   143	    Road {
   144	        name,
   145	        points,
   146	        width,
   147	        highway,
   148	    }
   149	}
   150	pub fn deck(x: f32, z: f32) -> f32 {
   151	    if (-490. ..-390.).contains(&x) && (-500. ..700.).contains(&z) {
   152	        let t = 1. - ((x + 440.).abs() / 50.).clamp(0., 1.);
   153	        2. * t * t * (3. - 2. * t)
   154	    } else if x > 420. && (-260. ..500.).contains(&z) {
   155	        terrain::industrial_height(x, z)
   156	    } else if (280. ..740.).contains(&z) && (x - (-610. + 24. * (z * 0.012).sin())).abs() < 42. {
   157	        2. * (1. - ((x - (-610. + 24. * (z * 0.012).sin())).abs() / 42.).clamp(0., 1.))
   158	    } else {
   159	        0.
   160	    }
   161	}
   162	pub fn network() -> Vec<Road> {
   163	    let mut r = Vec::new();
   164	    for z in [0., 140., 300.] {

   267	pub fn connected(roads: &[Road], start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> bool {
   268	    let nodes: Vec<Vec3> = roads
   269	        .iter()
   270	        .flat_map(|r| r.points.iter().copied())
   271	        .collect();
   272	    let mut seen = vec![false; nodes.len()];
   273	    let Some(first) = nodes.iter().position(|n| n.distance(start) < 15.) else {
   274	        return false;
   275	    };
   276	    seen[first] = true;
   277	    let mut q = std::collections::VecDeque::from([first]);
   278	    while let Some(i) = q.pop_front() {
   279	        if nodes[i].distance(end) < 15. {
   280	            return true;
   281	        }
   282	        for j in 0..nodes.len() {
   283	            if !seen[j] && nodes[i].distance(nodes[j]) < 13. {
   284	                seen[j] = true;
   285	                q.push_back(j);
   286	            }
   287	        }
   288	    }
   289	    false
   290	}

    89	#[derive(Default)]
    90	pub struct Alarm {
    91	    pub site: Option<usize>,
    92	    pub remaining: f32,
    93	    pub progress: f32,
    94	    pub loot: u32,
    95	    pub dispatched: bool,
    96	    pub cooldown: [f32; 7],
    97	    pub hits: [u8; 7],
    98	    pub collecting: bool,
    99	    pub capacity: u32,
   100	}
   101	#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
   102	pub enum Outcome {
   103	    None,
   104	    Escaped(u32),
   105	    Dispatch(usize),
   106	}
   107	impl Alarm {
   108	    pub fn start(&mut self, id: usize) -> bool {
   109	        if id >= SITES.len() || self.site.is_some() || self.cooldown[id] > 0. {
   110	            return false;
   111	        }
   112	        self.site = Some(id);
   113	        self.remaining = 30.;
   114	        self.progress = 0.;
   115	        self.loot = 0;
   116	        self.dispatched = false;
   117	        true
   118	    }
   119	    pub fn case(id: usize) -> Vec3 {
   120	        let p = SITES[id].center;
   121	        Vec3::new(
   122	            p.x,
   123	            if id == 3 || id == 4 {
   124	                terrain::height(p.x, p.z).max(0.) + 1.
   125	            } else {
   126	                p.y
   127	            },
   128	            p.z - 3.,
   129	        )
   130	    }
   131	    pub fn strike(&mut self, id: usize) -> bool {
   132	        if id >= SITES.len() || self.cooldown[id] > 0. || self.site.is_some_and(|site| site != id) {
   133	            return false;
   134	        }
   135	        if self.site.is_none() {
   136	            self.start(id);
   137	        }
   138	        self.hits[id] = (self.hits[id] + 1).min(3);
   139	        true
   140	    }
   141	    pub fn tick(&mut self, p: Vec3, dt: f32) -> Outcome {
   142	        for c in &mut self.cooldown {
   143	            *c = (*c - dt).max(0.);
   144	        }
   145	        let Some(id) = self.site else {
   146	            return Outcome::None;
   147	        };
   148	        let site = SITES[id];
   149	        self.remaining = (self.remaining - dt).max(0.);
   150	        if self.collecting
   151	            && self.hits[id] >= 3
   152	            && p.distance(Self::case(id)) < 2.6
   153	            && (p.y - Self::case(id).y).abs() < 2.
   154	        {
   155	            self.progress += dt;
   156	            if self.progress >= site.collect {
   157	                let weight = if id == 0 || id == 3 || id == 4 {
   158	                    12
   159	                } else if id >= 5 {
   160	                    6
   161	                } else {
   162	                    4
   163	                };
   164	                self.loot = site.reward * self.capacity.clamp(8, 18).min(weight) / weight;
   165	            }
   166	        }
   167	        // The deadline is evaluated before escape: crossing after zero keeps the pursuit active.
   168	        if self.remaining <= 0. && !self.dispatched {
   169	            self.dispatched = true;
   170	            return Outcome::Dispatch(id);
   171	        }
   172	        if p.distance(site.center) > site.radius && self.loot > 0 && !self.dispatched {
   173	            let loot = self.loot;
   174	            self.finish();
   175	            return Outcome::Escaped(loot);
   176	        }
   177	        Outcome::None
   178	    }
   179	    pub fn finish(&mut self) {
   180	        if let Some(id) = self.site {
   181	            self.cooldown[id] = 300. + (id as f32 * 97.).rem_euclid(601.);
   182	            self.hits[id] = 0;
   183	        }
   184	        self.site = None;
   185	        self.loot = 0;
   186	        self.progress = 0.;
   187	        self.dispatched = false;
   188	    }
   189	    pub fn cancel(&mut self) {
   190	        self.finish();
   191	    }
   192	}
   193	#[cfg(test)]
   194	mod tests {
   195	    use super::*;
   196	    #[test]
   197	    fn three_sites_pay_only_after_escape_and_once() {
   198	        for (id, _) in SITES.iter().enumerate() {
   199	            let mut a = Alarm::default();
   200	            assert!(a.start(id));
   201	            a.hits[id] = 3;

     1	use engine_core::Vec3;
     2	#[derive(Default)]
     3	pub struct Bank {
     4	    pub progress: f32,
     5	    pub loot: u32,
     6	    pub cooldown: f32,
     7	    pub active: bool,
     8	    pub timer: f32,
     9	}
    10	impl Bank {
    11	    pub fn start(&mut self) -> bool {
    12	        if self.cooldown <= 0. && !self.active && self.loot == 0 {
    13	            self.active = true;
    14	            self.timer = 70.;
    15	            self.progress = 0.;
    16	            true
    17	        } else {
    18	            false
    19	        }
    20	    }
    21	    pub fn tick(&mut self, p: Vec3, dt: f32) -> bool {
    22	        self.cooldown = (self.cooldown - dt).max(0.);
    23	        if self.active {
    24	            self.timer -= dt;
    25	            if self.timer <= 0. {
    26	                self.cancel();
    27	                return false;
    28	            }
    29	            if p.distance(Vec3::new(320., 0., 44.)) < 7. {
    30	                self.progress += dt;
    31	                if self.progress >= 8. {
    32	                    self.loot = 2500;
    33	                    self.active = false;
    34	                    return true;
    35	                }
    36	            }
    37	        }
    38	        false
    39	    }
    40	    pub fn deliver(&mut self) -> u32 {
    41	        let loot = self.loot;
    42	        self.loot = 0;
    43	        if loot > 0 {
    44	            self.cooldown = 90.;
    45	        }
    46	        loot
    47	    }
    48	    pub fn cancel(&mut self) {
    49	        self.active = false;
    50	        self.loot = 0;
    51	        self.progress = 0.;
    52	        self.cooldown = 30.;
    53	    }
    54	}
    55	#[cfg(test)]
    56	mod tests {
    57	    use super::*;
    58	    #[test]
    59	    fn delivery_once() {
    60	        let mut b = Bank::default();
    61	        assert!(b.start());
    62	        assert!(b.tick(Vec3::new(320., 0., 44.), 8.));
    63	        assert_eq!(b.deliver(), 2500);
    64	        assert_eq!(b.deliver(), 0);
    65	    }
    66	}

   112	pub fn path() -> PathBuf {
   113	    if let Some(p) = std::env::var_os("JAILBREAK_SAVE") {
   114	        return p.into();
   115	    }
   116	    let mut p = std::env::var_os("XDG_DATA_HOME")
   117	        .map(PathBuf::from)
   118	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
   119	            PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("HOME").unwrap_or_default()).join(".local/share")
   120	        });
   121	    p.push("jailbreak-rs/save.json");
   122	    p
   123	}
   124	pub fn load() -> Result<Save, String> {
   125	    load_from(&path())
   126	}
   127	fn load_from(p: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Save, String> {
   128	    if !p.exists() {
   129	        return Ok(Save::default());
   130	    }
   131	    let s: Save = serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(p).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)
   132	        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   133	    if s.version != 1 {
   134	        return Err("Unsupported save version".into());
   135	    }
   136	    if s.car_engine_selected
   137	        .iter()
   138	        .zip(s.car_engine)
   139	        .any(|(n, max)| *n != u32::MAX && *n > max)
   140	        || s.wanted > 5
   141	        || s.heist_cooldown
   142	            .iter()
   143	            .chain(s.robbery_cooldown.iter())
   144	            .any(|v| !v.is_finite() || *v < 0. || *v > 900.)
   145	        || s.car_engine.iter().any(|n| *n > 5)
   146	        || s.car_brakes.iter().any(|n| *n > 3)
   147	        || s.car_suspension.iter().any(|n| *n > 2)
   148	        || s.car_paint
   149	            .iter()
   150	            .flatten()
   151	            .any(|n| !n.is_finite() || *n < 0. || *n > 1.)
   152	        || s.leases
   153	            .iter()
   154	            .any(|n| !n.is_finite() || *n < 0. || *n > 900.)
   155	        || s.magazines.iter().zip([12, 6, 24]).any(|(v, max)| *v > max)
   156	        || s.ammunition.iter().any(|v| *v > 1000)
   157	        || s.texture_level > 3
   158	        || s.run_level > 5
   159	        || s.endurance_level > 5
   160	        || s.carry_level > 5
   161	        || s.water > 20
   162	        || s.food > 20
   163	        || s.quality > 3
   164	        || s.owned.iter().any(|i| *i >= 6)
   165	        || !s.position.x.is_finite()
   166	        || !s.position.z.is_finite()
   167	        || !s.position.y.is_finite()
   168	        || !s.render_distance.is_finite()
   169	        || s.render_distance < 80.
   170	        || s.render_distance > 650.
   171	        || s.ammo > 12
   172	        || !s.sensitivity.is_finite()
   173	        || s.sensitivity <= 0.
   174	    {
   175	        return Err("Invalid save".into());
   176	    }
   177	    Ok(s)
   178	}
   179	pub fn store(s: &Save) -> io::Result<()> {
   180	    store_at(&path(), s)
   181	}
   182	fn store_at(p: &std::path::Path, s: &Save) -> io::Result<()> {
   183	    if let Some(parent) = p.parent() {
   184	        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?
   185	    }
   186	    let tmp = p.with_extension("tmp");
   187	    std::fs::write(&tmp, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(s)?)?;
   188	    std::fs::rename(tmp, p)
   189	}

   212	fn read_car_engine<'de, D: serde::Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<[u32; 7], D::Error> {
   213	    let values = Vec::<u32>::deserialize(d)?;
   214	    if values.len() > 7 {
   215	        return Err(serde::de::Error::custom("too many vehicle slots"));
   216	    }
   217	    let mut out = [0; 7];
   218	    for (i, v) in values.into_iter().enumerate() {
   219	        out[i] = v;
   220	    }
   221	    Ok(out)
   222	}
   223

     1	use engine_core::Mesh;
     2	pub const LIMIT: f32 = 1024.;
     3	pub const CHUNK: f32 = 128.;
     4	fn smooth(a: f32, b: f32, x: f32) -> f32 {
     5	    let t = ((x - a) / (b - a)).clamp(0., 1.);
     6	    t * t * (3. - 2. * t)
     7	}
     8	pub fn industrial_height(x: f32, z: f32) -> f32 {
     9	    18. * smooth(420., 620., x)
    10	        * (1. - smooth(780., 980., x))
    11	        * smooth(-260., -60., z)
    12	        * (1. - smooth(300., 500., z))
    13	}
    14	pub fn height(x: f32, z: f32) -> f32 {
    15	    let coast = (x / 1000.).powi(4) + (z / 1040.).powi(4);
    16	    if coast > 1.05 {
    17	        return -8. - (coast - 1.05) * 8.;
    18	    }
    19	    let mountain =
    20	        smooth(390., 640., -z) * (1. - smooth(850., 990., -z)) * (1. - smooth(380., 550., x));
    21	    let peaks = 50. + 60. * (x * 0.007).sin().powi(2) + 35. * (z * 0.011 + x * 0.004).cos().powi(2);
    22	    let airport_flat = smooth(510., 550., x)
    23	        * (1. - smooth(840., 880., x))
    24	        * smooth(400., 440., z)
    25	        * (1. - smooth(840., 880., z));
    26	    let hills = smooth(500., 760., z) * 12. * (x * 0.009).sin().powi(2) * (1. - airport_flat);
    27	    let beach = -5. * smooth(0.82, 1.05, coast);
    28	    let lake = ((x + 540.) / 115.).powi(2) + ((z - 430.) / 90.).powi(2);
    29	    if lake < 1. {
    30	        return -4. * (1. - lake).min(0.8);
    31	    }
    32	    let pond = ((x + 230.) / 75.).powi(2) + ((z - 650.) / 65.).powi(2);
    33	    if pond < 1. {
    34	        return -3. * (1. - pond).min(0.9);
    35	    }
    36	    // Broad river along x=-440; every east/west arterial crosses on a bridge.
    37	    let river = (x + 440.).abs();
    38	    let river_depth = if (-500. ..700.).contains(&z) {
    39	        -4. * (1. - smooth(10., 24., river))
    40	    } else {
    41	        0.
    42	    };
    43	    let inland = smooth(500., 650., x.abs().max(z.abs()));
    44	    let rolling =
    45	        inland * (1. - airport_flat) * 5. * (x * 0.017).sin().powi(2) * (z * 0.014).cos().powi(2);
    46	    let industry = industrial_height(x, z);
    47	    let meadow = smooth(340., 480., z)
    48	        * (1. - smooth(620., 740., z))
    49	        * (1. - smooth(-410., -360., x))
    50	        * (1. - smooth(-750., -850., x));
    51	    let small_lake = ((x - 580.) / 65.).powi(2) + ((z - 470.) / 48.).powi(2);
    52	    if small_lake < 1. {
    53	        return -3. * (1. - small_lake).min(0.9);
    54	    }
    55	    let stream_x = -610. + 24. * (z * 0.012).sin();
    56	    let stream = if (280. ..740.).contains(&z) {
    57	        -3.5 * (1. - smooth(6., 18., (x - stream_x).abs()))
    58	    } else {
    59	        0.
    60	    };
    61	    let water = (-river_depth / 4.).max(-stream / 3.5);
    62	    let museum_distance = ((x + 200.).powi(2) + (z + 630.).powi(2)).sqrt();
    63	    let museum_blend = smooth(220., 280., museum_distance);
    64	    ((mountain * peaks + hills + rolling + beach + industry + meadow * 7.) * (1. - water)
    65	        + river_depth
    66	        + stream)
    67	        * museum_blend
    68	        + 88. * (1. - smooth(35., 220., museum_distance))
    69	}
    70	pub fn material(x: f32, z: f32, h: f32) -> (u8, [f32; 3]) {
    71	    if h < -0.2 {
    72	        (8, [0.25, 0.47, 0.56])
    73	    } else if x > 500. && z < -250. {
    74	        (5, [0.85, 0.72, 0.46])
    75	    } else if h > 25. {
    76	        (7, [0.62, 0.65, 0.64])
    77	    } else if x.abs() > 820. || z.abs() > 820. {
    78	        (5, [0.87, 0.78, 0.55])
    79	    } else {
    80	        (6, [0.38, 0.55, 0.32])
    81	    }
    82	}
    83	pub fn mesh(key: (i32, i32), lod: u8) -> Mesh {
    84	    mesh_reusing(key, lod, Vec::new())
    85	}
    86	pub fn mesh_reusing(key: (i32, i32), lod: u8, mut vertices: Vec<engine_core::Vertex>) -> Mesh {
    87	    vertices.clear();
    88	    let mut m = Mesh { vertices };
    89	    let step = if lod == 0 { 8. } else { 16. };
    90	    let n = (CHUNK / step) as i32;
    91	    let x0 = key.0 as f32 * CHUNK;
    92	    let z0 = key.1 as f32 * CHUNK;
    93	    for ix in 0..n {
    94	        for iz in 0..n {
    95	            let x = x0 + ix as f32 * step;
    96	            let z = z0 + iz as f32 * step;
    97	            let p = [
    98	                [x, height(x, z), z],
    99	                [x + step, height(x + step, z), z],
   100	                [x + step, height(x + step, z + step), z + step],
   101	                [x, height(x, z + step), z + step],
   102	            ];
   103	            let (mat, c) = material(x, z, height(x, z));
   104	            m.quad(p, c, mat, 0.);
   105	            // Clip water to each terrain triangle: the shoreline follows slopes instead of square tiles.
   106	            for indices in [[0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3]] {
   107	                let input = indices.map(|i| p[i]);
   108	                let mut water = Vec::new();
   109	                for i in 0..3 {
   110	                    let a = input[i];
   111	                    let b = input[(i + 1) % 3];
   112	                    let wet = a[1] < -0.2;
   113	                    let next = b[1] < -0.2;
   114	                    if wet {
   115	                        water.push([a[0], -0.2, a[2]]);
   116	                    }
   117	                    if wet != next {
   118	                        let t = (-0.2 - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]);
   119	                        water.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, -0.2, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t]);
   120	                    }
   121	                }
   122	                for i in 1..water.len().saturating_sub(1) {
   123	                    m.triangle(
   124	                        [water[0], water[i], water[i + 1]],
   125	                        [0.22, 0.46, 0.61],
   126	                        8,
   127	                        0.1,
   128	                    );
   129	                }
   130	            }
   131	        }
   132	    }
   133	    m
   134	}

     1	use engine_core::Vec3;
     2	use vehicles::{Car, CATALOG};
     3	pub fn step(car: &mut Car, throttle: f32, steer: f32, brake: bool, dt: f32) -> Vec3 {
     4	    let dt = dt.clamp(0., 0.1);
     5	    let s = &CATALOG[car.kind];
     6	    car.speed += throttle * s.acceleration * (1. + car.engine_level as f32 * 0.18) * dt;
     7	    car.speed *= (-dt
     8	        * if brake {
     9	            7. + car.brake_level as f32 * 1.5
    10	        } else {
    11	            0.22
    12	        })
    13	    .exp();
    14	    if brake && car.speed.abs() < 0.15 {
    15	        car.speed = 0.;
    16	    }
    17	    let maximum = s.max_speed * (1. + car.engine_level as f32 * 0.08);
    18	    car.speed = car.speed.clamp(-maximum * 0.35, maximum);
    19	    car.angle +=
    20	        steer * car.speed * dt * 0.045 * s.grip * (1. + car.suspension_level as f32 * 0.12)
    21	            / (1. + car.speed.abs() * 0.04);
    22	    Vec3::new(
    23	        car.pos.x + car.angle.sin() * car.speed * dt,
    24	        car.pos.y,
    25	        car.pos.z + car.angle.cos() * car.speed * dt,
    26	    )
    27	}
    28	#[cfg(test)]
    29	mod tests {
    30	    use super::*;
    31	    #[test]
    32	    fn engine_upgrade_accelerates_and_brakes_upgrade_stops_faster() {
    33	        let mut stock = Car::new(0, Vec3::default());
    34	        let mut tuned = Car::new(0, Vec3::default());
    35	        tuned.engine_level = 2;
    36	        for _ in 0..60 {
    37	            step(&mut stock, 1., 0., false, 1. / 60.);
    38	            step(&mut tuned, 1., 0., false, 1. / 60.);
    39	        }
    40	        assert!(tuned.speed > stock.speed);
    41	        stock.speed = 30.;
    42	        tuned.speed = 30.;
    43	        tuned.brake_level = 2;
    44	        step(&mut stock, 0., 0., true, 0.1);
    45	        step(&mut tuned, 0., 0., true, 0.1);
    46	        assert!(tuned.speed < stock.speed);
    47	    }
    48	    #[test]
    49	    fn braking_large_dt_does_not_reverse_or_lose_elevation() {
    50	        let mut c = Car::new(0, Vec3::new(0., 5., 0.));
    51	        c.speed = 30.;
    52	        let p = step(&mut c, 0., 0., true, 1.);
    53	        assert!(c.speed >= 0. && c.speed < 30.);
    54	        assert_eq!(p.y, 5.);
    55	    }
    56	    #[test]
    57	    fn bounded_speed() {
    58	        let mut c = Car::new(0, Vec3::default());
    59	        for _ in 0..6000 {
    60	            c.pos = step(&mut c, 1., 0., false, 1. / 60.);
    61	        }
    62	        assert!(c.speed <= 43.);
    63	        assert!(c.speed > 30.);
    64	    }
    65	}

     1	use engine_core::Mesh;
     2	/// Cross sections give each body a distinct silhouette without curved-box tessellation.
     3	pub fn mesh(kind: usize) -> Mesh {
     4	    let mut m = Mesh::default();
     5	    let (length, roof, cabin_z, width) = match kind {
     6	        1 => (3.65, 1.35, -0.25, 1.0),
     7	        3 => (4.5, 1.15, -0.25, 1.03),
     8	        4 => (5.1, 1.5, 0.65, 1.05),
     9	        6 => (4.55, 1.0, -0.15, 1.14),
    10	        5 => (4.8, 0.95, -0.4, 1.15),
    11	        _ => (4.5, 1.22, -0.35, 1.07),
    12	    };
    13	    let l = length * 0.5;
    14	    sections(
    15	        &mut m,
    16	        &[
    17	            (-l, width * 0.86, 0.1, 0.50),
    18	            (-l + 0.4, width, 0., 0.72),
    19	            (0., width, 0., 0.72),
    20	            (l - 0.5, width * 0.97, 0.06, 0.58),
    21	            (l, width * 0.78, 0.18, 0.42),
    22	        ],
    23	        [1., 1., 1.],
    24	    );
    25	    let cabin_length = if kind == 4 { 1.55 } else { 2.35 };
    26	    sections(
    27	        &mut m,
    28	        &[
    29	            (cabin_z - cabin_length * 0.5, 0.9, 0.65, 0.70),
    30	            (cabin_z - cabin_length * 0.25, 0.75, 0.65, roof),
    31	            (cabin_z + cabin_length * 0.24, 0.72, 0.65, roof),
    32	            (cabin_z + cabin_length * 0.5, 0.88, 0.6, 0.68),
    33	        ],
    34	        [0.12, 0.17, 0.21],
    35	    );
    36	    m.cuboid(
    37	        [0., roof + 0.015, cabin_z],
    38	        [1.45, 0.07, cabin_length * 0.49],
    39	        [1., 1., 1.],
    40	        1,
    41	        0.,
    42	    );
    43	    if kind == 4 {
    44	        // Open pickup bed with separate rails and tailgate.
    45	        m.cuboid(
    46	            [0., 0.73, -1.25],
    47	            [1.8, 0.08, 1.6],
    48	            [0.12, 0.13, 0.14],
    49	            1,
    50	            0.,
    51	        );
    52	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
    53	            m.cuboid(
    54	                [side * 0.96, 0.88, -1.25],
    55	                [0.13, 0.4, 1.8],
    56	                [1., 1., 1.],
    57	                1,
    58	                0.,
    59	            );
    60	        }
    61	    }
    62	    if kind == 6 {
    63	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
    64	            m.cuboid(
    65	                [side * 1.08, 0.5, -0.5],
    66	                [0.12, 0.4, 1.2],
    67	                [0.08, 0.1, 0.12],
    68	                1,
    69	                0.,
    70	            );
    71	        }
    72	        m.cuboid(
    73	            [0., 0.33, 2.23],
    74	            [0.5, 0.4, 0.12],
    75	            [0.06, 0.07, 0.08],
    76	            1,
    77	            0.,
    78	        );
    79	    }
    80	    if kind == 5 {
    81	        m.cuboid([0., 0.98, -2.], [2.25, 0.1, 0.4], [0.15, 0.17, 0.18], 1, 0.);
    82	        for side in [-1., 1.] {
    83	            m.cuboid(
    84	                [side * 0.7, 0.78, -2.],
    85	                [0.08, 0.4, 0.12],
    86	                [0.2, 0.2, 0.2],
    87	                1,
    88	                0.,
    89	            );
    90	        }
    91	    }
    92	    m
    93	}
    94	fn sections(m: &mut Mesh, rings: &[(f32, f32, f32, f32)], color: [f32; 3]) {
    95	    let ring = |(z, w, lo, hi): (f32, f32, f32, f32)| {
    96	        [
    97	            [-w * 0.8, lo, z],
    98	            [-w, lo + 0.12, z],
    99	            [-w, hi - 0.12, z],
   100	            [-w * 0.8, hi, z],
   101	            [w * 0.8, hi, z],
   102	            [w, hi - 0.12, z],
   103	            [w, lo + 0.12, z],
   104	            [w * 0.8, lo, z],
   105	        ]
   106	    };
   107	    for pair in rings.windows(2) {
   108	        let a = ring(pair[0]);
   109	        let b = ring(pair[1]);
   110	        for i in 0..8 {
   111	            let j = (i + 1) % 8;
   112	            let shade = [0.6, 0.7, 0.85, 1., 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6][i];
   113	            m.quad([a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]], color.map(|v| v * shade), 1, 0.);
   114	        }
   115	    }
   116	    for end in [0, rings.len() - 1] {
   117	        let a = ring(rings[end]);
   118	        for i in 1..7 {
   119	            m.triangle([a[0], a[i], a[i + 1]], color.map(|v| v * 0.8), 1, 0.);
   120	        }
   121	    }
   122	}
   123	#[cfg(test)]
   124	mod tests {
   125	    #[test]
   126	    fn body_budget_and_distinct_profiles() {
   127	        let meshes: Vec<_> = (0..7).map(super::mesh).collect();
   128	        for m in &meshes {
   129	            assert!(m.vertices.len() / 3 < 400);
   130	            assert!(m
   131	                .vertices
   132	                .iter()
   133	                .all(|v| v.position.iter().all(|x| x.is_finite())));
   134	        }
   135	        assert_ne!(
   136	            meshes[1].vertices[0].position,
   137	            meshes[4].vertices[0].position
   138	        );
   139	    }
   140	}

     1	#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
     2	pub struct Spec {
     3	    pub name: &'static str,
     4	    pub price: u32,
     5	    pub magazine: u32,
     6	    pub reserve: u32,
     7	    pub damage: f32,
     8	    pub range: f32,
     9	    pub interval: f32,
    10	    pub reload: f32,
    11	}
    12	pub const CATALOG: [Spec; 3] = [
    13	    Spec {
    14	        name: "PISTOL",
    15	        price: 350,
    16	        magazine: 12,
    17	        reserve: 36,
    18	        damage: 34.,
    19	        range: 65.,
    20	        interval: 0.25,
    21	        reload: 1.4,
    22	    },
    23	    Spec {
    24	        name: "SHOTGUN",
    25	        price: 600,
    26	        magazine: 6,
    27	        reserve: 18,
    28	        damage: 65.,
    29	        range: 24.,
    30	        interval: 0.85,
    31	        reload: 2.1,
    32	    },
    33	    Spec {
    34	        name: "RIFLE",
    35	        price: 950,
    36	        magazine: 24,
    37	        reserve: 72,
    38	        damage: 23.,
    39	        range: 100.,
    40	        interval: 0.12,
    41	        reload: 1.8,
    42	    },
    43	];
    44	use engine_core::Vec3;
    45	pub struct Pistol {
    46	    pub kind: usize,
    47	    pub ammo: u32,
    48	    pub reserve: u32,
    49	    pub cooldown: f32,
    50	    pub reload: f32,
    51	}
    52	impl Default for Pistol {
    53	    fn default() -> Self {
    54	        Self {
    55	            kind: 0,
    56	            ammo: 12,
    57	            reserve: 72,
    58	            cooldown: 0.,
    59	            reload: 0.,
    60	        }
    61	    }
    62	}
    63	impl Pistol {
    64	    pub fn tick(&mut self, dt: f32) {
    65	        self.cooldown = (self.cooldown - dt).max(0.);
    66	        if self.reload > 0. {
    67	            self.reload -= dt;
    68	            if self.reload <= 0. {
    69	                let n = (CATALOG[self.kind].magazine - self.ammo).min(self.reserve);
    70	                self.ammo += n;
    71	                self.reserve -= n;
    72	            }
    73	        }
    74	    }
    75	    pub fn fire(&mut self) -> bool {
    76	        if self.cooldown > 0. || self.reload > 0. || self.ammo == 0 {
    77	            return false;
    78	        }
    79	        self.ammo -= 1;
    80	        self.cooldown = CATALOG[self.kind].interval;
    81	        true
    82	    }
    83	    pub fn reload(&mut self) {
    84	        if self.reload <= 0. && self.ammo < CATALOG[self.kind].magazine && self.reserve > 0 {
    85	            self.reload = CATALOG[self.kind].reload;
    86	        }
    87	    }
    88	}
    89	pub fn ray_distance(origin: Vec3, yaw: f32, target: Vec3) -> Option<f32> {
    90	    ray_distance_range(origin, yaw, target, 65.)
    91	}
    92	pub fn ray_distance_range(origin: Vec3, yaw: f32, target: Vec3, range: f32) -> Option<f32> {
    93	    if (target.y - origin.y).abs() > 1.8 {
    94	        return None;
    95	    }
    96	    let dx = target.x - origin.x;
    97	    let dz = target.z - origin.z;
    98	    let along = dx * yaw.sin() - dz * yaw.cos();
    99	    let side = dx * yaw.cos() + dz * yaw.sin();
   100	    if along > 0. && along < range && side.abs() < 1.1 {
   101	        Some(along)
   102	    } else {
   103	        None
   104	    }
   105	}
   106	#[cfg(test)]
   107	mod tests {
   108	    use super::*;
   109	    #[test]
   110	    fn every_weapon_uses_its_magazine_cooldown_and_reload() {
   111	        for (id, s) in CATALOG.iter().enumerate() {
   112	            let mut w = Pistol {
   113	                kind: id,
   114	                ammo: s.magazine,
   115	                reserve: s.reserve,
   116	                ..Default::default()
   117	            };
   118	            assert!(w.fire());
   119	            assert!(!w.fire());
   120	            w.tick(s.interval + 0.01);
   121	            assert!(w.fire());
   122	            w.ammo = 0;
   123	            w.reload();
   124	            assert!(!w.fire());
   125	            w.tick(s.reload + 0.01);
   126	            assert_eq!(w.ammo, s.magazine);
   127	        }
   128	    }
   129	    #[test]
   130	    fn targets_on_other_floor_are_not_hit() {
   131	        assert!(ray_distance(Vec3::new(0., -3., 0.), 0., Vec3::new(0., 1., -5.)).is_none());
   132	        assert!(ray_distance(Vec3::new(0., 1., 0.), 0., Vec3::new(0., 1., -5.)).is_some());
   133	    }
   134	    #[test]
   135	    fn fire_and_reload() {
   136	        let mut p = Pistol::default();
   137	        for _ in 0..12 {
   138	            assert!(p.fire());
   139	            p.tick(0.3);
   140	        }
   141	        assert!(!p.fire());
   142	        p.reload();
   143	        assert!(!p.fire());
   144	        p.tick(1.5);
   145	        assert_eq!(p.ammo, 12);
   146	        assert_eq!(p.reserve, 60);
   147	    }
   148	}

   442	    }
   443	    for c in &mut colliders {
   444	        c.p.y += terrain::height(c.p.x, c.p.z).max(0.);
   445	    }
   446	    buildings::museum::place_0(&mut lib);
   447	    buildings::power_plant::place_0(&mut lib);
   448	    buildings::gas_station::place_0(&mut lib);
   449	    for b in &mut lib.buildings {
   450	        if matches!(b.name, "Museum" | "Power Plant" | "Gas Station") {
   451	            b.p.y = terrain::height(b.p.x, b.p.z).max(0.);
   452	        }
   453	    }
   454	    for name in ["Museum", "Power Plant", "Gas Station"] {
   455	        let b = lib.buildings.iter().find(|b| b.name == name).unwrap();
   456	        pois.push(Poi {
   457	            name,
   458	            p: b.p,
   459	            color: [0.2, 0.8, 0.8],
   460	        });
   461	    }
   462	    let mut points = Vec::new();
   463	    for i in 0..=240 {
   464	        let t = i as f32 / 240.;
   465	        let angle = t * std::f32::consts::TAU * 2.;
   466	        let radius = 180. * (1. - t) + 38.;
   467	        let x = -200. + angle.cos() * radius;
   468	        let z = -630. + angle.sin() * radius;
   469	        points.push(Vec3::new(x, terrain::height(x, z).max(0.), z));
   470	    }
   471	    let museum = lib.buildings.iter().find(|b| b.name == "Museum").unwrap();
   472	    let mut entry = museum.entrance();
   473	    entry.z -= 6.;
   474	    entry.y = museum.p.y;
   475	    points.push(Vec3::new(-162., museum.p.y, entry.z));
   476	    points.push(entry);
   477	    roadnet.push(Road {
   478	        name: "Museum spiral",
   479	        points,
   480	        width: 8.,
   481	        highway: false,
   482	    });
   483	    trees.retain(|t| {
   484	        if (((t.x / 800.).powi(2) + (t.z / 750.).powi(2)).sqrt() - 1.).abs() < 0.022 {
   485	            return false;
   486	        }
   487	        roadnet.iter().all(|r| r.distance(*t).0 > r.width / 2. + 8.)
   488	            && lib.buildings.iter().all(|b| {
   489	                (t.x - b.p.x).abs() > b.size.x / 2. + 12.
   490	                    || (t.z - b.p.z).abs() > b.size.z / 2. + 12.
   491	            })
   492	    });
   493	    World::assemble(roadnet, lib, colliders, props, pois, trees)
   494	}

    44	    pub(crate) fn assemble(
    45	        roads: Vec<Road>,
    46	        library: Library,
    47	        colliders: Vec<Collider>,
    48	        props: Vec<Prop>,
    49	        pois: Vec<Poi>,
    50	        trees: Vec<Vec3>,
    51	    ) -> Self {
    52	        let mut world = Self {
    53	            roads,
    54	            buildings: library.buildings,
    55	            colliders,
    56	            props,
    57	            pois,
    58	            trees,
    59	            cells: HashMap::new(),
    60	        };
    61	        for b in &world.buildings {
    62	            world.colliders.extend(b.colliders());
    63	        }
    64	        for t in &world.trees {
    65	            let h = world.surface(t.x, t.z);
    66	            world.colliders.push(Collider {
    67	                p: Vec3::new(t.x, h + 2., t.z),
    68	                size: Vec3::new(0.6, 4., 0.6),
    69	                movable: false,
    70	                breakable: true,
    71	            });
    72	        }
    73	        for (i, c) in world.colliders.iter().enumerate() {
    74	            let min = cell(c.p.x - c.size.x / 2. - 4., c.p.z - c.size.z / 2. - 4.);
    75	            let max = cell(c.p.x + c.size.x / 2. + 4., c.p.z + c.size.z / 2. + 4.);
    76	            for x in min.0..=max.0 {
    77	                for z in min.1..=max.1 {
    78	                    world.cells.entry((x, z)).or_default().push(i);
    79	                }
    80	            }
    81	        }
    82	        world
    83	    }
    84	    pub fn blocked(&self, p: Vec3, r: f32) -> bool {
    85	        if prison::underground(p) {
    86	            return !prison::passable(p, r);
    87	        }
    88	        if p.x.abs() > 1010. || p.z.abs() > 1010. {
    89	            return true;
    90	        }
    91	        if self
    92	            .interior(p)
    93	            .is_some_and(|i| self.buildings[i].support(p) > p.y - 0.5)
    94	        {
    95	            return true;
    96	        }
    97	        self.cells
    98	            .get(&cell(p.x, p.z))
    99	            .is_some_and(|ids| ids.iter().any(|i| self.colliders[*i].contains(p, r)))
   100	    }
   101	    pub fn body_blocked(&self, p: Vec3, r: f32, height: f32) -> bool {
   102	        if prison::underground(p) {
   103	            return self.blocked(p, r);
   104	        }
   105	        if p.x.abs() > 1010. || p.z.abs() > 1010. {
   106	            return true;
   107	        }
   108	        self.cells.get(&cell(p.x, p.z)).is_some_and(|ids| {
   109	            ids.iter().any(|i| {
   110	                let c = &self.colliders[*i];
   111	                p.y - 1. + height > c.p.y - c.size.y / 2.
   112	                    && p.y - 1. < c.p.y + c.size.y / 2.
   113	                    && (p.x - c.p.x).abs() < c.size.x / 2. + r
   114	                    && (p.z - c.p.z).abs() < c.size.z / 2. + r
   115	            })
   116	        })
   117	    }
   118	    pub fn walking_surface(&self, p: Vec3) -> f32 {
   119	        if prison::underground(p) {
   120	            -4.
   121	        } else if let Some(id) = self.interior(p) {
   122	            self.buildings[id].support(p)
   123	        } else {
   124	            self.surface(p.x, p.z)
   125	        }
   126	    }
   127	    pub fn next_step(&self, from: Vec3, target: Vec3, distance: f32) -> Vec3 {
   128	        // Route through an actual entrance rather than getting stuck at the nearest wall.
   129	        let target = if let Some(id) = self.interior(from) {
   130	            let b = &self.buildings[id];
   131	            if !b.inside(target) {
   132	                b.entrance()
   133	            } else {
   134	                target
   135	            }
   136	        } else if let Some(id) = self.interior(target) {
   137	            let entry = self.buildings[id].entrance();
   138	            if from.distance(entry) > 4. {
   139	                entry
   140	            } else {
   141	                target
   142	            }
   143	        } else {
   144	            target
   145	        };
   146	        let steer = |goal: Vec3| {
   147	            let dx = goal.x - from.x;
   148	            let dz = goal.z - from.z;
   149	            let len = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt().max(0.001);
   150	            let step = distance.min(len);
   151	            let mut p = Vec3::new(from.x + dx / len * step, from.y, from.z + dz / len * step);
   152	            p.y = self.walking_surface(p) + 1.;
   153	            p
   154	        };
   155	        let direct = steer(target);
   156	        let clear = |a: Vec3, b: Vec3| {
   157	            let samples = (a.distance(b) / 0.4).ceil().clamp(1., 2048.) as i32;
   158	            let mut previous_height = self.walking_surface(a) + 1.;
   159	            (1..=samples).all(|i| {
   160	                let t = i as f32 / samples as f32;
   161	                let mut p = Vec3::new(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, a.y, a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t);
   162	                p.y = self.walking_surface(p) + 1.;
   163	                let clear = !self.blocked(p, 0.45) && (p.y - previous_height).abs() < 0.6;
   164	                previous_height = p.y;
   165	                clear
   166	            })
   167	        };
   168	        if clear(from, target) {
   169	            return direct;
   170	        }
   171	        // A 48m local search; node spacing matches the 2m cell door clearance.
   172	        let origin = (from.x.round() as i32, from.z.round() as i32);
   173	        let mut frontier = std::collections::BinaryHeap::new();
   174	        let mut cost = HashMap::new();
   175	        let mut parent = HashMap::new();
   176	        frontier.push((0, origin));
   177	        cost.insert(origin, 0i32);
   178	        let heuristic =
   179	            |q: (i32, i32)| ((q.0 as f32 - target.x).abs() + (q.1 as f32 - target.z).abs()) as i32;
   180	        let mut best = origin;
   181	        let mut expanded = 0;
   182	        while let Some((_, node)) = frontier.pop() {
   183	            expanded += 1;
   184	            if expanded > 100 {
   185	                break;
   186	            }
   187	            if heuristic(node) < heuristic(best) {
   188	                best = node;
   189	            }
   190	            let a = Vec3::new(node.0 as f32, from.y, node.1 as f32);
   191	            if heuristic(node) < 2 {
   192	                best = node;
   193	                break;
   194	            }
   195	            for (dx, dz) in [(1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)] {
   196	                let q = (node.0 + dx, node.1 + dz);
   197	                if (q.0 - origin.0).abs() > 24 || (q.1 - origin.1).abs() > 24 {
   198	                    continue;
   199	                }
   200	                let b = Vec3::new(q.0 as f32, from.y, q.1 as f32);
   201	                if !clear(a, b) {
   202	                    continue;
   203	                }
   204	                let g = cost[&node] + 1;
   205	                if cost.get(&q).is_none_or(|old| g < *old) {
   206	                    cost.insert(q, g);
   207	                    parent.insert(q, node);
   208	                    frontier.push((-(g + heuristic(q)), q));
   209	                }
   210	            }
   211	        }
   212	        let mut q = best;
   213	        while let Some(prev) = parent.get(&q) {
   214	            if *prev == origin {
   215	                break;
   216	            }
   217	            q = *prev;
   218	        }
   219	        let p = steer(Vec3::new(q.0 as f32, from.y, q.1 as f32));
   220	        if clear(from, p) {
   221	            p
   222	        } else {
   223	            // A fractional position beside a jamb may not reach the first grid
   224	            // neighbor diagonally. Align with the clear origin before turning.
   225	            let aligned = steer(Vec3::new(origin.0 as f32, from.y, origin.1 as f32));
   226	            if from.distance(aligned) > 0.001 && clear(from, aligned) {
   227	                aligned
   228	            } else {
   229	                from
   230	            }
   231	        }
   232	    }
   233	    pub fn ceiling(&self, p: Vec3) -> f32 {
   234	        if prison::underground(p) {
   235	            return -0.3;
   236	        }
   237	        if let Some(id) = self.interior(p) {
   238	            let b = &self.buildings[id];
   239	            if b.name == "Jewelry" && p.y > b.p.y + 12.5 {
   240	                return f32::MAX;
   241	            }
   242	            if matches!(b.name, "Office" | "Jewelry" | "Westhaven") {
   243	                return b.support(p) + 4.;
   244	            }
   245	            return b.p.y + b.size.y;
   246	        }
   247	        if p.z < -460. {
   248	            if let Some(r) = self.roads.iter().find(|r| r.name == "Mountain tunnel") {
   249	                if r.distance(p).0 < 6. {
   250	                    return 6.;
   251	                }
   252	            }
   253	        }
   254	        f32::MAX
   255	    }
   256	    pub fn surface(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> f32 {
   257	        let p = Vec3::new(x, 0., z);
   258	        if let Some(id) = self.interior(p) {
   259	            return self.buildings[id].support(p);
   260	        }
   261	        // The central plain and its roads are at sea-level; avoid scanning every
   262	        // spline segment during local navigation on this known flat region.
   263	        if (-380. ..500.).contains(&x) && (-350. ..350.).contains(&z) && terrain::height(x, z) == 0.
   264	        {
   265	            return 0.;
   266	        }
   267	        if let Some(b) = self.buildings.iter().find(|b| {
   268	            b.name != "Penthouse"
   269	                && (x - b.p.x).abs() < b.size.x / 2. + 7.
   270	                && (z - b.p.z).abs() < b.size.z / 2. + 7.
   271	        }) {
   272	            let d = ((x - b.p.x).abs() - b.size.x / 2.).max((z - b.p.z).abs() - b.size.z / 2.);
   273	            let blend = ((d - 3.) / 4.).clamp(0., 1.);
   274	            return b.p.y * (1. - blend) + terrain::height(x, z) * blend;
   275	        }
   276	        let mut nearest = (f32::MAX, 0., 0.);
   277	        for road in &self.roads {
   278	            let (d, y) = road.distance(p);
   279	            if d < nearest.0 {
   280	                nearest = (d, y, road.width);
   281	            }
   282	        }
   283	        if nearest.0 < nearest.2 / 2. + 1.5 {
   284	            return nearest.1;
   285	        }
   286	        if nearest.0 < nearest.2 / 2. + 10. && terrain::height(x, z) < 20. {
   287	            let blend = ((nearest.0 - nearest.2 / 2. - 5.) / 5.).clamp(0., 1.);
   288	            nearest.1 * (1. - blend) + terrain::height(x, z) * blend
   289	        } else {
   290	            terrain::height(x, z)
   291	        }
   292	    }
   293	    pub fn interior(&self, p: Vec3) -> Option<usize> {
   294	        self.buildings.iter().position(|b| {
   295	            b.interior
   296	                && b.inside(p)
   297	                && p.y + 1.5 >= b.p.y
   298	                && p.y - 0.8 <= b.p.y + b.size.y + if b.name == "Jewelry" { 0.5 } else { 0. }
   299	        })
   300	    }
   301	    pub fn chunk(&self, key: (i32, i32), lod: u8) -> Mesh {
   302	        self.chunk_reusing(key, lod, Vec::new())
   303	    }
   304	    pub fn chunk_reusing(
   305	        &self,
   306	        key: (i32, i32),
   307	        lod: u8,
   308	        vertices: Vec<engine_core::Vertex>,
   309	    ) -> Mesh {
   310	        let mut m = terrain::mesh_reusing(key, lod, vertices);
   311	        let x0 = key.0 as f32 * CHUNK;
   312	        let z0 = key.1 as f32 * CHUNK;
   313	        let in_chunk = |p: Vec3| p.x >= x0 && p.x < x0 + CHUNK && p.z >= z0 && p.z < z0 + CHUNK;
   314	        // Smooth road embankments; preserve mountain cover above the tunnel.
   315	        let nearby: Vec<&Road> = self
   316	            .roads
   317	            .iter()
   318	            .filter(|r| {
   319	                r.points
   320	                    .iter()
   321	                    .any(|p| p.x > x0 - 32. && p.x < x0 + 160. && p.z > z0 - 32. && p.z < z0 + 160.)
   322	            })
   323	            .collect();
   324	        for v in &mut m.vertices {
   325	            let p = Vec3::new(v.position[0], 0., v.position[2]);
   326	            if v.position[1] == -0.2 {
   327	                continue;
   328	            }
   329	            for r in &nearby {
   330	                let (d, y) = r.distance(p);
   331	                if d < r.width / 2. + 10. && v.position[1] < 20. {
   332	                    let blend = ((d - r.width / 2. - 5.) / 5.).clamp(0., 1.);
   333	                    v.position[1] = y * (1. - blend) + v.position[1] * blend;
   334	                }
   335	            }
   336	        }
   337	        self.railway_mesh(key, &mut m);
   338	        if key == (-1, -1) {
   339	            prison::mesh(&mut m, lod);
   340	        }
   341	        for v in &mut m.vertices {
   342	            if v.position[1] < -0.25 || v.position[1] > 25. {
   343	                continue;
   344	            }
   345	            for b in &self.buildings {
   346	                if b.name == "Penthouse" {
   347	                    continue;
   348	                }
   349	                let dx = (v.position[0] - b.p.x).abs() - b.size.x / 2.;
   350	                let dz = (v.position[2] - b.p.z).abs() - b.size.z / 2.;
   351	                let d = dx.max(dz);
   352	                if d < 7. {
   353	                    let blend = ((d - 3.) / 4.).clamp(0., 1.);
   354	                    v.position[1] = b.p.y * (1. - blend) + v.position[1] * blend;
   355	                }
   356	            }
   357	        }
   358	        for road in &self.roads {
   359	            road.mesh(key, lod, &mut m);
   360	        }
   361	        for b in &self.buildings {
   362	            if in_chunk(b.p) {
   363	                b.mesh(&mut m, lod);
   364	            }
   365	        }
   366	        for prop in &self.props {
   367	            if in_chunk(prop.p) && (lod == 0 || prop.size.y > 5.) {
   368	                if prop.roof {
   369	                    m.roof(
   370	                        [prop.p.x, prop.p.y, prop.p.z],
   371	                        [prop.size.x, prop.size.y, prop.size.z],
   372	                        prop.color,
   373	                    );
   374	                } else {
   375	                    m.cuboid(
   376	                        [prop.p.x, prop.p.y, prop.p.z],
   377	                        [prop.size.x, prop.size.y, prop.size.z],
   378	                        prop.color,
   379	                        prop.material,
   380	                        prop.emission,
   381	                    );
   382	                }
   383	            }
   384	        }
   385	        for t in &self.trees {
   386	            if in_chunk(*t) {
   387	                let h = self.surface(t.x, t.z);
   388	                if lod == 0 {
   389	                    m.cylinder([t.x, h, t.z], 0.3, 4., [0.55, 0.4, 0.25], 10, 6);
   390	                    for (y, r) in [(3., 3.8), (5., 2.8), (7., 1.6)] {
   391	                        for i in 0..6 {
   392	                            let a = i as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU / 6.;
   393	                            let b = (i + 1) as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU / 6.;
   394	                            m.triangle(
   395	                                [
   396	                                    [t.x + a.cos() * r, h + y, t.z + a.sin() * r],
   397	                                    [t.x + b.cos() * r, h + y, t.z + b.sin() * r],
   398	                                    [t.x, h + y + 3.5, t.z],
   399	                                ],
   400	                                [0.21, 0.4, 0.25],
   401	                                6,
   402	                                0.,
   403	                            );
   404	                        }
   405	                    }
   406	                } else {
   407	                    m.triangle(
   408	                        [
   409	                            [t.x - 3., h + 2., t.z],
   410	                            [t.x + 3., h + 2., t.z],
   411	                            [t.x, h + 10., t.z],
   412	                        ],
   413	                        [0.24, 0.42, 0.26],
   414	                        6,
   415	                        0.,
   416	                    );
   417	                    m.triangle(
   418	                        [
   419	                            [t.x, h + 2., t.z - 3.],
   420	                            [t.x, h + 2., t.z + 3.],
   421	                            [t.x, h + 10., t.z],
   422	                        ],
   423	                        [0.24, 0.42, 0.26],
   424	                        6,
   425	                        0.,
   426	                    );
   427	                }
   428	            }
   429	        }
   430	        // Rail corridor shares the transport grid but is physically independent.
   431	        for i in 0..16 {
   432	            let x = x0 + i as f32 * 8.;
   433	            let z = 365.;
   434	            if in_chunk(Vec3::new(x, 0., z)) {
   435	                m.cuboid([x, 0.08, z], [1., 0.16, 3.5], [0.47, 0.32, 0.2], 10, 0.);
   436	                for zz in [z - 1., z + 1.] {
   437	                    m.cuboid([x, 0.2, zz], [8.1, 0.15, 0.12], [0.62, 0.64, 0.66], 4, 0.);
   438	                }
   439	            }
   440	        }
   441	        // Mountain tunnel has continuous visible inner walls and a clear 6m envelope.
   442	        if lod == 0 {
   443	            for r in &self.roads {
   444	                if r.name == "Mountain tunnel" {
   445	                    for (i, seg) in r.points.windows(2).enumerate() {
   446	                        let a = seg[0];
   447	                        let b = seg[1];
   448	                        if in_chunk(a) && a.z < -460. {
   449	                            let (nx, nz) = r.normal(i);
   450	                            let (bx, bz) = r.normal(i + 1);
   451	                            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   452	                                m.quad(
   453	                                    [
   454	                                        [a.x + nx * side * 6., 0., a.z + nz * side * 6.],
   455	                                        [b.x + bx * side * 6., 0., b.z + bz * side * 6.],
   456	                                        [b.x + bx * side * 6., 6., b.z + bz * side * 6.],
   457	                                        [a.x + nx * side * 6., 6., a.z + nz * side * 6.],
   458	                                    ],
   459	                                    [0.58, 0.59, 0.55],
   460	                                    1,
   461	                                    0.,
   462	                                );
   463	                            }
   464	                            m.quad(
   465	                                [
   466	                                    [a.x + nx * 6., 6., a.z + nz * 6.],
   467	                                    [b.x + bx * 6., 6., b.z + bz * 6.],
   468	                                    [b.x - bx * 6., 6., b.z - bz * 6.],
   469	                                    [a.x - nx * 6., 6., a.z - nz * 6.],
   470	                                ],
   471	                                [0.45, 0.48, 0.47],
   472	                                1,
   473	                                0.,
   474	                            );
   475	                        }
   476	                    }
   477	                }
   478	            }
   479	        }
   480	        m
   481	    }
   482	    pub fn navigation_image(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
   483	        let n = 256;
   484	        let mut pixels = vec![0u8; n * n * 3];
   485	        for z in 0..n {
   486	            for x in 0..n {
   487	                let wx = x as f32 / 256. * 2048. - 1024.;
   488	                let wz = z as f32 / 256. * 2048. - 1024.;
   489	                let h = terrain::height(wx, wz);
   490	                let (_, c) = terrain::material(wx, wz, h);
   491	                let i = (z * n + x) * 3;
   492	                for j in 0..3 {
   493	                    pixels[i + j] = (c[j] * 170.) as u8;
   494	                }
   495	            }
   496	        }
   497	        let mut dot = |x: f32, z: f32, r: i32, c: [u8; 3]| {
   498	            let px = ((x + 1024.) / 2048. * 256.) as i32;
   499	            let pz = ((z + 1024.) / 2048. * 256.) as i32;
   500	            for dz in -r..=r {
   501	                for dx in -r..=r {
   502	                    let xx = px + dx;
   503	                    let zz = pz + dz;
   504	                    if (0..256).contains(&xx) && (0..256).contains(&zz) {
   505	                        let i = (zz as usize * 256 + xx as usize) * 3;
   506	                        pixels[i..i + 3].copy_from_slice(&c);
   507	                    }
   508	                }
   509	            }
   510	        };
   511	        for road in &self.roads {
   512	            for seg in road.points.windows(2) {
   513	                let a = seg[0];
   514	                let b = seg[1];
   515	                for i in 0..8 {
   516	                    let t = i as f32 / 8.;
   517	                    dot(
   518	                        a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t,
   519	                        a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t,
   520	                        if road.highway { 1 } else { 0 },
   521	                        [155, 161, 166],
   522	                    );
   523	                }
   524	            }
   525	        }
   526	        for b in &self.buildings {
   527	            for x in (-(b.size.x / 2.) as i32..=(b.size.x / 2.) as i32).step_by(8) {
   528	                for z in (-(b.size.z / 2.) as i32..=(b.size.z / 2.) as i32).step_by(8) {
   529	                    dot(b.p.x + x as f32, b.p.z + z as f32, 0, [91, 107, 121]);
   530	                }
   531	            }
   532	        }
   533	        pixels
   534	    }
   535	    pub fn audit(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
   536	        for b in &self.buildings {
   537	            let hx = b.size.x / 2.;
   538	            let hz = b.size.z / 2.;
   539	            for road in &self.roads {
   540	                for p in &road.points {
   541	                    if (p.x - b.p.x).abs() < hx + road.width / 2. - 0.2
   542	                        && (p.z - b.p.z).abs() < hz + road.width / 2. - 0.2
   543	                    {
   544	                        return Err(format!(
   545	                            "Road {} overlaps building {} #{} at {},{}",
   546	                            road.name, b.name, b.id, p.x, p.z
   547	                        ));
   548	                    }
   549	                }
   550	            }
   551	        }
   552	        for b in &self.buildings {
   553	            if b.interior {
   554	                let mut p = b.entrance();
   555	                for i in 0..60 {
   556	                    p.z = b.entrance().z + i as f32 * 0.5;
   557	                    if p.z > b.p.z {
   558	                        break;
   559	                    }
   560	                    if self.blocked(p, 0.45) {
   561	                        return Err(format!("Interior entrance blocked: {}", b.name));
   562	                    }
   563	                }
   564	            }
   565	        }
   566	        Ok(())
   567	    }
   568	}
   569	pub fn cell(x: f32, z: f32) -> (i32, i32) {
   570	    ((x / CHUNK).floor() as i32, (z / CHUNK).floor() as i32)
   571	}
   572	
   573	impl World {
   574	    fn railway_mesh(&self, key: (i32, i32), m: &mut Mesh) {
   575	        for i in 0..600 {
   576	            let a = i as f32 / 600. * std::f32::consts::TAU;
   577	            let b = (i + 1) as f32 / 600. * std::f32::consts::TAU;
   578	            let x = 800. * a.cos();
   579	            let z = 750. * a.sin();
   580	            if cell(x, z) != key {
   581	                continue;
   582	            }
   583	            let qx = 800. * b.cos();
   584	            let qz = 750. * b.sin();
   585	            let y = terrain::height(x, z).max(0.) + 0.2;
   586	            let qy = terrain::height(qx, qz).max(0.) + 0.2;
   587	            let dx = qx - x;
   588	            let dz = qz - z;
   589	            let len = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt();
   590	            let nx = -dz / len;
   591	            let nz = dx / len;
   592	            for side in [-1., 1.] {
   593	                let off = side * 1.1;
   594	                m.quad(
   595	                    [
   596	                        [x + nx * (off - 0.06), y, z + nz * (off - 0.06)],
   597	                        [qx + nx * (off - 0.06), qy, qz + nz * (off - 0.06)],
   598	                        [qx + nx * (off + 0.06), qy, qz + nz * (off + 0.06)],
   599	                        [x + nx * (off + 0.06), y, z + nz * (off + 0.06)],
   600	                    ],
   601	                    [0.55, 0.56, 0.58],
   602	                    4,
   603	                    0.,
   604	                );
   605	            }
   606	            m.cuboid([x, y - 0.15, z], [3., 0.25, 0.4], [0.35, 0.22, 0.12], 2, 0.);
   607	        }
   608	    }
   609	}

    23	    ((-136., -122.), (-148., -122.)),
    24	    ((-120., -112.), (-120., -125.)),
    25	    ((-104., -100.), (-94., -100.)),

    28	pub fn underground(p: Vec3) -> bool {
    29	    p.y < -0.5 && (-152. ..=-90.).contains(&p.x) && (-150. ..=-73.).contains(&p.z)
    30	}
    31	pub fn passable(p: Vec3, r: f32) -> bool {
    32	    let segments = ROUTE.windows(2).map(|v| (v[0], v[1])).chain(BRANCHES);
    33	    segments.into_iter().any(|(a, b)| {
    34	        let width = 2.5 - r;
    35	        p.x >= a.0.min(b.0) - width
    36	            && p.x <= a.0.max(b.0) + width
    37	            && p.z >= a.1.min(b.1) - width
    38	            && p.z <= a.1.max(b.1) + width
    39	    })
    40	}
    41	pub fn mesh(m: &mut Mesh, lod: u8) {
    42	    // Concertina wire on the fictional camp perimeter; static LOD geometry.
    43	    for edge in [-220., -100.] {
    44	        for i in 0..28 {
    45	            let segments = if lod == 0 { 16 } else { 4 };
    46	            for j in 0..segments {
    47	                let phase = j as f32 / segments as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU;
    48	                let next = (j + 1) as f32 / segments as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU;
    49	                let a = [
    50	                    -168. + i as f32 * 5. + j as f32 * 5. / segments as f32,
    51	                    6.4 + phase.sin() * 0.45,
    52	                    edge + phase.cos() * 0.45,
    53	                ];
    54	                let b = [
    55	                    -168. + i as f32 * 5. + (j + 1) as f32 * 5. / segments as f32,
    56	                    6.4 + next.sin() * 0.45,
    57	                    edge + next.cos() * 0.45,
    58	                ];
    59	                m.quad(
    60	                    [a, b, [b[0], b[1] + 0.04, b[2]], [a[0], a[1] + 0.04, a[2]]],
    61	                    [0.3, 0.32, 0.29],
    62	                    4,
    63	                    0.,
    64	                );
    65	                if lod == 0 && j % 4 == 0 {
    66	                    m.cuboid(a, [0.22, 0.025, 0.025], [0.22, 0.24, 0.21], 4, 0.);
    67	                }
    68	            }
    69	        }
    70	    }
    71	
    72	    for z in [-145., -78.] {
    73	        m.cuboid(
    74	            [-116., 0.08, z],
    75	            [2.4, 0.16, 2.4],
    76	            [0.16, 0.23, 0.26],
    77	            4,
    78	            0.,
    79	        );
    80	    }
    81	}
    82	pub fn sewer_mesh() -> Mesh {
    83	    let mut mesh = Mesh::default();
    84	    let m = &mut mesh;
    85	    for x in (-151..-90).step_by(2) {
    86	        for z in (-149..-73).step_by(2) {
    87	            let p = Vec3::new(x as f32, -3., z as f32);
    88	            if !passable(p, 0.) {
    89	                continue;
    90	            }
    91	            m.cuboid([p.x, -4.1, p.z], [2., 0.2, 2.], [0.25, 0.31, 0.3], 1, 0.);
    92	            if p.distance(Vec3::new(-116., -3., -145.)) > 2.
    93	                && p.distance(Vec3::new(-116., -3., -78.)) > 2.
    94	            {
    95	                m.cuboid([p.x, -0.2, p.z], [2., 0.2, 2.], [0.25, 0.3, 0.3], 1, 0.);
    96	            }
    97	            for (dx, dz) in [(2., 0.), (-2., 0.), (0., 2.), (0., -2.)] {
    98	                if !passable(Vec3::new(p.x + dx, -3., p.z + dz), 0.) {
    99	                    m.cuboid(
   100	                        [p.x + dx / 2., -2., p.z + dz / 2.],
   101	                        if dx == 0. {
   102	                            [2., 4., 0.15]
   103	                        } else {
   104	                            [0.15, 4., 2.]
   105	                        },
   106	                        [0.3, 0.38, 0.34],
   107	                        2,
   108	                        0.,
   109	                    );
   110	                }
   111	            }
   112	        }
   113	    }
   114	    for z in [-145., -78.] {
   115	        m.cuboid(
   116	            [-116., 0.08, z],
   117	            [2.4, 0.16, 2.4],
   118	            [0.16, 0.23, 0.26],
   119	            4,
   120	            0.,
   121	        );
   122	        for x in [-117., -115.] {
   123	            m.cuboid([x, -2., z], [0.12, 4., 0.12], [0.75, 0.65, 0.25], 4, 0.);
   124	        }
   125	        for i in 0..10 {
   126	            m.cuboid(
   127	                [-116., -3.8 + i as f32 * 0.4, z],
   128	                [2., 0.12, 0.12],
   129	                [0.75, 0.65, 0.25],
   130	                4,
   131	                0.,
   132	            );
   133	        }
   134	    }
   135	    for z in (-140..-80).step_by(10) {
   136	        m.cuboid(
   137	            [-116., -0.4, z as f32],
   138	            [1., 0.12, 0.5],
   139	            [0.75, 0.95, 0.8],
   140	            9,
   141	            1.,
   142	        );
   143	    }

     1	use crate::World;
     2	use engine_core::Mesh;
     3	use std::{
     4	    sync::{
     5	        mpsc::{self, Receiver, SyncSender},
     6	        Arc,
     7	    },
     8	    thread,
     9	};
    10	pub struct ChunkData {
    11	    pub key: (i32, i32),
    12	    pub lod: u8,
    13	    pub mesh: Mesh,
    14	}
    15	pub struct Streamer {
    16	    sender: Option<SyncSender<((i32, i32), u8)>>,
    17	    receiver: Option<Receiver<ChunkData>>,
    18	    recycle: SyncSender<Vec<engine_core::Vertex>>,
    19	    worker: Option<thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
    20	}
    21	impl Streamer {
    22	    pub fn new(world: Arc<World>) -> Self {
    23	        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::sync_channel::<((i32, i32), u8)>(32);
    24	        let (out_tx, out_rx) = mpsc::sync_channel(4);
    25	        let (recycle, recycled) = mpsc::sync_channel(8);
    26	        let worker = thread::spawn(move || {
    27	            while let Ok((key, lod)) = rx.recv() {
    28	                let vertices = recycled.try_recv().unwrap_or_default();
    29	                let mesh = world.chunk_reusing(key, lod, vertices);
    30	                if out_tx.send(ChunkData { key, lod, mesh }).is_err() {
    31	                    break;
    32	                }
    33	            }
    34	        });
    35	        Self {
    36	            sender: Some(tx),
    37	            receiver: Some(out_rx),
    38	            worker: Some(worker),
    39	            recycle,
    40	        }
    41	    }
    42	    pub fn request(&self, key: (i32, i32), lod: u8) -> bool {
    43	        self.sender
    44	            .as_ref()
    45	            .is_some_and(|s| s.try_send((key, lod)).is_ok())
    46	    }
    47	    pub fn recycle(&self, mesh: Mesh) {
    48	        let _ = self.recycle.try_send(mesh.vertices);
    49	    }
    50	    pub fn poll(&self) -> Option<ChunkData> {
    51	        self.receiver.as_ref()?.try_recv().ok()
    52	    }
    53	}
    54	impl Drop for Streamer {
    55	    fn drop(&mut self) {
    56	        self.sender.take();
    57	        self.receiver.take();
    58	        if let Some(w) = self.worker.take() {
    59	            let _ = w.join();
    60	        }
    61	    }
    62	}

    70	        for x in -8..8 {
    71	            for z in -8..8 {
    72	                stream.request((x, z), 1);
    73	            }
    74	        }
    75	        drop(stream);
    76	    }
    77	}
